丙.zh: 经过专家评审，这个项目的综合评分被定为丙级，仍有较大的改进空间。
丙.py: Jīngguò zhuānjiā píngshěn, zhège xiàngmù de zōnghé píngfēn bèi dìng wéi bǐng jí, réng yǒu jiàodà de gǎijìn kōngjiān.
丙.en: After evaluation by the experts, this project's overall rating was graded as Level C, leaving considerable room for improvement.

次要.zh: 处理紧急事件时，我们必须抓住核心矛盾，次要问题可以稍后再解决。
次要.py: Chǔlǐ jǐnjí shìjiàn shí, wǒmen bìxū zhuāzhù héxīn máodùn, cìyào wèntí kěyǐ shāo hòu zài jiějué.
次要.en: When dealing with emergencies, we must grasp the core conflict; secondary issues can be resolved later.

登机牌.zh: 旅客请提前在手机上办理值机并获取电子登机牌，以节省排队时间。
登机牌.py: Lǚkè qǐng tíqián zài shǒujī shang bànlǐ zhíjī bìng huòqǔ diànzǐ dēngjīpái, yǐ jiéshěng páiduì shíjiān.
登机牌.en: Passengers are requested to check in advance on their mobile phones and obtain an electronic boarding pass to save queuing time.

钓.zh: 叔叔周末常常带着鱼竿去湖边钓鱼，享受悠闲的独处时光。
钓.py: Shūshu zhōumò chángcháng dàizhe yúgān qù hú biān diàoyú, xiǎngshòu yōuxián de dúchǔ shíguāng.
钓.en: My uncle often takes his fishing rod to the lakeside on weekends to fish and enjoy leisurely solitary time.

丁.zh: 本次技术合同由甲、乙、丙、丁四方共同签署并承担相应责任。
丁.py: Běncì jìshù hétóng yóu Jiǎ, Yǐ, Bǐng, Dīng sì fāng gòngtóng qiānshǔ bìng chéngdān xiāngyìng zérèn.
丁.en: This technical contract was jointly signed by all four parties—A, B, C, and D—who will bear corresponding responsibilities.

非.zh: 实验室内有精密仪器，非工作人员请勿擅自入内。
非.py: Shíyànshì nèi yǒu jīngmì yíqì, fēi gōngzuò rényuán qǐng wù shànzì rùnèi.
非.en: There are precision instruments inside the laboratory; unauthorized personnel are requested not to enter.

讽刺.zh: 这部幽默讽刺喜剧巧妙地揭露了某些职场中盲目迎合领导的虚伪风气。
讽刺.py: Zhè bù yōumò fěngcì xǐjù qiǎomiào de jiēlù le mǒuxiē zhíchǎng zhōng mángmù yínghé lǐngdǎo de xūwěi fēngqì.
讽刺.en: This satirical comedy cleverly exposes the hypocritical culture of blindly catering to leadership in some workplaces.

乖.zh: 孩子在诊所打针时不仅没有哭闹，而且非常乖地配合医生。
乖.py: Háizi zài zhěnsuǒ dǎzhēn shí bùjǐn méiyǒu kūnào, érqiě fēicháng guāi de pèihé yīshēng.
乖.en: When getting a vaccination at the clinic, the child not only did not cry, but was also very well-behaved and cooperated with the doctor.

罐头.zh: 这种金属罐头密封性能良好，能够长期保存食物的营养与风味。
罐头.py: Zhè zhǒng jīnshǔ guàntou mìfēng xìngnéng liánghǎo, nénggòu chángqī bǎocún shíwù de yíngyǎng yǔ fēngwèi.
罐头.en: This kind of metal can has excellent sealing properties and can preserve the nutrition and flavor of food for a long time.

管子.zh: 工人们正在仔细检查地下埋设的排水管子，确保雨季排水畅通。
管子.py: Gōngrénmen zhèngzài zǐxì jiǎnchá dìxià máishè de páishuǐ guǎnzi, quèbǎo yǔjì páishuǐ chàngtōng.
管子.en: The workers are carefully inspecting the underground drainage pipes to ensure smooth drainage during the rainy season.

国庆节.zh: 每年国庆节期间，全国各大旅游景区都会迎来客流高峰。
国庆节.py: Měinián Guóqìngjié qījiān, quánguó gè dà lǚyóu jǐngqū dōu huì yínglái kèliú gāofēng.
国庆节.en: During the National Day holiday each year, major tourist attractions across the country welcome a peak in visitor traffic.

雇佣.zh: 该企业为了提升研发实力，决定在海内外雇佣一批经验丰富的高端人才。
雇佣.py: Gāi qǐyè wèile tíshēng yánfā shílì, juédìng zài hǎinèiwài gùyōng yì pī jīngyàn fēngfù de gāoduān réncái.
雇佣.en: In order to enhance its R&D capabilities, the enterprise decided to hire a group of experienced, top-tier talents both domestically and abroad.

皇后.zh: 故宫中保存着许多清代皇后的华丽服饰与珍贵珠宝首饰。
皇后.py: Gùgōng zhōng bǎocún zhe xǔduō Qīng dài huánghòu de huálì fúshì yǔ zhēnguì zhūbǎo shǒushi.
皇后.en: The Forbidden City preserves many magnificent costumes and precious jewelry belonging to empresses of the Qing dynasty.

慌张.zh: 即使考卷上的题目出乎意料，他也表现得十分从容，丝毫没有慌张。
慌张.py: Jíshǐ kǎojuàn shang de tímù chūhūyìliào, tā yě biǎoxiàn de shífēn cōngróng, sīháo méiyǒu huāngzhāng.
慌张.en: Even though the questions on the exam paper were unexpected, he remained completely calm without feeling flustered at all.

华裔.zh: 这位华裔建筑设计师将东方美学与现代高层建筑完美融为一体。
华裔.py: Zhè wèi huáyì jiànzhù shèjìshī jiāng dōngfāng měixué yǔ xiàndài gāocéng jiànzhù wánměi róng wéi yītǐ.
华裔.en: This Chinese-descent architect seamlessly integrated Eastern aesthetics with modern high-rise architecture.

煎.zh: 厨师用文火慢慢把牛排煎至两面金黄，肉质依旧鲜嫩多汁。
煎.py: Chúshī yòng wénhuǒ mànmàn bǎ niúpái jiān zhì liǎng miàn jīnhuáng, ròuzhì yījiù xiānnèn duōzhī.
煎.en: The chef gently pan-fried the steak over low heat until golden brown on both sides, while the meat remained tender and juicy.

夹子.zh: 她用一个精致的金属夹子把整理好的复习资料夹得整整齐齐。
夹子.py: Tā yòng yí gè jīngzhì de jīnshǔ jiāzi bǎ zhěnglǐ hǎo de fùxí zīliào jiā de zhěngzhěng-qíqí.
夹子.en: She used a delicate metal clip to neatly bundle the organized review materials together.

解说员.zh: 体育解说员语速飞快而清晰，把比赛紧张激烈的气氛烘托得淋漓尽致。
解说员.py: Tǐyù jiěshuōyuán yǔsù fēikuài ér qīngxī, bǎ bǐsài jǐnzhāng jīliè de qìfēn hōngtuō de línlí-jìnzhì.
解说员.en: The sports commentator spoke rapidly and clearly, bringing out the intense and thrilling atmosphere of the match vividly.

敬爱.zh: 张教授治学严谨且乐于提携后辈，深受全系青年学者的敬爱。
敬爱.py: Zhāng jiàoshòu zhìxué yánjǐn qiě lèyú tíxié hòubèi, shēn shòu quán xì qīngnián xuézhě de jìng'ài.
敬爱.en: Professor Zhang is rigorous in scholarship and always keen to mentor young colleagues, deeply respected and loved by young scholars across the department.

桔子.zh: 秋末冬初正是桔子成熟的季节，果园里挂满了金灿灿的果实。
桔子.py: Qiū mò dōng chū zhèng shì júzi chéngshú de jìjié, guǒyuán lǐ guà mǎn le jīncàncàn de guǒshí.
桔子.en: Late autumn and early winter is the ripening season for tangerines, and the orchards are laden with golden fruit.

刻苦.zh: 只有经过日复一日的刻苦训练，运动员才能在国际赛场上争金夺银。
刻苦.py: Zhǐyǒu jīngguò rìfùyírì de kèkǔ xùnliàn, yùndòngyuán cái néng zài guójì sàichǎng shang zhēng jīn duó yín.
刻苦.en: Only through day after day of assiduous training can athletes compete for gold and silver on the international stage.

立方.zh: 这座新建的水库有效库容达到了数千万立方米，极大地改善了周边灌溉条件。
立方.py: Zhè zuò xīnjiàn de shuǐkù yǒuxiào kùróng dádào le shù qiānwàn lìfāngmǐ, jídà de gǎishàn le zhōubiān guàngài tiáojiàn.
立方.en: The effective capacity of this newly built reservoir has reached tens of millions of cubic meters, greatly improving surrounding irrigation conditions.

零件.zh: 机械设备装配时必须严格把关，任何一个劣质零件都可能酿成严重事故。
零件.py: Jīxiè shèbèi zhuāngpèi shí bìxū yángé bǎguān, rènhé yí gè lièzhì língjiàn dōu kěnéng niàngchéng yánzhòng shìgù.
零件.en: When assembling mechanical equipment, strict quality control is mandatory, as any substandard part could lead to a serious accident.

谜语.zh: 老师在课堂上出了一个有趣的谜语，同学们争先恐后地举手竞猜。
谜语.py: Lǎoshī zài kètáng shang chū le yí gè yǒuqù de míyǔ, tóngxuémen zhēngxiān-kǒnghòu de jǔshǒu jìngcāi.
谜语.en: The teacher posed an intriguing riddle in class, and the students vied with one another to raise their hands and guess.

嫩.zh: 春雨过后，刚破土而出的竹笋质地格外鲜嫩脆爽。
嫩.py: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, gāng pòtǔ ér chū de zhúsǔn zhìdì géwài xiānnèn cuìshuǎng.
嫩.en: After the spring rain, the bamboo shoots freshly emerging from the soil are extraordinarily tender and crisp.

侵略.zh: 国际公约严厉谴责任何破坏主权国家领土完整与和平发展的侵略行径。
侵略.py: Guójì gōngyuē yánlì qiǎnzé rènhé pòhuài zhǔquán guójiā lǐngtǔ wánzhěng yǔ hépíng fāzhǎn de qīnlüè xíngjìng.
侵略.en: International conventions sternly condemn any aggressive actions that undermine the territorial integrity and peaceful development of sovereign states.

嚷.zh: 会议室里正在讨论严肃方案，请大家不要在走廊里大声叫嚷。
嚷.py: Huìyìshì lǐ zhèngzài tǎolùn yánsù fāng'àn, qǐng dàjiā bùyào zài zǒuláng lǐ dàshēng jiàorǎng.
嚷.en: A serious proposal is being discussed in the conference room; everyone please refrain from shouting loudly in the hallway.

省略.zh: 在口语交际中，说话人常会为了简明扼要而省略某些已知的信息。
省略.py: Zài kǒuyǔ jiāojì zhōng, shuōhuàrén cháng huì wèile jiǎnmíng-èyào ér shěnglüè mǒuxiē yǐzhī de xìnxī.
省略.en: In spoken communication, speakers often omit certain already known information for the sake of conciseness.

使劲儿.zh: 陷在泥潭里的轮子打滑严重，几个年轻人齐心协力使劲儿推才脱离险境。
使劲儿.py: Xiàn zài nítán lǐ de lúnzi dǎhuá yánzhòng, jǐ gè qīngniánrén qíxīn-xiélì shǐjìnr tuī cái tuōlí xiǎnjìng.
使劲儿.en: The wheel stuck in the mud was slipping badly, and several young people pushed with all their might together before getting it out of trouble.

甩.zh: 奔跑冲过终点线的那一瞬间，他兴奋地把手中的毛巾用力甩向空中。
甩.py: Bēnpǎo chōngguò zhōngdiǎnxiàn de nà yí shùnjiān, tā xīngfèn de bǎ shǒuzhōng de máojīn yònglì shuǎi xiàng kōngzhōng.
甩.en: The moment he sprinted across the finish line, he excitedly swung the towel in his hand up into the air.

撕.zh: 整理旧文件时，她把不再需要的草稿纸撕碎后扔进了废纸篓。
撕.py: Zhěnglǐ jiù wénjiàn shí, tā bǎ bù zài xūyào de cǎogǎozhǐ sī suì hòu rēng jìn le fèizhǐlǒu.
撕.en: While sorting through old documents, she tore up the scratch papers that were no longer needed and threw them into the wastebasket.

太极拳.zh: 练习太极拳不仅能够增强体质，更能帮助现代人在忙碌之余平心静气。
太极拳.py: Liànxí tàijíquán bùjǐn nénggòu zēngqiáng tǐzhì, gèng néng bāngzhù xiàndàirén zài mánglù zhīyú píngxīn-jìngqì.
太极拳.en: Practicing Tai Chi not only strengthens physical health, but also helps modern people find inner calm amidst busy lives.

提纲.zh: 写毕业论文之前，导师要求我们必须先提交一份框架清晰的研究提纲。
提纲.py: Xiě bìyè lùnwén zhīqián, dǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen bìxū xiān tíjiāo yí fèn kuàngjià qīngxī de yánjiū tígāng.
提纲.en: Before writing our graduation thesis, our advisor required us to submit a research outline with a clear framework first.

退步.zh: 这学期他由于沉迷网络游戏，学习成绩出现了明显的退步。
退步.py: Zhè xuéqī tā yóuyú chénmí wǎngluò yóuxì, xuéxí chéngjì chūxiàn le míngxiǎn de tuìbù.
退步.en: Because he was addicted to online games this semester, his academic performance showed a noticeable decline.

推辞.zh: 老领导诚挚邀请他出席行业峰会，他实在盛情难却，不便推辞。
推辞.py: Lǎo lǐngdǎo chéngzhì yāoqǐng tā chūxí hángyè fēnghuì, tā shízài shèngqíng nán què, búbiàn tuīcí.
推辞.en: His former leader sincerely invited him to attend the industry summit; overwhelmed by such warmth, he found it awkward to decline.

吻.zh: 离开家门前，母亲轻轻在熟睡的婴儿额头上留下了一个吻。
吻.py: Líkāi jiāmén qián, mǔqīn qīngqīng zài shúshuì de yīng'ér étóu shang liúxià le yí gè wěn.
吻.en: Before leaving home, the mother gently planted a kiss on her sleeping infant's forehead.

瞎.zh: 遇到疑难技术问题时要依据数据排查，决不能凭空瞎猜。
瞎.py: Yù dào yínán jìshù wèntí shí yào yījù shùjù páichá, jué bùnéng píngkōng xiā cāi.
瞎.en: When encountering tricky technical problems, one must troubleshoot based on data rather than making wild guesses.

幸亏.zh: 暴雨突降，幸亏我们随身带了雨具，才没有被淋湿。
幸亏.py: Bàoyǔ tū jiàng, xìngkuī wǒmen suíshēn dài le yǔjù, cái méiyǒu bèi línshī.
幸亏.en: A rainstorm suddenly broke out; fortunately, we had brought rain gear with us, so we didn't get soaked.

油炸.zh: 长期食用高温油炸的高热量食品不利于保持健康的心血管机能。
油炸.py: Chángqī shíyòng gāowēn yóuzhá de gāo rèliàng shípǐn bù lìyú bǎochí jiànkāng de xīnxuěguān jīnéng.
油炸.en: Consuming high-calorie foods deep-fried at high temperatures over long periods is detrimental to maintaining healthy cardiovascular function.

则.zh: 哥哥性格沉稳内敛，喜欢阅读思考；弟弟则活泼好动，热爱户外探险。
则.py: Gēge xìnggé chénwěn nèiliǎn, xǐhuan yuèdú sīkǎo; dìdi zé huópo hàodòng, rè'ài hùwài tànxiǎn.
则.en: The older brother is composed and reserved, fond of reading and contemplation; the younger brother, on the other hand, is lively and energetic, loving outdoor adventures.

嘱咐.zh: 临行前，母亲拉着他的手再三嘱咐在异国他乡要保重身体。
嘱咐.py: Línxíng qián, mǔqīn lā zhe tā de shǒu zàisān zhǔfù zài yìguó tāxiāng yào bǎozhòng shēntǐ.
嘱咐.en: Prior to departure, his mother held his hand and repeatedly enjoined him to take good care of his health in a foreign land.

罪犯.zh: 刑警经过数月排查与技术追踪，终于在边境地区将潜逃多年的罪犯抓获。
罪犯.py: Xíngjǐng jīngguò shù yuè páichá yǔ jìshù zhuīzōng, zhōngyú zài biānjìng dìqū jiāng qiántáo duō nián de zuìfàn zhuāhuò.
罪犯.en: After months of investigation and technical tracking, criminal detectives finally apprehended the criminal who had been on the run for years in the border region.

呵.zh: 严冬的清晨寒气逼人，环卫工人常常对着冻僵的双手呵一口热气。
呵.py: Yándōng de qīngchén hánqì bīrén, huánwèi gōngrén chángcháng duìzhe dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu hē yì kǒu rèqì.
呵.en: On freezing winter mornings when the chill was biting, sanitation workers often exhaled a breath of warm air onto their numb hands.

爱戴.zh: 这位老教授不仅学术造诣深厚，而且关怀爱护学生，赢得了全校师生的衷心爱戴。
爱戴.py: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu bùjǐn xuéshù zàoyì shēnhòu, érqiě guānhuái àihù xuéshēng, yíngdé le quán xiào shīshēng de zhōngxīn àidài.
爱戴.en: This veteran professor not only possesses profound academic attainments but also cares deeply for his students, winning the heartfelt love and esteem of teachers and students across the university.

哎哟.zh: “哎哟，我的脚踝扭到了，疼得站不起来！”他痛苦地叫道。
哎哟.py: "Āiyō, wǒ de jiǎohuái niǔ dào le, téng de zhàn bù qǐlái!" tā tòngkǔ de jiàodào.
哎哟.en: "Ouch, I twisted my ankle, it hurts so much I can't stand up!" he cried in pain.

安详.zh: 老艺术家安详地坐在公园长椅上，静静聆听着树枝间清脆的鸟鸣。
安详.py: Lǎo yìshùjiā ānxiáng de zuò zài gōngyuán chángyǐ shang, jìngjìng língtīng zhe shùzhī jiān qīngcuì de niǎomíng.
安详.en: The elderly artist sat serenely on the park bench, quietly listening to the crisp birdsong among the branches.

熬.zh: 面对创业初期的重重艰辛，团队咬紧牙关，终于熬过了资金匮乏的困境。
熬.py: Miànduì chuàngyè chūqī de zhòngzhòng jiānxīn, tuánduì yǎojǐn yáguān, zhōngyú áoguò le zījīn kuìfá de kùnjìng.
熬.en: Facing manifold hardships in the early stages of entrepreneurship, the team gritted their teeth and finally endured through the predicament of capital shortage.

奥秘.zh: 天体物理学家借助深空探测望远镜，一步步揭开黑洞形成的奥秘。
奥秘.py: Tiāntǐ wùlǐ xuéjiā jièzhù shēnkōng tàncè wàngyuǎnjìng, yíbùbù jiēkāi hēidòng xíngchéng de àomì.
奥秘.en: With the help of deep-space exploration telescopes, astrophysicists are unraveling step by step the mysteries of black hole formation.

凹凸.zh: 越野车在凹凸不平的山间碎石路上颠簸前行，车速十分缓慢。
凹凸.py: Yuèyěchē zài āotū-bùpíng de shānjiān suìshílù shang diānbǒ qiánxíng, chēsù shífēn huǎnmàn.
凹凸.en: The off-road vehicle bumped along the uneven gravel road in the mountains at a very slow pace.

扒.zh: 厨师利落地把烤熟的板栗外壳扒开，露出里面金黄香甜的果肉。
扒.py: Chúshī lìluo de bǎ kǎoshú de bǎnlì wàiké bā kāi, lùchū lǐmiàn jīnhuáng xiāngtián de guǒròu.
扒.en: The chef deftly peeled open the shells of the roasted chestnuts, revealing the golden, sweet nuts inside.

疤.zh: 尽管手术后留下了一道浅浅的疤，但他的身体已经完全康复了。
疤.py: Jǐnguǎn shǒushù hòu liúxià le yí dào qiǎnqiǎn de bā, dàn tā de shēntǐ yǐjīng wánquán kāngfù le.
疤.en: Although a faint scar was left after the surgery, he has made a full recovery.

巴不得.zh: 经过连续几个月的加班，他巴不得立刻休假去海边放松几天。
巴不得.py: Jīngguò liánxù jǐ ge yuè de jiābān, tā bā bu de lìkè xiūjià qù hǎibiān fàngsōng jǐ tiān.
巴不得.en: After months of continuous overtime, he can hardly wait to take some time off and relax by the sea.

霸道.zh: 他在团队讨论中态度非常霸道，从不给其他人表达意见的机会。
霸道.py: Tā zài tuánduì tǎolùn zhōng tàidù fēicháng bàdào, cóngbù gěi qítā rén biǎodá yìjiàn de jīhuì.
霸道.en: His attitude during team discussions was very domineering, never giving others a chance to voice their opinions.

掰.zh: 奶奶把刚蒸好的玉米掰成两半，递给了身旁的孩子。
掰.py: Nǎinai bǎ gāng zhēng hǎo de yùmǐ bāi chéng liǎng bàn, dì gěi le shēnpáng de háizi.
掰.en: Grandma broke the freshly steamed corn in half and handed it to the child beside her.

败坏.zh: 这种弄虚作假的行为严重败坏了公司的商业信誉。
败坏.py: Zhè zhǒng nòngxū-zuòjiǎ de xíngwéi yánzhòng bàihuài le gōngsī de shāngyè xìnyù.
败坏.en: Such fraudulent behavior has severely damaged the company's commercial reputation.

巴结.zh: 他为人正直，向来不屑于通过巴结领导来获得升迁。
巴结.py: Tā wéirén zhèngzhí, xiànglái bùxiè yú tōngguò bājie lǐngdǎo lái huòdé shēngqiān.
巴结.en: He is an upright person who has always disdained currying favor with leaders to get a promotion.

颁布.zh: 政府近期颁布了一系列支持新能源产业发展的新政策。
颁布.py: Zhèngfǔ jìnqī bānbù le yí xìliè zhīchí xīn néngyuán chǎnyè fāzhǎn de xīn zhèngcè.
颁布.en: The government recently promulgated a series of new policies supporting the development of the new energy industry.

磅.zh: 这件托运行李重约五十磅，刚好符合航空公司的免费托运标准。
磅.py: Zhè jiàn tuōyùn xíngli zhòng yuē wǔshí bàng, gānghǎo fúhé hángkōng gōngsī de miǎnfèi tuōyùn biāozhǔn.
磅.en: This checked baggage weighs about fifty pounds, just meeting the airline's free allowance limit.

绑架.zh: 警方经过周密侦查，成功解救了被绑架的人质并抓获了嫌疑人。
绑架.py: Jǐngfāng jīngguò zhōumì zhēnchá, chénggōng jiějiù le bèi bǎngjià de rénzhì bìng zhuāhuò le xiányírén.
绑架.en: Following a thorough investigation, the police successfully rescued the kidnapped hostage and arrested the suspect.

斑纹.zh: 斑马身上独特的黑白斑纹能够有效迷惑捕食者的视线。
斑纹.py: Bānmǎ shēnshang dútè de hēibái bānwén nénggòu yǒuxiào míhuo bǔshízhě de shìxiàn.
斑纹.en: The unique black-and-white stripes on a zebra can effectively confuse the vision of predators.

包庇.zh: 无论职位多高，任何包庇违法犯罪分子的行为都必将受到法律严惩。
包庇.py: Wúlùn zhíwèi duō gāo, rènhé bāobì wéifǎ fànzuì fènzǐ de xíngwéi dōu bìjiāng shòudào fǎlǜ yánchěng.
包庇.en: No matter how high one's rank, any act of harboring criminals will surely be severely punished by law.

包袱.zh: 我们要放下沉重的思想包袱，以积极的心态迎接新的挑战。
包袱.py: Wǒmen yào fàngxià chénzhòng de sīxiǎng bāofu, yǐ jījí de xīntài yíngjiē xīn de tiǎozhàn.
包袱.en: We need to shed our heavy mental baggage and embrace new challenges with a positive mindset.

报复.zh: 面对竞争对手的恶意攻击，他选择依法维权，而不是采取报复手段。
报复.py: Miànduì jìngzhēng duìshǒu de èyì gōngjī, tā xuǎnzé yīfǎ wéiquán, ér bú shì cǎiqǔ bàofù shǒuduàn.
报复.en: Faced with malicious attacks from a competitor, he chose to defend his rights legally rather than resort to retaliation.

曝光.zh: 这家餐厅的卫生问题被媒体曝光后，相关部门立即介入调查并责令整改。
曝光.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng de wèishēng wèntí bèi méitǐ bàoguāng hòu, xiāngguān bùmén lìjí jièrù diàochá bìng zélìng zhěnggǎi.
曝光.en: After the restaurant's hygiene issues were exposed by the media, relevant departments immediately launched an investigation and ordered rectifications.

饱和.zh: 本地手机市场已经趋于饱和，厂商必须开拓海外新兴市场来寻求增长。
饱和.py: Běndì shǒujī shìchǎng yǐjīng qūyú bǎohé, chǎngshāng bìxū kāituò hǎiwài xīnxīng shìchǎng lái xúnqiú zēngzhǎng.
饱和.en: The local smartphone market has reached saturation, forcing manufacturers to explore emerging overseas markets to pursue growth.

保姆.zh: 夫妻俩平时工作繁忙，特意请了一位富有经验的保姆来照看孩子。
保姆.py: Fūqī liǎ píngshí gōngzuò fánmáng, tèyì qǐng le yí wèi fùyǒu jīngyàn de bǎomǔ lái zhàokàn háizi.
保姆.en: Since the couple are both busy with work, they specially hired an experienced nanny to look after their child.

悲哀.zh: 听到老朋友不幸遇难的消息，大家心中充满了悲哀与不舍。
悲哀.py: Tīngdào lǎo péngyou búxìng yùnàn de xiāoxi, dàjiā xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le bēi'āi yǔ bùshě.
悲哀.en: Hearing the tragic news of their old friend's death, everyone's hearts were filled with deep sorrow and grief.

备忘录.zh: 两国代表在会晤后正式签署了深化经贸合作的谅解备忘录。
备忘录.py: Liǎng guó dàibiǎo zài huìwù hòu zhèngshì qiānshǔ le shēnhuà jīng-mào hézuò de liàngjiě bèiwànglù.
备忘录.en: Following the meeting, representatives of both countries formally signed a memorandum of understanding to deepen economic and trade cooperation.

奔波.zh: 为了给贫困山区的学校筹集图书，他连续数月在多座城市间奔波。
奔波.py: Wèile gěi pínkùn shānqū de xuéxiào chóují túshū, tā liánxù shù yuè zài duō zuò chéngshì jiān bēnbō.
奔波.en: To raise books for schools in impoverished mountain areas, he spent months rushing between several cities.

奔驰.zh: 一群矫健的骏马在辽阔的草原上自由自在地奔驰。
奔驰.py: Yì qún jiǎojiàn de jùnmǎ zài liáokuò de cǎoyuán shang zìyóu-zìzài de bēnchí.
奔驰.en: A herd of spirited horses galloped freely across the vast grasslands.

甭.zh: 这点小事你甭放在心上，朋友之间互相帮忙是理所应当的。
甭.py: Zhè diǎn xiǎoshì nǐ béng fàng zài xīn shang, péngyou zhī jiān hùxiāng bāngmáng shì lǐsuǒyīngdāng de.
甭.en: Don't take such a small matter to heart; friends should naturally help one another.

蹦.zh: 小狗看见主人推门进屋，兴奋地在玄关处又蹦又跳。
蹦.py: Xiǎogǒu kànjiàn zhǔrén tuīmén jìn wū, xīngfèn de zài xuánguān chù yòu bèng yòu tiào.
蹦.en: Seeing its owner push the door open and enter, the puppy jumped and bounced excitedly in the entryway.

迸发.zh: 在热烈的头脑风暴中，团队成员迸发出了许多极具创意的想法。
迸发.py: Zài rèliè de tóunǎo fēngbào zhōng, tuánduì chéngyuán bèngfā chū le xǔduō jí jù chuàngyì de xiǎngfǎ.
迸发.en: During the lively brainstorming session, team members burst forth with many highly creative ideas.

本钱.zh: 常言道身体是革命的本钱，工作再忙也要留出时间锻炼和休息。
本钱.py: Chángyándào shēntǐ shì gémìng de běnqián, gōngzuò zài máng yě yào liúchū shíjiān duànliàn hé xiūxi.
本钱.en: As the saying goes, good health is the foundation of success; no matter how busy you are, you must make time to exercise and rest.

本着.zh: 双方本着平等互利的原则，达成了长期稳定的战略合作关系。
本着.py: Shuāngfāng běnzhe píngděng hùlì de yuánzé, dáchéng le chángqī wěndìng de zhànlüè hézuò guānxì.
本着.en: Adhering to the principle of equality and mutual benefit, both parties established a long-term, stable strategic partnership.

笨拙.zh: 初学陶艺时他的动作显得有些笨拙，但经过反复练习后手法变得灵活多了。
笨拙.py: Chūxué táoyì shí tā de dòngzuò xiǎnde yǒuxiē bènzhuō, dàn jīngguò fǎnfù liànxí hòu shǒufǎ biànde línghuó duō le.
笨拙.en: When he first learned pottery, his movements appeared somewhat clumsy, but after repeated practice, his technique became much more agile.

臂.zh: 关键时刻，老工程师的指点助了他们一臂之力，使项目难题迎刃而解。
臂.py: Guānjiàn shíkè, lǎo gōngchéngshī de zhǐdiǎn zhù le tāmen yí bì zhī lì, shǐ xiàngmù nántí yíngrèn'érjiě.
臂.en: At the critical moment, the senior engineer's guidance lent them a helping hand, solving the project's difficult issues smoothly.

遍布.zh: 这家便利店的分店如今已遍布城市各个主要社区和商业街区。
遍布.py: Zhè jiā biànlìdiàn de fēndiàn rújīn yǐ biànbù chéngshì gège zhǔyào shèqū hé shāngyè jiēqū.
遍布.en: Branches of this convenience store are now spread across every major neighborhood and commercial district in the city.

变故.zh: 面对家中突如其来的变故，他迅速成熟起来并挑起了生活的重担。
变故.py: Miànduì jiā zhōng tūrúqílái de biàngù, tā xùnsù chéngshú qǐlai bìng tiāoqǐ le shēnghuó de zhòngdàn.
变故.en: Faced with sudden misfortunes in his family, he matured rapidly and took on the heavy burdens of life.

边疆.zh: 许多年轻人在大学毕业后主动奔赴祖国边疆，投身于基层的支教事业。
边疆.py: Xǔduō niánqīngrén zài dàxué bìyè hòu zhǔdòng bēnfù zǔguó biānjiāng, tóushēn yú jīcéng de zhījiào shìyè.
边疆.en: After graduating from university, many young people volunteered to head to the nation's frontier regions to dedicate themselves to grassroots volunteer teaching.

辩解.zh: 面对确凿的证据，他没有再为自己的过错辩解，而是诚恳地接受了批评。
辩解.py: Miànduì quèzáo de zhèngjù, tā méiyǒu zài wèi zìjǐ de guòcuò biànjiě, ér shì chéngkěn de jiēshòu le pīpíng.
辩解.en: In the face of conclusive evidence, he did not offer any further excuses for his mistake, but instead sincerely accepted the criticism.

变迁.zh: 这座陈列馆收藏的老照片生动记录了这座老工业城市数十年的沧桑变迁。
变迁.py: Zhè zuò chénlièguǎn shōucáng de lǎo zhàopiàn shēngdòng jìlù le zhè zuò lǎo gōngyè chéngshì shùshí nián de cāngsāng biànqiān.
变迁.en: The old photographs kept in this exhibition hall vividly record the decades of vicissitudes and transformations of this old industrial city.

辨认.zh: 由于常年风吹雨淋，古城墙石碑上的字迹已经模糊得难以辨认。
辨认.py: Yóuyú chángnián fēngchuī-yǔlín, gǔ chéngqiáng shíbēi shang de zìjì yǐjīng móhu de nányǐ biànrèn.
辨认.en: Due to years of exposure to wind and rain, the inscriptions on the ancient city wall's stone stele have become too blurred to decipher.

贬义.zh: 在现代汉语中，这个词往往带有明显的贬义，在正式商务写作中应避免使用。
贬义.py: Zài xiàndài Hànyǔ zhōng, zhè ge cí wǎngwǎng dàiyǒu míngxiǎn de biǎnyì, zài zhèngshì shāngwù xiězuò zhōng yīng bìmiǎn shǐyòng.
贬义.en: In modern Chinese, this word often carries a clear negative connotation and should be avoided in formal business writing.

辩证.zh: 我们应当辩证地看待人工智能的发展，既要看到它的效率，也要防范其风险。
辩证.py: Wǒmen yīngdāng biànzhèng de kàndài réngōng zhìnéng de fāzhǎn, jì yào kàndào tā de xiàolǜ, yě yào fángfàn qí fēngxiǎn.
辩证.en: We should take a dialectical view of the development of artificial intelligence, acknowledging its efficiency while guarding against potential risks.

编织.zh: 手艺人凭借灵巧的双手，用细竹篾编织出各式各样精美的生活用品。
编织.py: Shǒuyìrén píngjiè língqiǎo de shuāngshǒu, yòng xì zhúmiè biānzhī chū gèshì-gèyàng jīngměi de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
编织.en: With deft hands, the craftsman wove thin bamboo strips into a variety of exquisite everyday household items.

标本.zh: 这座自然历史博物馆里陈列着上万件珍贵的植物和昆虫标本。
标本.py: Zhè zuò zìrán lìshǐ bówùguǎn lǐ chénliè zhe shàng wàn jiàn zhēnguì de zhíwù hé kūnchóng biāoběn.
标本.en: This natural history museum displays tens of thousands of precious plant and insect specimens.

标记.zh: 地质队员在勘探地图上清晰地标记出了地下水源和矿藏的分布位置。
标记.py: Dìzhì duìyuán zài kāntàn dìtú shang qīngxī de biāojì chū le dìxià shuǐyuán hé kuàngcáng de fēnbù wèizhi.
标记.en: The geological team clearly marked the locations of underground water sources and mineral deposits on the exploration map.

表决.zh: 经过数小时的充分讨论，理事会全体成员举手表决通过了这项决议。
表决.py: Jīngguò shù xiǎoshí de chōngfèn tǎolùn, lǐshìhuì quántǐ chéngyuán jǔshǒu biǎojué tōngguò le zhè xiàng juéyì.
表决.en: After several hours of thorough discussion, all council members voted by a show of hands to pass the resolution.

飙升.zh: 受极端严寒天气影响，当地对天然气等取暖资源的需求量和价格双双飙升。
飙升.py: Shòu jíduān yánhán tiānqì yǐngxiǎng, dāngdì duì tiānránqì děng qǔnuǎn zīyuán de xūqiúliàng hé jiàgé shuāngshuāng biāoshēng.
飙升.en: Due to the extreme cold weather, both local demand and prices for heating resources like natural gas have skyrocketed.

表态.zh: 面对媒体关于公司业务重组的传闻，管理层目前尚未对此公开表态。
表态.py: Miànduì méitǐ guānyú gōngsī yèwù chóngzǔ de chuánwén, guǎnlǐcéng mùqián shàngwèi duì cǐ gōngkāi biǎotài.
表态.en: In response to media rumors regarding corporate restructuring, the management has not yet made a public statement on the matter.

表彰.zh: 在年终总结表彰大会上，多位技术骨干因卓越的科研贡献受到了公开表彰。
表彰.py: Zài niánzhōng zǒngjié biǎozhāng dàhuì shang, duō wèi jìshù gǔgàn yīn zhuóyuè de kēyán gòngxiàn shòudào le gōngkāi biǎozhāng.
表彰.en: At the year-end commendation conference, several core technical personnel were publicly commended for their outstanding research contributions.

弊病.zh: 传统的人才选拔机制存在过于看重学历的弊病，亟须进一步推行改革。
弊病.py: Chuántǒng de réncái xuǎnbá jīzhì cúnzài guòyú kànzhòng xuélì de bìbìng, jíxū jìnyíbù tuīxíng gǎigé.
弊病.en: Traditional talent selection mechanisms suffer from the drawback of overemphasizing academic credentials and urgently require further reform.

弊端.zh: 数字化办公系统的上线，彻底根除了过去审批流程冗长繁琐的弊端。
弊端.py: Shùzìhuà bàngōng xìtǒng de shàngxiàn, chèdǐ gēnchú le guòqù shěnpī liúchéng rǒngcháng fánsuǒ de bìduān.
弊端.en: The launch of the digital office system thoroughly eliminated the drawbacks of lengthy and cumbersome approval processes of the past.

憋.zh: 他心里有许多委屈，但为了顾全大局一直硬憋着没向大家吐露。
憋.py: Tā xīnli yǒu xǔduō wěiqu, dàn wèile gùquándàjú yìzhí yìng biē zhe méi xiàng dàjiā tǔlù.
憋.en: He felt wronged in many ways, but in order to preserve the big picture, he kept bottling it up and didn't confide in anyone.

别扭.zh: 自从上次发生争执后，他们俩在办公室碰面时总觉得气氛有些别扭。
别扭.py: Zìcóng shàng cì fāshēng zhēngzhí hòu, tāmen liǎ zài bàngōngshì pèngmiàn shí zǒng juéde qìfēn yǒuxiē bièniu.
别扭.en: Ever since their last argument, whenever the two ran into each other at the office, the atmosphere felt rather awkward.

别致.zh: 这家书店的室内设计风格十分别致，将复古工业风与绿色植被巧妙融为一体。
别致.py: Zhè jiā shūdiàn de shìnèi shèjì fēnggé shífēn biézhì, jiāng fùgǔ gōngyè fēng yǔ lǜsè zhíbèi qiǎomiào róng wéi yītǐ.
别致.en: The interior design of this bookstore is very unique and chic, cleverly blending retro industrial aesthetics with lush greenery.

并存.zh: 在当下的全球经贸环境中，机遇与挑战并存，唯有开拓创新才能赢得主动。
并存.py: Zài dāngxià de quánqiú jīng-mào huánjìng zhōng, jīyù yǔ tiǎozhàn bìngcún, wéiyǒu kāituò chuàngxīn cái néng yíngdé zhǔdòng.
并存.en: In today's global economic and trade climate, opportunities and challenges coexist; only through pioneering innovation can one seize the initiative.

并非.zh: 掌握一门外语并非一朝一夕之功，需要持之以恒的积累与不断练习。
并非.py: Zhǎngwò yì mén wàiyǔ bìngfēi yìzhāo-yīxī zhī gōng, xūyào chízhīyǐhéng de jīlěi yǔ búduàn liànxí.
并非.en: Mastering a foreign language is by no means an overnight feat; it requires persistent accumulation and continuous practice.

濒临.zh: 由于生态环境恶化和盗猎屡禁不止，许多稀有物种已经濒临灭绝。
濒临.py: Yóuyú shēngtài huánjìng èhuà hé dàoliè lǚjìnbùzhǐ, xǔduō xīyǒu wùzhǒng yǐjīng bīnlín mièjué.
濒临.en: Due to ecological degradation and rampant poaching, many rare species are now on the verge of extinction.

逼迫.zh: 在严峻的经济形势逼迫下，许多传统企业不得不加快转型步伐。
逼迫.py: Zài yánjùn de jīngjì xíngshì bīpò xià, xǔduō chuántǒng qǐyè bùdébù jiākuài zhuǎnxíng bùfá.
逼迫.en: Compelled by the grim economic situation, many traditional enterprises have had to accelerate the pace of their transformation.

闭塞.zh: 这座偏远的山村过去交通十分闭塞，直到修通公路后才与外界建立联系。
闭塞.py: Zhè zuò piānyuǎn de shāncūn guòqù jiāotōng shífēn bìsè, zhídào xiūtōng gōnglù hòu cái yǔ wàijiè jiànlì liánxì.
闭塞.en: Transportation to this remote mountain village used to be extremely cut off, and it only connected with the outside world after a highway was built.

鼻涕.zh: 他感冒得很厉害，不仅咳嗽发烧，还不停地流鼻涕。
鼻涕.py: Tā gǎnmào de hěn lìhai, bùjǐn késou fāshāo, hái bùtíng de liú bítì.
鼻涕.en: He has a severe cold; not only is he coughing and running a fever, but his nose is also running constantly.

碧玉.zh: 湖水清澈透亮，宛如一块温润的碧玉镶嵌在群山之间。
碧玉.py: Húshuǐ qīngchè tòuliàng, wǎnrú yí kuài wēnrùn de bìyù xiāngqiàn zài qúnshān zhījiān.
碧玉.en: The lake water is crystal clear, resembling a piece of warm green jasper embedded among the rolling hills.

博大精深.zh: 中华传统文化博大精深，吸引了世界各地的学者前来深入研究。
博大精深.py: Zhōnghuá chuántǒng wénhuà bódà-jīngshēn, xīyǐn le shìjiè gèdì de xuézhě qiánlái shēnrù yánjiū.
博大精深.en: Traditional Chinese culture is broad and profound, attracting scholars from around the world to conduct in-depth research.

波涛汹涌.zh: 海面上狂风大作，波涛汹涌，所有渔船都接到通知返回港口避风。
波涛汹涌.py: Hǎimiàn shang kuángfēng dàzuò, bōtāo xiōngyǒng, suǒyǒu yúchuán dōu jiēdào tōngzhī fǎnhuí gǎngkǒu bìfēng.
波涛汹涌.en: Fierce winds whipped across the sea, and the surging waves roared, prompting all fishing boats to be called back to port for shelter.

剥削.zh: 这家跨国公司因残酷剥削发展中国家劳工而遭到了舆论的严厉谴责。
剥削.py: Zhè jiā kuàguó gōngsī yīn cánkù bōxuē fāzhǎnzhōng guójiā láogōng ér zāodào le yúlùn de yánlì qiǎnzé.
剥削.en: The multinational corporation faced harsh public condemnation for ruthlessly exploiting laborers in developing countries.

不得已.zh: 迫于生计的压力，他不得已离开家乡，独自前往陌生的大城市打拼。
不得已.py: Pòyú shēngjì de yālì, tā bùdéyǐ líkāi jiāxiāng, dúzì qiánwǎng mòshēng de dà chéngshì dǎpīn.
不得已.en: Under the pressure of making a living, he had no choice but to leave his hometown and strive on his own in an unfamiliar big city.

不堪.zh: 经历了一整天的高强度训练，队员们个个疲惫不堪。
不堪.py: Jīnglì le yì zhěng tiān de gāo qiángdù xùnliàn, duìyuán men gè gè píbèi bùkān.
不堪.en: After a whole day of high-intensity training, every single team member was utterly exhausted.

不愧.zh: 他在危急时刻沉着果断地救下了落水儿童，真不愧是见义勇为的英雄。
不愧.py: Tā zài wēijí shíkè chénzhuó guǒduàn de jiùxià le luòshuǐ értóng, zhēn búkuì shì jiànyì-yǒngwéi de yīngxióng.
不愧.en: Rescuing the drowning child calmly and decisively in a moment of crisis, he truly proved himself worthy of being called a heroic figure.

哺乳.zh: 鲸鱼虽然生活在海洋中，但属于用肺呼吸的哺乳动物。
哺乳.py: Jīngyú suīrán shēnghuó zài hǎiyáng zhōng, dàn shǔyú yòng fèi hūxī de bǔrǔ dòngwù.
哺乳.en: Although whales live in the ocean, they are mammals that breathe with lungs.

部署.zh: 总经理在周例会上详细部署了下一季度的市场推广计划。
部署.py: Zǒngjīnglǐ zài zhōu lìhuì shang xiángxì bùshǔ le xià yí jīdù de shìchǎng tuīguǎng jìhuà.
部署.en: At the weekly meeting, the general manager laid out detailed deployments for the next quarter's marketing plan.

不相上下.zh: 两位棋手的棋艺不相上下，整场决赛厮杀了五个多小时才分出胜负。
不相上下.py: Liǎng wèi qíshǒu de qíyì bù xiāng shàng xià, zhěng chǎng juésài sīshā le wǔ gè duō xiǎoshí cái fēnchū shèngfù.
不相上下.en: The two chess players were equally matched, battling for more than five hours before a winner was finally determined.

不言而喻.zh: 良好的团队合作对于项目的成功来说，其重要性是不言而喻的。
不言而喻.py: Liánghǎo de tuánduì hézuò duìyú xiàngmù de chénggōng lái shuō, qí zhòngyàoxìng shì bù yán ér yù de.
不言而喻.en: For the success of a project, the importance of good teamwork goes without saying.

舱.zh: 飞机进入平飞状态后，舱内的灯光逐渐调暗了下来。
舱.py: Fēijī jìnrù píngfēi zhuàngtài hòu, cāng nèi de dēngguāng zhújiàn tiáo àn le xiàlai.
舱.en: After the airplane reached cruising altitude, the lights inside the cabin were gradually dimmed.

仓促.zh: 这项方案制定得过于仓促，许多潜在的技术风险根本没有考虑到。
仓促.py: Zhè xiàng fāng'àn zhìdìng de guòyú cāngcù, xǔduō qiánzài de jìshù fēngxiǎn gēnběn méiyǒu kǎolǜ dào.
仓促.en: This proposal was drawn up too hastily, and many potential technical risks were not taken into account at all.

残留.zh: 蔬菜在食用前最好多浸泡冲洗，以尽量减少农药残留。
残留.py: Shūcài zài shíyòng qián zuìhǎo duō jìnpào chōngxǐ, yǐ jìnliàng jiǎnshǎo nóngyào cánliú.
残留.en: It is best to soak and rinse vegetables thoroughly before eating to minimize pesticide residues as much as possible.

参谋.zh: 遇到这么重大的决策，你最好找有经验的老前辈帮你参谋一下。
参谋.py: Yùdào zhème zhòngdà de juécè, nǐ zuìhǎo zhǎo yǒu jīngyàn de lǎo qiánbèi bāng nǐ cānmóu yíxià.
参谋.en: When facing such a major decision, you had better consult an experienced veteran to advise you.

参照.zh: 编写新版员工手册时，我们参照了同行业领头羊企业的成功标准。
参照.py: Biānxiě xīnbǎn yuángōng shǒucè shí, wǒmen cānzhào le tóng hángyè lǐngtóuyáng qǐyè de chénggōng biāozhǔn.
参照.en: When compiling the new employee handbook, we referred to the successful standards of industry-leading companies.

草案.zh: 委员会经过数轮激烈的讨论，终于完成了劳动法修正案的初次草案。
草案.py: Wěiyuánhuì jīngguò shù lún jīliè de tǎolùn, zhōngyú wánchéng le láodòngfǎ xiūzhèng'àn de chūcì cǎo'àn.
草案.en: After several rounds of heated discussions, the committee finally completed the initial draft of the labor law amendment.

操劳.zh: 母亲为了抚养我们兄妹几个长大成人，一辈子都在操劳。
操劳.py: Mǔqīn wèile fǔyǎng wǒmen xiōngmèi jǐ gè zhǎngdà chéngrén, yíbèizi dōu zài cāoláo.
操劳.en: Mother toiled all her life in order to raise us siblings into adulthood.

操练.zh: 操场上传来整齐有力的口号声，新兵们正在烈日下加紧操练。
操练.py: Cāochǎng shang chuánlái zhěngqí yǒulì de kǒuhàoshēng, xīnbīng men zhèngzài lièrì xià jiājǐn cāoliàn.
操练.en: Rhythmic and forceful slogans echoed from the parade ground, where new recruits were drilling intensively under the scorching sun.

侧面.zh: 记者从侧面了解到，这两家科技巨头近期确实正在秘密洽谈合并事宜。
侧面.py: Jìzhě cóng cèmiàn liǎojiě dào, zhè liǎng jiā kējì jùtóu jìnqī quèshí zhèngzài mìmì qiàtán hébìng shìyí.
侧面.en: The reporter learned indirectly from side sources that these two tech giants are indeed secretly negotiating a merger.

层出不穷.zh: 随着互联网技术的飞速发展，各种新型网络诈骗手段也层出不穷。
层出不穷.py: Suízhe hùliánwǎng jìshù de fēisù fāzhǎn, gè zhǒng xīnxíng wǎngluò zhàpiàn shǒuduàn yě céng chū bù qióng.
层出不穷.en: With the rapid development of internet technology, various new types of online scam tactics continue to emerge in an endless stream.

岔.zh: 沿着山路走到前面的岔口，往右拐就是通往山顶的近道。
岔.py: Yánzhe shānlù zǒudào qiánmiàn de chàkǒu, wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì tōngwǎng shāndǐng de jìndào.
岔.en: Follow the mountain path to the fork ahead; turning right is the shortcut to the summit.

查获.zh: 海关人员在例行抽检中，成功查获了一批走私的高档电子产品。
查获.py: Hǎiguān rényuán zài lìxíng chōujiǎn zhōng, chénggōng cháhuò le yì pī zǒusī de gāodàng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn.
查获.en: During a routine spot check, customs officers successfully seized a batch of smuggled high-end electronic products.

搀.zh: 老爷爷下楼梯有些吃力，孙子赶紧上前搀着他的手臂。
搀.py: Lǎo yéye xià lóutī yǒuxiē chīlì, sūnzi gǎnjǐn shàngqián chānzhe tā de shǒubì.
搀.en: The grandfather had difficulty walking down the stairs, so his grandson quickly stepped forward to support him by the arm.

馋.zh: 闻到厨房里飘出来的红烧肉香味，弟弟忍不住馋得直流口水。
馋.py: Wéndào chúfáng lǐ piāochūlai de hóngshāoròu xiāngwèi, dìdi rěnbuzhù chán de zhí liú kǒushuǐ.
馋.en: Smelling the braised pork aroma wafting from the kitchen, the younger brother couldn't help drooling with craving.

刹那.zh: 闪电划破夜空的刹那，整座城市都被照得如同白昼。
刹那.py: Shǎndiàn huàpò yèkōng de chànà, zhěng zuò chéngshì dōu bèi zhào de rútóng báizhòu.
刹那.en: In the split second lightning ripped across the night sky, the entire city was illuminated as bright as day.

颤抖.zh: 站在寒风刺骨的雪地里，他的双手忍不住剧烈地颤抖起来。
颤抖.py: Zhàn zài hánfēng cìgǔ de xuědì lǐ, tā de shuāngshǒu rěnbuzhù jùliè de chàndǒu qǐlai.
颤抖.en: Standing in the bone-chilling snowy ground, his hands couldn't help but tremble violently.

猖狂.zh: 警方展开了专项打击行动，狠狠打击了不法分子猖狂的盗窃行为。
猖狂.py: Jǐngfāng zhǎnkāi le zhuānxiàng dǎjī xíngdòng, hěnhěn dǎjī le bùfǎ fènzǐ chāngkuáng de dàoqiè xíngwéi.
猖狂.en: The police launched a special crackdown operation to deal a heavy blow against the rampant theft carried out by unlawful elements.

常务.zh: 他目前担任该学会的常务理事，负责统筹协调每年的学术年会。
常务.py: Tā mùqián dānrèn gāi xuéhuì de chángwù lǐshì, fùzé tǒngchóu xiétiáo měinián de xuéshù niánhuì.
常务.en: He currently serves as the standing director of the academic society, responsible for coordinating the annual academic conference.

倡议.zh: 社区积极响应垃圾分类的倡议，许多居民都自发参与到环保宣传中。
倡议.py: Shèqū jījí xiǎngyìng lājī fēnlèi de chàngyì, xǔduō jūmín dōu zìfā cānyù dào huánbǎo xuānchuán zhōng.
倡议.en: The community actively responded to the waste-sorting initiative, and many residents spontaneously took part in environmental protection campaigns.

缠绕.zh: 院子里的绿萝顺着木架一路向上生长，紧紧地缠绕在栏杆上。
缠绕.py: Yuànzi lǐ de lǜluó shùnzhe mùjià yílù xiàng shàng shēngzhǎng, jǐnjǐn de chánrào zài lángān shang.
缠绕.en: The potted ivy in the courtyard grew all the way up along the wooden trellis, winding tightly around the railing.

阐述.zh: 主讲人在开场白中系统地阐述了该项技术研发的理论基础与应用前景。
阐述.py: Zhǔjiǎngrén zài kāichǎngbái zhōng xìtǒng de chǎnshù le gāi xiàng jìshù yánfā de lǐlùn jīchǔ yǔ yìngyòng qiánjǐng.
阐述.en: In the opening remarks, the keynote speaker systematically elaborated on the theoretical basis and application prospects of this technology's research and development.

诧异.zh: 听到一向沉默寡言的他主动报名参加辩论赛，大家都感到十分诧异。
诧异.py: Tīngdào yíxiàng chénmò-guǎyán de tā zhùdòng bàomíng cānjiā biànlùnsài, dàjiā dōu gǎndào shífēn chàyì.
诧异.en: Hearing that he, normally a man of few words, had voluntarily signed up for the debate competition, everyone was very astonished.

沉淀.zh: 这杯刚泡好的果茶需要静置几分钟，等果肉碎屑自然沉淀到底部。
沉淀.py: Zhè bēi gāng pào hǎo de guǒchá xūyào jìngzhì jǐ fēnzhōng, děng guǒròu suìxiè zìrán chéndiàn dào dǐbù.
沉淀.en: This freshly brewed fruit tea needs to sit undisturbed for a few minutes until the fruit pulp naturally settles to the bottom.

橙.zh: 新鲜剥开的橙子汁水饱满，散发出浓郁清爽的果香。
橙.py: Xīnxiān bōkāi de chéngzi zhīshuǐ bǎomǎn, sànfāchū nóngyù qīngshuǎng de guǒxiāng.
橙.en: The freshly peeled orange was bursting with juice, giving off a rich and refreshing fruity aroma.

秤.zh: 菜市场里的摊主拿起电子秤，准确地为顾客称量刚挑选的新鲜蔬菜。
秤.py: Càishìchǎng lǐ de tānzhǔ náqǐ diànzǐchèng, zhǔnquè de wèi gùkè chēngliáng gāng tiāoxuǎn de xīnxiān shūcài.
秤.en: The vendor in the farmers market picked up the digital scale to accurately weigh the fresh vegetables the customer had just selected.

承包.zh: 这家建筑工程公司承包了城市地铁三号线多个站点的扩建工程。
承包.py: Zhè jiā jiànzhù gōngchéng gōngsī chéngbāo le chéngshì dìtiě sān hào xiàn duō gè zhàndiǎn de kuòjiàn gōngchéng.
承包.en: This construction engineering company contracted the expansion project for multiple stations on the city's Metro Line 3.

成天.zh: 他放暑假后就成天泡在图书馆里，查阅考研所需的专业资料。
成天.py: Tā fàng shǔjià hòu jiù chéngtiān pào zài túshūguǎn lǐ, cháyuè kǎoyán suǒxū de zhuānyè zīliào.
成天.en: Ever since summer vacation started, he has been spending all day long in the library, looking up specialized materials needed for postgraduate entrance exams.

成心.zh: 他绝不是成心打破那个花瓶的，只是一时手滑没拿稳而已。
成心.py: Tā jué bú shì chéngxīn dǎpò nàge huāpíng de, zhǐshì yìshí shǒuhuá méi náwěn éryǐ.
成心.en: He definitely didn't break that vase on purpose; his hand just slipped and he couldn't hold it steady.

陈旧.zh: 厂房里这批陈旧的生产设备不仅能耗极高，而且经常出现故障。
陈旧.py: Chǎngfáng lǐ zhè pī chénjiù de shēngchǎn shèbèi bùjǐn nénghào jí gāo, érqiě jīngcháng chūxiàn gùzhàng.
陈旧.en: This batch of outdated production equipment in the workshop not only consumes huge amounts of energy, but also breaks down frequently.

陈列.zh: 博物馆展厅的玻璃柜里陈列着许多珍贵的古代青铜器。
陈列.py: Bówùguǎn zhǎntīng de bōliguì lǐ chénliè zhe xǔduō zhēnguì de gǔdài qīngtóngqì.
陈列.en: Many precious ancient bronzes are displayed in the glass cases of the museum exhibition hall.

沉闷.zh: 雷雨来临前的午后格外闷热，空气压抑而沉闷，让人透不过气来。
沉闷.py: Léiyǔ láilín qián de wǔhòu géwài mēnrè, kōngqì yāyì ér chénmèn, ràng rén tòubuguò qì lái.
沉闷.en: The afternoon before the thunderstorm was unusually sweltering, and the stifling, heavy air made it hard to breathe.

陈述.zh: 原告律师在法庭上清晰全面地陈述了案发当天的全部经过。
陈述.py: Yuángào lǜshī zài fǎtíng shang qīngxī quánmiàn de chénshù le ànfā dāngtiān de quánbù jīngguò.
陈述.en: The plaintiff's attorney clearly and comprehensively stated the full sequence of events on the day of the incident in court.

沉思.zh: 听完这个尖锐的问题后，专家陷入了短暂的沉思，随后给出了中肯的回答。
沉思.py: Tīngwán zhège jiānruì de wèntí hòu, zhuānjiā xiànrù le duǎnzàn de chénsī, suíhòu gěichū le zhòngkěn de huídá.
沉思.en: After hearing this pointed question, the expert fell into brief contemplation before giving a pertinent response.

沉着.zh: 尽管遭遇突发意外，机长依然沉着冷静地按照应急程序处置险情。
沉着.py: Jǐnguǎn zāoyù tūfā yìwài, jīzhǎng yīrán chénzhuó lěngjìng de ànzhào yìngjí chéngxù chǔzhì xiǎnqíng.
沉着.en: Despite encountering an unexpected emergency, the captain still handled the perilous situation calmly and composedly according to emergency procedures.

撤退.zh: 看到洪水迅速上涨，抢险指挥部立即下达命令，组织群众安全撤退。
撤退.py: Kàndào hóngshuǐ xùnsù shàngzhǎng, qiǎngxiǎn zhǐhuībù lìjí xiàdá mìnglìng, zǔzhī qúnzhòng ānquán chètuì.
撤退.en: Seeing the floodwaters rising rapidly, the disaster-relief command immediately issued orders to organize the safe withdrawal of the residents.

迟缓.zh: 由于系统长期缺乏维护，软件运行速度变得越来越迟缓。
迟缓.py: Yóuyú xìtǒng chángqī quēfá wéihù, ruǎnjiàn yùnxíng sùdù biànde yuèláiyuè chíhuǎn.
迟缓.en: Due to a long lack of system maintenance, the software's operating speed has become increasingly sluggish.

吃苦.zh: 想要在科学研究领域有所建树，就必须具备脚踏实地、敢于吃苦的精神。
吃苦.py: Xiǎngyào zài kēxué yánjiū lǐngyù yǒu suǒ jiànshù, jiù bìxū jùbèi jiǎotàshídì, gǎnyú chīkǔ de jīngshén.
吃苦.en: If you want to make achievements in scientific research, you must possess a down-to-earth spirit and the courage to endure hardships.

迟疑.zh: 面对考官提出的专业难题，他没有丝毫迟疑，沉着冷静地给出了清晰的解答。
迟疑.py: Miànduì kǎoguān tíchū de zhuānyè nántí, tā méiyǒu sīháo chíyí, chénzhuó lěngjìng de gěichū le qīngxī de jiědá.
迟疑.en: Faced with the difficult professional question raised by the examiner, he did not hesitate in the slightest and gave a clear answer calmly.

崇高.zh: 这位老教师一生坚守在偏远山区，把奉献教育事业当成自己崇高的理想。
崇高.py: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshī yìshēng jiānshǒu zài piānyuǎn shānqū, bǎ fèngxiàn jiàoyù shìyè dàngchéng zìjǐ chónggāo de lǐxiǎng.
崇高.en: This veteran teacher dedicated his life to the remote mountainous area, regarding devotion to education as his lofty ideal.

崇敬.zh: 大家对那位为保护国家财产而英勇牺牲的消防员怀有无比崇敬的心情。
崇敬.py: Dàjiā duì nà wèi wèi bǎohù guójiā cáichǎn ér yīngyǒng xīshēng de xiāofángyuán huáiyǒu wúbǐ chóngjìng de xīnqíng.
崇敬.en: Everyone holds immense reverence for the firefighter who bravely sacrificed his life to protect state property.

充沛.zh: 充足的睡眠和规律的锻炼让他每天都能保持充沛的精力去应对繁忙的工作。
充沛.py: Chōngzú de shuìmián hé guīlǜ de duànliàn ràng tā měitiān dōu néng bǎochí chōngpèi de jīnglì qù yìngduì fánmáng de gōngzuò.
充沛.en: Sufficient sleep and regular exercise allow him to maintain abundant energy every day to handle his busy workload.

重阳节.zh: 每年农历九月初九是重阳节，人们通常会登高远眺、佩插茱萸并表达对长辈的敬意。
重阳节.py: Měinián nónglì jiǔyuè chūjiǔ shì Chóngyángjié, rénmen tōngcháng huì dēnggāo yuǎntiào, pèichā zhūyú bìng biǎodá duì zhǎngbèi de jìngyì.
重阳节.en: The ninth day of the ninth lunar month every year is the Double Ninth Festival, when people typically climb heights to gaze into the distance, wear cornel twigs, and express respect to the elderly.

踌躇.zh: 站在人生的十字路口，他踌躇了良久，最终决定选择追寻自己的创业梦想。
踌躇.py: Zhàn zài rénshēng de shízìlùkǒu, tā chóuchú le liángjiǔ, zuìzhōng juédìng xuǎnzé zhuīxún zìjǐ de chuàngyè mèngxiǎng.
踌躇.en: Standing at the crossroads of life, he hesitated for a long time before finally deciding to pursue his entrepreneurial dream.

丑恶.zh: 这篇新闻调查彻底揭露了黑心商家制造假冒伪劣药品的丑恶嘴脸。
丑恶.py: Zhè piān xīnwén diàochá chèdǐ jiēlù le hēixīn shāngjiā zhìzào jiǎmào wěiliè yàopǐn de chǒu'è zuǐliǎn.
丑恶.en: This investigative news report thoroughly exposed the ugly, deceitful faces of unethical merchants manufacturing counterfeit and shoddy medicines.

抽空.zh: 尽管最近科研任务十分紧张，导师依然会抽空与每位研究生交流论文进展。
抽空.py: Jǐnguǎn zuìjìn kēyán rènwu shífēn jǐnzhāng, dǎoshī yīrán huì chōukòng yǔ měi wèi yánjiūshēng jiāoliú lùnwén jìnzhǎn.
抽空.en: Although research tasks have been very intense recently, the advisor still makes time to discuss thesis progress with each graduate student.

稠密.zh: 这座沿海大都市人口稠密、商业繁荣，对市政交通和公共服务提出了极高的要求。
稠密.py: Zhè zuò yánhǎi dà dūshì rénkǒu chóumì, shāngyè fánróng, duì shìzhèng jiāotōng hé gōnggòng fúwù tíchū le jí gāo de yāoqiú.
稠密.en: This coastal metropolis is densely populated and commercially prosperous, placing extremely high demands on municipal transportation and public services.

船舶.zh: 港口管理部门严密监控海面天气变化，及时引导往来船舶进港避风。
船舶.py: Gǎngkǒu guǎnlǐ bùmén yánmì jiānkòng hǎimiàn tiānqì biànhuà, jíshí yǐndǎo wǎnglái chuánbó jìn gǎng bìfēng.
船舶.en: The port administration closely monitors maritime weather changes and promptly guides incoming and outgoing vessels into harbor to take shelter from the wind.

传单.zh: 志愿者们在社区广场向居民分发防范网络诈骗的传单，普及安全常识。
传单.py: Zhìyuànzhěmen zài shèqū guǎngchǎng xiàng jūmín fēnfā fángfàn wǎngluò zhàpiàn de chuándān, pǔjí ānquán chángshí.
传单.en: Volunteers distributed flyers on preventing telecom fraud to residents in the community square, popularizing safety knowledge.

幢.zh: 校园南侧新建了一幢现代化的综合实验楼，配备了先进的科研设备。
幢.py: Xiàoyuán náncè xīn jiàn le yí chuáng xiàndàihuà de zōnghé shíyànlóu, pèibèi le xiānjìn de kēyán shèbèi.
幢.en: A modern comprehensive laboratory building was newly constructed on the south side of campus, equipped with advanced scientific research facilities.

川流不息.zh: 夜幕降临后，市中心的立交桥上车灯闪烁，过往车辆川流不息。
川流不息.py: Yèmù jiànglín hòu, shìzhōngxīn de lìjiāoqiáo shang chēdēng shǎnshuò, guòwǎng chēliàng chuānliú-bùxī.
川流不息.en: After nightfall, headlights flicker on the overpass downtown, with passing traffic flowing in an endless stream.

喘气.zh: 经过连续两个小时的剧烈爬坡训练，运动员们累得坐在草地上大口喘气。
喘气.py: Jīngguò liánxù liǎng gè xiǎoshí de jùliè pápō xùnliàn, yùndòngyuánmen lèi de zuò zài cǎodì shang dàkǒu chuǎnqì.
喘气.en: After two consecutive hours of intense uphill training, the athletes were so exhausted that they sat on the grass gasping for breath.

触犯.zh: 任何人不论职务高低，只要触犯了国家法律，都必须受到严肃的制裁。
触犯.py: Rènhé rén búlùn zhíwù gāodī, zhǐyào chùfàn le guójiā fǎlǜ, dōu bìxū shòudào yánsù de zhìcái.
触犯.en: Regardless of rank or position, anyone who violates national laws must be subject to severe punishment.

锤.zh: 面对突发险情，救援队员迅速举起重锤，砸碎了被反锁的应急通道大门。
锤.py: Miànduì tūfā xiǎnqíng, jiùyuánduìyuán xùnsù jǔqǐ zhòngchuí, zásuì le bèi fǎnsuǒ de yìngjí tōngdào dàmén.
锤.en: In the face of a sudden emergency, the rescue team members quickly lifted a heavy hammer and smashed through the locked emergency exit door.

吹捧.zh: 真正有实力的学者从来不靠媒体的盲目吹捧，而是用扎实的研究成果赢得尊重。
吹捧.py: Zhēnzhèng yǒu shílì de xuézhě cónglái bú kào méitǐ de mángmù chuīpěng, érshì yòng zhāshi de yánjiū chéngguǒ yíngdé zūnzhòng.
吹捧.en: Scholars of true caliber never rely on blind flattery from the media; rather, they earn respect through solid research achievements.

出神.zh: 爷爷凝视着相册里泛黄的老照片，久久出神，回忆起年轻时的峥嵘岁月。
出神.py: Yéye níngshìzhe xiàngchè lǐ fànhuáng de lǎo zhàopiàn, jiǔjiǔ chūshén, huíyìqǐ niánqīng shí de zhēngróng suìyuè.
出神.en: Grandfather gazed at the yellowed old photos in the album and was lost in thought for a long time, recalling the eventful years of his youth.

出息.zh: 父母辛勤操劳了大半辈子，最大的心愿就是看到孩子有出息、能为社会做贡献。
出息.py: Fùmǔ xīnqín cāoláo le dàbànbèizi, zuì dà de xīnyuàn jiùshì kàndào háizi yǒu chūxi, néng wèi shèhuì zuò gòngxiàn.
出息.en: The parents toiled diligently for most of their lives, and their greatest wish was to see their child succeed with good prospects and make contributions to society.

伺候.zh: 母亲住院的那段日子，他在床前悉心伺候，无微不至地照料母亲的起居。
伺候.py: Mǔqīn zhùyuàn de nà duàn rìzi, tā zài chuáng qián xīxīn cìhou, wúwēibúzhì de zhàoliào mǔqīn de qǐjū.
伺候.en: During the days when his mother was hospitalized, he waited upon her attentively by her bedside, taking meticulous care of her daily needs.

次品.zh: 工厂质检部门制定了严格的把关标准，坚决不允许任何次品流入市场。
次品.py: Gōngchǎng zhìjiǎn bùmén zhìdìng le yángé de bǎguān biāozhǔn, jiānjué bù yǔnxǔ rènhé cìpǐn liúrù shìchǎng.
次品.en: The factory's quality inspection department established strict screening standards and firmly refused to allow any defective products to enter the market.

雌雄.zh: 这两种候鸟在羽毛颜色上差异明显，经验丰富的观鸟者一眼就能辨别出雌雄。
雌雄.py: Zhè liǎng zhǒng hòuniǎo zài yǔmáo yánsè shang chāyì míngxiǎn, jīngyàn fēngfù de guānniǎozhě yì yǎn jiù néng biànbié chū cíxióng.
雌雄.en: These two types of migratory birds show distinct differences in feather coloration, allowing experienced birdwatchers to distinguish male from female at a glance.

丛.zh: 春雨过后，公园小径旁的灌木丛中绽放出一丛丛娇艳的野花。
丛.py: Chūnyǔ guòhòu, gōngyuán xiǎojìng páng de guànmùcóng zhōng zhànfàng chū yì cóngcóng jiāoyàn de yěhuā.
丛.en: After the spring rain, clusters of charming wild flowers bloomed amidst the bushes beside the park path.

凑合.zh: 出差在外住宿条件虽然简陋，但他并不挑剔，觉得凑合住一晚就行。
凑合.py: Chūchāi zài wài zhùsù tiáojiàn suīrán jiǎnlòu, dàn tā bìng bù tiāoti, juéde còuhe zhù yì wǎn jiù xíng.
凑合.en: Although accommodation conditions on the business trip were rudimentary, he was not picky and felt making do for one night was just fine.

攒.zh: 广场上人头攒动，市民们兴高采烈地聚集在一起观赏节日烟火表演。
攒.py: Guǎngchǎng shang réntóu-cuándòng, shìmínmen xìnggāo-cǎiliè de jùjí zài yìqǐ guānshǎng jiérì yānhuǒ biǎoyǎn.
攒.en: Crowds were bustling in the square as citizens gathered together joyfully to watch the festive fireworks display.

窜.zh: 几只小老鼠受惊后慌忙向墙角缝隙里逃窜。
窜.py: Jǐ zhī xiǎo lǎoshǔ shòujīng hòu huāngmáng xiàng qiángjiǎo fèngxì lǐ táocuàn.
窜.en: Startled, several little mice scuttled flusteredly into the crevice in the corner of the wall.

摧残.zh: 长期超负荷的重体力劳动严重摧残了他的身体健康，导致未老先衰。
摧残.py: Chángqī chāofùhè de zhòngtǐlì láodòng yánzhòng cuīcán le tā de shēntǐ jiànkāng, dǎozhì wèilǎo-xiānshuāi.
摧残.en: Long-term overloaded heavy physical labor severely ravaged his health, leading to premature aging.

粗鲁.zh: 在公共场合大声喧哗甚至辱骂工作人员，是非常粗鲁且缺乏教养的行为。
粗鲁.py: Zài gōnggòng chǎnghé dàshēng xuānhuá shènzhì rǔmà gōngzuò rényuán, shì fēicháng cūlǔ qiě quēfá jiàoyǎng de xíngwéi.
粗鲁.en: Shouting loudly or even insulting staff in public places is extremely rude and ill-mannered behavior.

搓.zh: 冬天室外寒风刺骨，他忍不住使劲搓着双手，试图让冰凉的手指暖和起来。
搓.py: Dōngtiān shìwài hánfēng cìgǔ, tā rěnbuzhù shǐjìn cuōzhe shuāngshǒu, shìtú ràng bīngliáng de shǒuzhǐ nuǎnhuo qǐlái.
搓.en: With the winter wind biting cold outside, he couldn't help vigorously rubbing his hands together, trying to warm up his chilly fingers.

磋商.zh: 经过双方代表团数轮坦诚友好的磋商，两国终于达成了双边自由贸易协定。
磋商.py: Jīngguò shuāngfāng dàibiǎotuán shù lún tǎnchéng yǒuhǎo de cuōshāng, liǎng guó zhōngyú dáchéng le shuāngbiān zìyóu màoyì xiédìng.
磋商.en: After several rounds of candid and friendly consultations between delegations from both sides, the two countries finally reached a bilateral free trade agreement.

答辩.zh: 她在毕业论文答辩中条理清晰、应对从容，获得了评委专家们的一致赞赏。
答辩.py: Tā zài bìyè lùnwén dábiàn zhōng tiáolǐ qīngxī, yìngduì cóngróng, huòdé le píngwěi zhuānjiāmen de yízhì zànshǎng.
答辩.en: In her graduation thesis defense, she was well-organized and composed in her responses, winning unanimous praise from the panel of experts.

大不了.zh: 别为这次面试失败感到灰心，大不了从头再来，多积累几次经验就好了。
大不了.py: Bié wèi zhè cì miànshì shībài gǎndào huīxīn, dàbùliǎo cóngtóu-zàilái, duō jīlěi jǐ cì jīngyàn jiù hǎo le.
大不了.en: Don't lose heart over failing this interview; at worst, you can start over again and gain more experience.

怠慢.zh: 贵宾远道而来视察项目，我们必须周密安排接待工作，切不可有所怠慢。
怠慢.py: Guìbīn yuǎndào-érlái shìchá xiàngmù, wǒmen bìxū zhōumì ānpái jiēdài gōngzuò, qiè bù kě yǒu suǒ dàimàn.
怠慢.en: Distinguished guests have traveled from afar to inspect the project; we must make thorough reception arrangements and must not neglect them in any way.

歹徒.zh: 便衣民警经过严密布控，在火车站广场迅速制服了企图持刀伤人的歹徒。
歹徒.py: Biànyī mínjǐng jīngguò yánmì bùkòng, zài huǒchēzhàn guǎngchǎng xùnsù zhìfú le qǐtú chídāo shāngrén de dǎitú.
歹徒.en: After rigorous surveillance and positioning, plainclothes police officers swiftly subdued the gangster attempting to injure people with a knife in the railway station square.

打量.zh: 招聘经理扶了扶眼镜，仔细打量着眼前这位自信沉稳的年轻求职者。
打量.py: Zhàopìn jīnglǐ fú le fú yǎnjìng, zǐxì dǎliangzhe yǎnqián zhè wèi zìxìn chénwěn de niánqīng qiúzhízhě.
打量.en: The hiring manager adjusted his glasses and carefully sized up the confident and poised young job seeker before him.

打猎.zh: 为了保护濒危野生动物资源，该自然保护区已全面禁止任何形式的打猎活动。
打猎.py: Wèile bǎohù bīnwēi yěshēng dòngwù zīyuán, gāi zìrán bǎohùqū yǐ quánmiàn jìnzhǐ rènhé xíngshì de dǎliè huódòng.
打猎.en: In order to protect endangered wildlife resources, this nature reserve has completely banned all forms of hunting activities.

诞辰.zh: 全校师生隆重集会，共同纪念建校先驱诞辰一百二十周年。
诞辰.py: Quán xiào shīshēng lóngzhòng jíhuì, gòngtóng jìniàn jiànxiào xiānqū dànchén yībǎi èrshí zhōunián.
诞辰.en: Faculty and students of the entire school gathered solemnly to commemorate the 120th anniversary of the founding pioneer's birth.

当事人.zh: 在正式调解纠纷前，法官依法认真听取了双方当事人对案件事实的陈述。
当事人.py: Zài zhèngshì tiáojiě jiūfēn qián, fǎguān yīfǎ rènzhēn tīngqǔ le shuāngfāng dāngshìrén duì ànjiàn shìshí de chénshù.
当事人.en: Before formally mediating the dispute, the judge conscientiously listened to the statements of case facts from both parties involved in accordance with the law.

胆怯.zh: 面对台下数千名观众的注视，她克服了内心的胆怯，自信地完成了精彩的演讲。
胆怯.py: Miànduì tái xià shù qiān míng guānzhòng de zhùshì, tā kèfú le nèixīn de dǎnqiè, zìxìn de wánchéng le jīngcǎi de yǎnjiǎng.
胆怯.en: Facing the gaze of thousands of audience members beneath the stage, she overcame her inner timidity and confidently delivered a brilliant speech.

导弹.zh: 现代防空系统能够在短时间内精准锁定并拦截来袭的敌方巡航导弹。
导弹.py: Xiàndài fángkōng xìtǒng nénggòu zài duǎn shíjiān nèi jīngzhǔn suǒdìng bìng lánjié láixí de dífāng xúnháng dǎodàn.
导弹.en: Modern air defense systems can accurately lock onto and intercept incoming enemy cruise missiles within a short time.

稻谷.zh: 金秋十月，广袤的田野里稻谷金黄，农民们驾驶着收割机在农田里忙碌穿梭。
稻谷.py: Jīnqiū shíyuè, guǎngmào de tiányě lǐ dàogǔ jīnhuáng, nóngmínmen jiàshǐzhe shōugējī zài nóngtián lǐ mánglù chuānsuō.
稻谷.en: In golden October, the unhusked rice turns golden across the vast fields, and farmers drive harvesters bustling back and forth through the farmland.

导航.zh: 智能车载导航系统能根据实时路况信息，为驾驶员规划出避开拥堵的最佳路线。
导航.py: Zhìnéng chēzài dǎoháng xìtǒng néng gēnjù shíshí lùkuàng xìnxī, wèi jiàshǐyuán guīhuà chū bìkāi yōngdǔ de zuì jiā lùxiàn.
导航.en: The smart in-car navigation system can plan the best route to avoid traffic jams for drivers based on real-time traffic condition information.

捣乱.zh: 几名醉汉在安静的剧场里大吵大闹故意捣乱，最终被值班安保人员强行带离。
捣乱.py: Jǐ míng zuìhàn zài ānjìng de jùchǎng lǐ dàchǎo-dànào gùyì dǎoluàn, zuìzhōng bèi zhíbān ānbǎo rényuán qiángxíng dàilí.
捣乱.en: Several drunken men made noise and deliberately caused trouble in the quiet theater, and were ultimately escorted away by on-duty security personnel.

盗窃.zh: 警方凭借高清监控录像迅速锁定了犯罪嫌疑人，破获了这起巨额黄金盗窃案。
盗窃.py: Jǐngfāng píngjiè gāoqīng jiānkòng lùxiàng xùnsù suǒdìng le fànzuì xiányírén, pòhuò le zhè qǐ jù'é huángjīn dàoqiè àn.
盗窃.en: Relying on high-definition surveillance footage, the police quickly identified the criminal suspect and solved this massive gold theft case.

导向.zh: 企业在研发新产品时应当坚持以市场需求为导向，避免脱离消费者的实际需求。
导向.py: Qǐyè zài yánfā xīn chǎnpǐn shí yīngdāng jiānchí yǐ shìchǎng xūqiú wéi dǎoxiàng, bìmiǎn tuōlí xiāofèizhě de shíjì xūqiú.
导向.en: When developing new products, enterprises should adhere to market demand as their orientation and avoid detaching from the practical needs of consumers.

大肆.zh: 这家不良机构为了谋取暴利，在网络上大肆虚假宣传未经审批的保健品。
大肆.py: Zhè jiā bùliáng jīgòu wèile móuqǔ bàolì, zài wǎnglù shang dàsì xūjiǎ xuānchuán wèijīng shěnpī de bǎojiànpǐn.
大肆.en: In order to reap exorbitant profits, this unscrupulous organization wantonly disseminated false advertisements online for unapproved health supplements.

得不偿失.zh: 为了赶工期而忽视施工安全是得不偿失的，一旦发生重大事故将造成无可挽回的损失。
得不偿失.py: Wèile gǎn gōngqī ér hūshì shīgōng ānquán shì débùchángshī de, yídàn fāshēng zhòngdà shìgù jiāng zàochéng wúkě-wǎnhuí de sǔnshī.
得不偿失.en: Sacrificing construction safety just to rush the project deadline is not worth the cost; once a major accident occurs, it will lead to irreparable losses.

得力.zh: 他工作勤勉且办事果断，是总经理身边最得力的业务助手。
得力.py: Tā gōngzuò qǐnmiǎn qiě bànshì guǒduàn, shì zǒngjīnglǐ shēnbiān zuì délì de yèwù zhùshǒu.
得力.en: Diligent in his work and decisive in execution, he is the general manager's most capable business assistant.

瞪.zh: 听到对方毫无根据的污蔑，他气得瞪圆了双眼，当场义正言辞地予以反驳。
瞪.py: Tīngdào duìfāng háowú gēnjù de wūmiè, tā qì de dèng yuán le shuāngyǎn, dāngchǎng yìzhèng-yáncí de yǔyǐ fǎnbó.
瞪.en: Hearing the other party's baseless slander, he glared with wide eyes in fury and refuted it sternly and justly on the spot.

蹬.zh: 他蹬上一双跑鞋，迎着晨光开始了每天的晨跑。
蹬.py: Tā dēng shàng yì shuāng pǎoxié, yíngzhe chénguāng kāishǐ le měitiān de chénpǎo.
蹬.en: He slipped on a pair of running shoes and set out for his daily morning run in the dawn light.

登陆.zh: 这场超强台风预计将于今晚在沿海地区登陆。
登陆.py: Zhè chǎng chāoqiáng táifēng yùjì jiāng yú jīnwǎn zài yánhǎi dìqū dēnglù.
登陆.en: This super typhoon is expected to make landfall in the coastal area tonight.

得天独厚.zh: 这座城市依山傍水，拥有得天独厚的自然资源和旅游优势。
得天独厚.py: Zhè zuò chéngshì yī shān bàng shuǐ, yōngyǒu détiāndúhòu de zìrán zīyuán hé lǚyóu yōushì.
得天独厚.en: Nestled against mountains and waters, this city is richly endowed with exceptional natural resources and tourism advantages.

垫.zh: 这张桌子的腿有点不平，他找了一块硬纸板垫在下面。
垫.py: Zhè zhāng zhuōzi de tuǐ yǒudiǎn bùpíng, tā zhǎo le yí kuài yìngzhǐbǎn diàn zài xiàmiàn.
垫.en: One leg of the table was a bit uneven, so he found a piece of cardboard to cushion underneath it.

颠簸.zh: 飞机穿过强对流云层时发生了剧烈的颠簸，空乘人员迅速提醒乘客系好安全带。
颠簸.py: Fēijī chuānguò qiáng duìliú yúncéng shí fāshēng le jùliè de diānbǒ, kōngchéng rényuán xùnsù tíxǐng chéngkè jì hǎo ānquándài.
颠簸.en: The plane experienced severe turbulence as it passed through strong convective clouds, and the flight attendants promptly reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts.

颠倒.zh: 在论证过程中，我们绝不能颠倒因果关系，否则得出的结论将毫无意义。
颠倒.py: Zài lùnzhèng guòchéng zhōng, wǒmen jué bù néng diāndǎo yīnguǒ guānxì, fǒuzé déchū de jiélùn jiāng háowú yìyì.
颠倒.en: In the process of argumentation, we must never reverse cause and effect; otherwise, the conclusion reached will be meaningless.

奠定.zh: 这项早期的科学研究为后来现代通信技术的突破奠定了坚实的基础。
奠定.py: Zhè xiàng zǎoqī de kēxué yánjiū wèi hòulái xiàndài tōngxìn jìshù de tūpò diàndìng le jiānshí de jīchǔ.
奠定.en: This early scientific research laid a solid foundation for later breakthroughs in modern communications technology.

惦记.zh: 母亲总是惦记着身在外地的儿子，隔三岔五就会打电话嘘寒问暖。
惦记.py: Mǔqīn zǒngshì diànjì zhe shēn zài wàidì de érzi, gésānchàwǔ jiù huì dǎ diànhuà xūhánwènnuǎn.
惦记.en: The mother is always thinking of her son living away from home, calling every few days to check on how he is doing.

点缀.zh: 碧绿的草坪上点缀着五颜六色的野花，给春天增添了无限生机。
点缀.py: Bìlǜ de cǎopíng shang diǎnzhuì zhe wǔyánliùsè de yěhuā, gěi chūntiān zēngtiān le wúxiàn shēngjī.
点缀.en: Colorful wildflowers dotted the emerald green lawn, infusing the spring season with boundless vitality.

叼.zh: 老虎轻轻叼起刚出生的小幼崽，小心翼翼地把它转移到安全的洞穴中。
叼.py: Lǎohǔ qīngqīng diāo qǐ gāng chūshēng de xiǎo yòuzǎi, xiǎoxīnyìyì de bǎ tā zhuǎnyí dào ānquán de dòngxué zhōng.
叼.en: The tigress gently picked up her newborn cub in her mouth and carefully moved it to a safe den.

雕刻.zh: 这位老艺人花费数年时间，在这块玉石上雕刻出栩栩如生的山水图案。
雕刻.py: Zhè wèi lǎoyìrén huāfèi shù nián shíjiān, zài zhè kuài yùshí shang diāokè chū xǔxǔrùshēng de shānshuǐ tú'àn.
雕刻.en: The veteran craftsman spent several years carving lifelike landscape scenery into this piece of jade.

堤坝.zh: 经过多日强降雨，工人们连夜加固堤坝以防洪水决口。
堤坝.py: Jīngguò duō rì qiáng jiàngyǔ, gōngrénmen liányè jiāgù dībà yǐ fáng hóngshuǐ juékǒu.
堤坝.en: Following consecutive days of torrential rains, workers reinforced the dike overnight to prevent a flood breach.

地步.zh: 事情怎么会发展到如此严重的地步，大家事先都没有料到。
地步.py: Shìqing zěnme huì fāzhǎn dào rúcǐ yánzhòng de dìbù, dàjiā shìxiān dōu méiyǒu liàodào.
地步.en: Nobody had anticipated beforehand that things would develop to such a serious point.

盯.zh: 程序员目不转睛地盯着电脑屏幕，仔细排查代码中的隐藏漏洞。
盯.py: Chéngxùyuán mùbùzhuǎnjīng de dīng zhe diànnǎo píngmù, zǐxì páichá dàimǎ zhōng de yǐncáng lòudòng.
盯.en: The programmer stared fixedly at the computer screen, meticulously searching for hidden bugs in the code.

叮嘱.zh: 出门前，奶奶反复叮嘱他在路上要注意交通安全。
叮嘱.py: Chūmén qián, nǎinai fǎnfù dīngzhǔ tā zài lù shang yào zhùyì jiāotōng ānquán.
叮嘱.en: Before he left home, grandma repeatedly reminded him to pay attention to traffic safety on the road.

敌视.zh: 双方应该通过对话增进相互理解，而不是抱有敌视的态度。
敌视.py: Shuāngfāng yīnggāi tōngguò duìhuà zēngjìn xiānghù lǐjiě, ér bú shì bàoyǒu díshì de tàidù.
敌视.en: Both sides should enhance mutual understanding through dialogue rather than harboring an attitude of hostility.

丢人.zh: 犯错并不可耻，不敢承认错误、逃避责任才真正丢人。
丢人.py: Fàncuò bìng bù kěchǐ, bù gǎn chéngrèn cuòwù, táobì zérèn cái zhēnzhèng diūrén.
丢人.en: Making a mistake is not disgraceful; it is refusing to admit your mistakes and evading responsibility that is truly embarrassing.

丢三落四.zh: 他平时总是丢三落四，今天出门又把钥匙忘在了办公桌上。
丢三落四.py: Tā píngshí zǒngshì diūsānlàsì, jīntiān chūmén yòu bǎ yàoshi wàng zài le bàngōngzhuō shang.
丢三落四.en: He is always scatterbrained; today when leaving, he once again forgot his keys on his desk.

递增.zh: 近年来，这家新能源公司的研发投入以每年百分之二十的幅度递增。
递增.py: Jìnnián lái, zhè jiā xīn néngyuán gōngsī de yánfā tóurù yǐ měinián bǎifēnzhī'èrshí de fúdù dìzēng.
递增.en: In recent years, this new energy company's investment in research and development has increased progressively at an annual rate of 20%.

动荡.zh: 那段动荡的社会历史给普通民众的生活留下了深刻的烙印。
动荡.py: Nà duàn dòngdàng de shèhuì lìshǐ gěi pǔtōng mínzhòng de shēnghuó liúxià le shēnkè de làoyìn.
动荡.en: That turbulent period of social history left a profound imprint on the lives of ordinary citizens.

东道主.zh: 作为本届国际峰会的东道主，中国为各国代表提供了周到的服务和保障。
东道主.py: Zuòwéi běnjiè guójì fēnghuì de dōngdàozhǔ, Zhōngguó wèi gè guó dàibiǎo tígōng le zhōudào de fúwù hé bǎozhàng.
东道主.en: As the host of this international summit, China provided thoughtful services and support for delegates from all nations.

冻结.zh: 法院已依法冻结涉案嫌疑人的全部银行账户和相关资产。
冻结.py: Fǎyuàn yǐ yīfǎ dòngjié shè'àn xiányírén de quánbù yínháng zhànghù hé xiāngguān zīchǎn.
冻结.en: The court has legally frozen all bank accounts and related assets belonging to the suspect involved in the case.

动静.zh: 房间里一片漆黑，听不到任何动静，似乎屋里根本没有人。
动静.py: Fángjiān lǐ yípiàn qīhēi, tīng bú dào rènhé dòngjing, sìhū wū lǐ gēnběn méiyǒu rén.
动静.en: The room was pitch black and not a sound could be heard, as if there was nobody inside at all.

动脉.zh: 这条贯穿南北的高速铁路被誉为国家经济发展的大动脉。
动脉.py: Zhè tiáo guànchuān nánběi de gāosù tiělù bèi yù wéi guójiā jīngjì fāzhǎn de dà dòngmài.
动脉.en: This high-speed railway running north to south is acclaimed as a vital artery of national economic development.

东张西望.zh: 过马路时要专心观察路况，切忌东张西望或者低头玩手机。
东张西望.py: Guò mǎlù shí yào zhuānxīn guānchá lùkuàng, qièjì dōngzhāngxīwàng huòzhě dītóu wán shǒujī.
东张西望.en: When crossing the street, focus on watching traffic conditions and avoid looking all around or staring down at your phone.

兜.zh: 天气很冷，他把冻僵的双手深深插进外套的大兜里。
兜.py: Tiānqì hěn lěng, tā bǎ dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu shēnshēn chā jìn wàitào de dà dōu lǐ.
兜.en: The weather was freezing, so he plunged his stiff hands deep into the large pockets of his coat.

陡峭.zh: 这条通往山顶的小径非常陡峭，登山队员们每走一步都格外谨慎。
陡峭.py: Zhè tiáo tōngwǎng shāndǐng de xiǎojìng fēicháng dǒuqiào, dēngshān duìyuánmen měi zǒu yí bù dōu géwài jǐnshèn.
陡峭.en: The trail leading to the mountain summit is exceptionally steep, and the mountaineers were extra cautious with every step.

短促.zh: 尽管夏令营的时间十分短促，但孩子们在这里结下了深厚的友谊。
短促.py: Jǐnguǎn xiàlìngyíng de shíjiān shífēn duǎncù, dàn háizimen zài zhèlǐ jiéxià le shēnhòu de yǒuyì.
短促.en: Although the summer camp was very brief, the children forged deep friendships here.

督促.zh: 导师每周都会督促研究生汇报科研进展，确保课题按时完成。
督促.py: Dǎoshī měi zhōu dōu huì dūcù yánjiūshēng huìbào kēyán jìnzhǎn, quèbǎo kètí ànshí wánchéng.
督促.en: Every week, the advisor urges the graduate students to report on their research progress to ensure the project is completed on schedule.

对策.zh: 面对原材料价格上涨的严峻挑战，管理层迅速商讨出了应对的对策。
对策.py: Miànduì yuáncáiliào jiàgé shàngzhǎng de yánjùn tiǎozhàn, guǎnlǐcéng xùnsù shāngtǎo chū le yìngduì de duìcè.
对策.en: Faced with the severe challenge of rising raw material costs, management swiftly formulated effective countermeasures.

堆积.zh: 连续几个星期的阴雨天气导致港口码头堆积了大量集装箱。
堆积.py: Liánxù jǐ gè xīngqī de yīnyǔ tiānqì dǎozhì gǎngkǒu mǎtou duījī le dàliàng jízhuāngxiāng.
堆积.en: Weeks of continuous rainy weather caused a large accumulation of shipping containers at the harbor dock.

对联.zh: 每逢除夕，家家户户都会在大门两旁贴上喜庆的红对联以迎新春。
对联.py: Měi féng chúxī, jiājiā-hùhù dōu huì zài dàmén liǎngpáng tiē shàng xǐqìng de hóng duìlián yǐ yíng xīnchūn.
对联.en: Every Lunar New Year's Eve, families paste festive red couplets on both sides of their front doors to welcome the new spring.

兑现.zh: 作为有担当的企业家，他始终说到做到，认真兑现了对员工的所有承诺。
兑现.py: Zuòwéi yǒu dāndāng de qǐyèjiā, tā shǐzhōng shuōdào-zuòdào, rènzhēn duìxiàn le duì yuángōng de suǒyǒu chéngnuò.
兑现.en: As a responsible entrepreneur, he always walks the talk and conscientiously fulfills all promises made to his employees.

对照.zh: 医生对照病人的体检报告和既往病史，做出了准确的诊断。
对照.py: Yīshēng duìzhào bìngrén de tǐjiǎn bàogào hé jìwǎng bìngshǐ, zuòchū le zhǔnquè de zhěnduàn.
对照.en: The doctor made an accurate diagnosis by comparing the patient's medical checkup report against their past medical history.

杜绝.zh: 学校采取严格的安检措施，坚决杜绝任何危险物品进入校园。
杜绝.py: Xuéxiào cǎiqǔ yángé de ānjiǎn cuòshī, jiānjué dùjué rènhé wēixiǎn wùpǐn jìnrù xiàoyuán.
杜绝.en: The school implemented strict security measures to resolutely prevent any dangerous items from entering the campus.

堕落.zh: 他曾经是一位优秀青年，后来却因沉迷赌博而逐渐堕落。
堕落.py: Tā céngjīng shì yí wèi yōuxiù qīngnián, hòulái què yīn chénmí dǔbó ér zhújiàn duòluò.
堕落.en: He used to be an outstanding young man, but later gradually degenerated due to gambling addiction.

哆嗦.zh: 那个小男孩在刺骨的寒风中冻得浑身直哆嗦。
哆嗦.py: Nàge xiǎo nánhái zài cìgǔ de hánfēng zhōng dòng de húnshēn zhí duōsuo.
哆嗦.en: The little boy shivered all over in the biting cold wind.

多元化.zh: 随着全球化深入推进，现代社会呈现出更加包容和多元化的文化特征。
多元化.py: Suízhe quánqiúhuà shēnrù tuījìn, xiàndài shèhuì chéngxiàn chū gèngjiā bāoróng hé duōyuánhuà de wénhuà tèzhēng.
多元化.en: As globalization deepens, modern society displays more inclusive and diversified cultural characteristics.

堵塞.zh: 早高峰时期的交通事故导致市中心主干道严重堵塞达两小时。
堵塞.py: Zǎogāofēng shíqī de jiāotōng shìgù dǎozhì shìzhōngxīn zhǔgàndào yánzhòng dǔsè dá liǎng xiǎoshí.
堵塞.en: A traffic accident during the morning rush hour caused severe congestion on the downtown thoroughfare for two hours.

恶化.zh: 如果不及时采取治理措施，当地的水质污染状况将会进一步恶化。
恶化.py: Rúguǒ bù jíshí cǎiqǔ zhìlǐ cuòshī, dāngdì de shuǐzhì wūrǎn zhuàngkuàng jiāng huì jìnyíbù èhuà.
恶化.en: If remediation measures are not taken in time, the local water pollution situation will worsen further.

恩怨.zh: 合作双方决定摒弃过往的恩怨，携手开创崭新的合作局面。
恩怨.py: Hézuò shuāngfāng juédìng bìngqì guòwǎng de ēnyuàn, xiéshǒu kāichuàng zhǎnxīn de hézuò júmiàn.
恩怨.en: Both cooperating parties decided to set aside past grievances and join hands to usher in a new phase of collaboration.

遏制.zh: 各国央行纷纷调整货币政策，以遏制不断加剧的通货膨胀。
遏制.py: Gè guó yāngháng fēnfēn tiáozhěng huòbì zhèngcè, yǐ èzhì bùduàn jiājù de tōnghuò péngzhàng.
遏制.en: Central banks across nations have successively adjusted monetary policies to rein in mounting inflation.

发财.zh: 真正的成功在于脚踏实地的积累，绝不可能靠一夜发财的侥幸心理来实现。
发财.py: Zhēnzhèng de chénggōng zàiyú jiǎotàshídì de jīlěi, jué bù kěnéng kào yíyè fācái de jiǎoxìng xīnlǐ lái shíxiàn.
发财.en: True success lies in down-to-earth accumulation and can never be achieved by the wishful thinking of striking it rich overnight.

发呆.zh: 午后阳光明媚，她坐在窗前静静地发呆，享受难得的惬意时光。
发呆.py: Wǔhòu yángguāng míngmèi, tā zuò zài chuāng qián jìngjìng de fādāi, xiǎngshòu nándé de qièyì shíguāng.
发呆.en: In the bright afternoon sunshine, she sat by the window staring blankly, enjoying a rare moment of tranquility.

发火.zh: 他向来脾气温和，今天却因为团队成员敷衍塞责的工作态度罕见地发火了。
发火.py: Tā xiànglái píqi wēnhé, jīntiān què yīnwèi tuánduì chéngyuán fūyansèzé de gōngzuò tàidù hǎnjiàn de fāhuǒ le.
发火.en: He has always had a gentle temper, but today he rarely lost his temper over the team members' perfunctory work attitude.

范畴.zh: 人工智能伦理已经超越了单纯的工程技术范畴，成为全人类共同关注的哲学议题。
范畴.py: Réngōng zhìnéng lúlǐ yǐjīng chāoyuè le dānchún de gōngchéng jìshù fànchóu, chéngwéi quán rénlèi gòngtóng guānzhù de zhéxué yìtí.
范畴.en: Artificial intelligence ethics has transcended the category of mere engineering and technology, becoming a philosophical issue of shared concern for all humankind.

反倒.zh: 吃了感冒药之后，他不仅没有觉得轻松，反倒更加昏昏欲睡了。
反倒.py: Chī le gǎnmàoyào zhīhòu, tā bùjǐn méiyǒu juéde qīngsōng, fǎndào gèngjiā hūnhūnyùshuì le.
反倒.en: After taking the cold medicine, not only did he not feel relieved, but he became even drowsier instead.

防疫.zh: 社区卫生服务中心严格落实各项防疫措施，筑牢基层健康防线。
防疫.py: Shèqū wèishēng fúwù zhōngxīn yángé luòshí gè xiàng fángyì cuòshī, zhù láo jīcéng jiànkāng fángxiàn.
防疫.en: The community health service center strictly implements various epidemic prevention measures, building a solid grassroots defense line for public health.

繁华.zh: 夜幕降临，这座国际大都市的繁华街道依旧车水马龙、灯火辉煌。
繁华.py: Yèmù jiànglín, zhè zuò guójì dà dūshì de fánhuá jiēdào yījiù chēshuǐmǎlóng, dēnghuǒ huīhuáng.
繁华.en: As night fell, the bustling streets of this international metropolis were still flowing with traffic and ablaze with lights.

贩卖.zh: 执法部门严厉打击非法贩卖野生动物制品的违法犯罪行为。
贩卖.py: Zhífǎ bùmén yánlì dǎjī fēifǎ fànmài yěshēng dòngwù zhìpǐn de wéifǎ fànzuì xíngwéi.
贩卖.en: Law enforcement authorities cracked down severely on the illegal crimes of trafficking wildlife products.

反射.zh: 阳光照射在平静的水面上，反射出耀眼的光芒。
反射.py: Yángguāng zhàoshè zài píngjìng de shuǐmiàn shang, fǎnshè chū yàoyǎn de guāngmáng.
反射.en: The sunlight shone on the calm surface of the water, reflecting a dazzling gleam.

反之.zh: 保持乐观的心态有益于身心健康，反之，长期焦虑则会损害免疫系统。
反之.py: Bǎochí lèguān de xīntài yǒuyì yú shēnxīn jiànkāng, fǎnzhī, chángqī jiāolǜ zé huì sǔnhài miǎnyì xìtǒng.
反之.en: Maintaining an optimistic mindset benefits both physical and mental health; conversely, prolonged anxiety will impair the immune system.

法人.zh: 该企业具有独立的法人资格，依法独立承担民事责任。
法人.py: Gāi qǐyè jùyǒu dúlì de fǎrén zīgé, yīfǎ dúlì chéngdān mínshì zérèn.
法人.en: The enterprise possesses an independent legal personality and assumes civil liability independently according to law.

发扬.zh: 团队在比赛中发扬了拼搏精神，最终反超对手夺得冠军。
发扬.py: Tuánduì zài bǐsài zhōng fāyáng le pīnbó jīngshén, zuìzhōng fǎnchāo duìshǒu duó dé guànjūn.
发扬.en: The team carried forward a fighting spirit during the match and ultimately overtook their opponent to win the championship.

诽谤.zh: 他决定通过法律途径维护自己的名誉，起诉恶意诽谤他的竞争对手。
诽谤.py: Tā juédìng tōngguò fǎlǜ tújìng wéihù zìjǐ de míngyù, qǐsù èyì fěibàng tā de jìngzhēng duìshǒu.
诽谤.en: He decided to safeguard his reputation through legal channels and sue the competitor who maliciously slandered him.

飞禽走兽.zh: 这座国家公园生态环境优越，栖息着各种各样的飞禽走兽。
飞禽走兽.py: Zhè zuò guójiā gōngyuán shēngtài huánjìng yōuyuè, qīxīzhe gèzhǒng-gèyàng de fēiqín zǒushòu.
飞禽走兽.en: This national park boasts an excellent ecological environment, sheltering all kinds of birds and beasts.

匪徒.zh: 警方迅速包围了现场，迫使持枪抢劫的匪徒放下武器投降。
匪徒.py: Jǐngfāng xùnsù bāowéi le xiànchǎng, pòshǐ chíqiāng qiǎngjié de fěitú fàngxia wǔqì tóuxiáng.
匪徒.en: The police quickly surrounded the scene, forcing the armed bandits to lay down their weapons and surrender.

飞跃.zh: 近年来，人工智能技术的迅猛发展实现了质的飞跃。
飞跃.py: Jìnnián lái, réngōng zhìnéng jìshù de xùnměng fāzhǎn shíxiàn le zhì de fēiyuè.
飞跃.en: In recent years, the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence technology has achieved a qualitative leap.

吩咐.zh: 经理吩咐秘书将会议纪要整理好，并在下班前发送给全体员工。
吩咐.py: Jīnglǐ fēnfù mìshū jiāng huìyì jìyào zhěnglǐ hǎo, bìng zài xiàbān qián fāsòng gěi quántǐ yuángōng.
吩咐.en: The manager instructed the secretary to compile the meeting minutes and send them to all staff before the end of the day.

逢.zh: 每逢中秋佳节，漂泊在外的游子总会格外思念家乡的亲人。
逢.py: Měi féng Zhōngqiū jiājié, piāobó zàiwài de yóuzǐ zǒng huì géwài sīniàn jiāxiāng de qīnrén.
逢.en: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, wanderers far from home miss their loved ones in their hometown all the more.

丰满.zh: 这部小说中的人物形象刻画得十分丰满，每个角色都栩栩如生。
丰满.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō zhōng de rénwù xíngxiàng kèhuà de shífēn fēngmǎn, měi ge juésè dōu xǔxǔ-rúshēng.
丰满.en: The characters in this novel are depicted in a very well-rounded and full manner, with each one vividly brought to life.

风气.zh: 学校积极倡导阅读，营造了浓厚的书香风气。
风气.py: Xuéxiào jījí chàngdǎo yuèdú, yíngzào le nónghòu de shūxiāng fēngqì.
风气.en: The school actively promotes reading, fostering a strong atmosphere of learning and culture.

风趣.zh: 他幽默风趣的演讲把复杂的学术问题讲得通俗易懂，赢得了阵阵掌声。
风趣.py: Tā yōumò fēngqù de yǎnjiǎng bǎ fùzá de xuéshù wèntí jiǎng de tōngsú yìdǒng, yíngdé le zhènzhèn zhǎngshēng.
风趣.en: His witty and humorous speech made complex academic issues easy to understand, earning bursts of applause.

丰盛.zh: 为了庆祝母亲的生日，全家人准备了一桌丰盛的晚餐。
丰盛.py: Wèile qìngzhù mǔqīn de shēngrì, quánjiā rén zhǔnbèi le yì zhuō fēngshèng de wǎncān.
丰盛.en: To celebrate mother's birthday, the whole family prepared a sumptuous dinner.

封锁.zh: 事故发生后，警方立即封锁了周边路段以确保抢险救援顺利进行。
封锁.py: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, jǐngfāng lìjí fēngsuǒ le zhōubiān lùduàn yǐ quèbǎo qiǎngxiǎn jiùyuán shùnlì jìnxíng.
封锁.en: After the accident occurred, the police immediately cordoned off the surrounding roads to ensure rescue operations proceeded smoothly.

风土人情.zh: 他在旅行期间深入乡村，真切体验了当地独特的风土人情。
风土人情.py: Tā zài lǚxíng qījiān shēnrù xiāngcūn, zhēnqiè tǐyàn le dāngdì dútè de fēngtǔ rénqíng.
风土人情.en: During his travels, he ventured deep into the countryside and truly experienced the unique local customs and culture.

风味.zh: 这家老字号餐馆保留了传统的制作工艺，做出的点心极具地方风味。
风味.py: Zhè jiā lǎozìhào cānguǎn bǎoliú le chuántǒng de zhìzuò gōngyì, zuò chū de diǎnxin jí jù dìfāng fēngwèi.
风味.en: This time-honored restaurant preserves traditional craftsmanship, producing pastries packed with distinctive local flavor.

分红.zh: 随着公司年度利润大幅增长，股东们获得了可观的分红。
分红.py: Suízhe gōngsī niándù lìrùn dàfú zēngzhǎng, gǔdōngmen huòdé le kěguān de fēnhóng.
分红.en: With the substantial growth in the company's annual profit, the shareholders received handsome dividends.

分量.zh: 老专家在行业内威望极高，他发表的意见往往具有很重的分量。
分量.py: Lǎo zhuānjiā zài hángyè nèi wēiwàng jí gāo, tā fābiǎo de yìjiàn wǎngwǎng jùyǒu hěn zhòng de fēnliàng.
分量.en: The veteran expert carries immense prestige in the industry, and the opinions he voices often carry great weight.

分泌.zh: 当人处于紧张状态时，肾上腺素的分泌量会显著增加。
分泌.py: Dāng rén chǔyú jǐnzhāng zhuàngtài shí, shènshàngxiànsù de fēnmì liàng huì xiǎnzhù zēngjiā.
分泌.en: When a person is under stress, the secretion of adrenaline increases significantly.

粉碎.zh: 坚强的意志粉碎了所有的质疑与阻碍，让他迎来了最后的胜利。
粉碎.py: Jiānqiáng de yìzhì fěnsuì le suǒyǒu de zhìyí yǔ zǔ'ài, ràng tā yínglái le zuìhòu de shènglì.
粉碎.en: His unyielding willpower shattered all doubts and obstacles, ushering in his ultimate victory.

俘虏.zh: 这部精彩绝伦的舞台剧深深吸引了观众，彻底俘虏了大家的心。
俘虏.py: Zhè bù jīngcǎi juélún de wǔtáijù shēnshēn xīyǐn le guānzhòng, chèdǐ fúlǔ le dàjiā de xīn.
俘虏.en: This breathtaking stage play deeply fascinated the audience, completely capturing everyone's hearts.

服气.zh: 面对他无可辩驳的事实和严谨的推理，大家不得不服气。
服气.py: Miànduì tā wúkě biànbó de shìshí hé yánjǐn de tuīlǐ, dàjiā bùdébù fúqì.
服气.en: Faced with his irrefutable facts and rigorous reasoning, everyone had to be thoroughly convinced.

福气.zh: 孩子们懂事孝顺，老人常说这是自己晚年最大的福气。
福气.py: Háizimen dǒngshì xiàoshùn, lǎorén cháng shuō zhè shì zìjǐ wǎnnián zuì dà de fúqi.
福气.en: With the children being sensible and filial, the elderly man often says this is the greatest blessing of his later years.

辐射.zh: 医护人员在操作放射性设备时必须穿戴铅衣，以减少辐射带来的伤害。
辐射.py: Yīhù rényuán zài cāozuò fàngshèxìng shèbèi shí bìxū chuāndài qiānyī, yǐ jiǎnshǎo fúshè dàilái de shānghài.
辐射.en: Medical personnel must wear lead aprons when operating radioactive equipment to minimize harm from radiation.

附属.zh: 这所小学是该著名大学的附属实验学校，师资力量非常雄厚。
附属.py: Zhè suǒ xiǎoxué shì gāi zhùmíng dàxué de fùshǔ shíyàn xuéxiào, shīzī lìliang fēicháng xiónghòu.
附属.en: This primary school is an affiliated experimental school of that prestigious university, boasting a very strong faculty.

腹泻.zh: 他因为误食了不洁净的生冷食物，导致严重的腹泻和腹痛。
腹泻.py: Tā yīnwèi wùshí le bù jiéjìng de shēnglěng shíwù, dǎozhì yánzhòng de fùxiè hé fùtòng.
腹泻.en: Because he accidentally consumed unhygienic raw food, he suffered from severe diarrhea and abdominal pain.

复兴.zh: 保护和传承非物质文化遗产，对实现优秀传统文化的复兴至关重要。
复兴.py: Bǎohù hé chuánchéng fēiwùzhì wénhuà yíchǎn, duì shíxiàn yōuxiù chuántǒng wénhuà de fùxīng zhìguān zhòngyào.
复兴.en: Protecting and inheriting intangible cultural heritage is vital to achieving the revival of fine traditional culture.

敷衍.zh: 对待工作必须认真负责，决不能敷衍了事。
敷衍.py: Duìdài gōngzuò bìxū rènzhēn fùzé, jué bù néng fūyǎn liǎoshì.
敷衍.en: One must be conscientious and responsible toward work, and never merely go through the motions.

俯仰.zh: 俯仰之间，几十年的光阴已经如流水般悄然流逝。
俯仰.py: Fǔyǎng zhī jiān, jǐshí nián de guāngyīn yǐjīng rú liúshuǐ bān qiǎorán liúshì.
俯仰.en: In the blink of an eye, decades of time have quietly slipped away like flowing water.

盖章.zh: 双方签署协议后，需要由代表签字并盖章，合同方能正式生效。
盖章.py: Shuāngfāng qiānshǔ xiéyì hòu, xūyào yóu dàibiǎo qiānzì bìng gàizhāng, hétong fāng néng zhèngshì shēngxiào.
盖章.en: After both parties sign the agreement, representatives must sign and affix their seals before the contract officially takes effect.

扛.zh: 面对突如其来的困难，他毫不退缩，独自扛起了整个团队的重担。
扛.py: Miànduì tūrúqílái de kùnnan, tā háobù tuìsuō, dúzì káng qǐ le zhěnggè tuánduì de zhòngdàn.
扛.en: Faced with sudden difficulties, he did not shrink back at all and shouldered the heavy burden of the entire team alone.

杠杆.zh: 阿基米德曾说，如果给他一个支点和一根足够长的杠杆，他就能撬动地球。
杠杆.py: Ājīmǐdé céng shuō, rúguǒ gěi tā yí gè zhīdiǎn hé yì gēn zúgòu cháng de gànggǎn, tā jiù néng qiàodòng dìqiú.
杠杆.en: Archimedes once said that if given a fulcrum and a long enough lever, he could move the earth.

纲领.zh: 大会审议并通过了关于未来五年经济社会发展的行动纲领。
纲领.py: Dàhuì shěnyì bìng tōngguò le guānyú wèilái wǔ nián jīngjì shèhuì fāzhǎn de xíngdòng gānglǐng.
纲领.en: The conference deliberated on and adopted the action program for economic and social development over the next five years.

港湾.zh: 暴风雨来临之前，渔船纷纷驶入宁静的港湾避风。
港湾.py: Bàofēngyǔ láilín zhīqián, yúchuán fēnfēn shǐrù níngjìng de gǎngwān bìfēng.
港湾.en: Before the rainstorm arrived, the fishing boats sailed one after another into the tranquil harbor to shelter from the wind.

干劲.zh: 听到项目获得批准的好消息，大家浑身充满了干劲。
干劲.py: Tīngdào xiàngmù huòdé pīzhǔn de hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā húnshēn chōngmǎn le gànjìn.
干劲.en: Hearing the good news that the project had been approved, everyone was filled with drive and enthusiasm.

感慨.zh: 重游阔别多年的故乡，看到家乡巨大的变迁，他心中感慨万千。
感慨.py: Chóngyóu kuòbié duōnián de gùxiāng, kàndào jiāxiāng jùdà de biànqiān, tā xīnzhōng gǎnkǎi wànqiān.
感慨.en: Revisiting the hometown he had been away from for years and witnessing its enormous transformation, he was overwhelmed with deep emotion.

告辞.zh: 天色已晚，客人们纷纷起身向主人告辞。
告辞.py: Tiānsè yǐ wǎn, kèrénmen fēnfēn qǐshēn xiàng zhǔrén gàocí.
告辞.en: As it was getting late, the guests rose one after another to take their leave of the host.

告诫.zh: 父亲经常告诫子女，做人要诚实守信，切莫贪图不义之财。
告诫.py: Fùqīn jīngcháng gàojiè zǐnǚ, zuòrén yào chéngshí shǒuxìn, qiè mò tāntú bùyì zhī cái.
告诫.en: The father often admonished his children that one should be honest and trustworthy, and never covet ill-gotten wealth.

高明.zh: 他提出了一个极为高明的解决方案，巧妙地化解了双方的争端。
高明.py: Tā tíchū le yí gè jíwéi gāomíng de jiějué fāng'àn, qiǎomiào de huàjiě le shuāngfāng de zhēngduān.
高明.en: He proposed an extremely brilliant solution that skillfully defused the dispute between both parties.

高涨.zh: 随着新产品发布会的临近，消费者的购买热情持续高涨。
高涨.py: Suízhe xīn chǎnpǐn fābùhuì de línjìn, xiāofèizhě de gòumǎi rèqíng chíxù gāozhǎng.
高涨.en: As the new product launch approached, consumers' buying enthusiasm continued to soar.

搁.zh: 你先把手头的事情搁一搁，过来帮我处理一下紧急情况。
搁.py: Nǐ xiān bǎ shǒutóu de shìqing gē yi gē, guòlai bāng wǒ chǔlǐ yíxià jǐnjí qíngkuàng.
搁.en: Put aside what you are doing for a moment and come help me deal with an emergency.

隔阂.zh: 双方经过坦诚深入的沟通，终于消除了长久以来的隔阂与误解。
隔阂.py: Shuāngfāng jīngguò tǎnchéng shēnrù de gōutōng, zhōngyú xiāochú le chángjiǔ yǐlái de géhé yǔ wùjiě.
隔阂.en: Through candid and in-depth communication, both sides finally removed the longstanding estrangement and misunderstandings.

格局.zh: 国际形势的变化深刻影响了全球经济的竞争格局。
格局.py: Guójì xíngshì de biànhuà shēnkè yǐngxiǎng le quánqiú jīngjì de jìngzhēng géjú.
格局.en: Changes in international affairs have profoundly influenced the competitive landscape of the global economy.

隔离.zh: 为了防止传染病蔓延，确诊患者需要留在专门的病房接受隔离治疗。
隔离.py: Wèile fángzhǐ chuánrǎnbìng mànyán, quèzhěn huànzhě xūyào liú zài zhuānmén de bìngfáng jiēshòu gélí zhìliáo.
隔离.en: To prevent the spread of infectious disease, confirmed patients need to stay in specialized wards for isolated treatment.

耕地.zh: 严格保护耕地红线，是确保国家粮食安全的重要基础。
耕地.py: Yángé bǎohù gēngdì hóngxiàn, shì quèbǎo guójiā liángshi ānquán de zhòngyào jīchǔ.
耕地.en: Strictly protecting the red line for arable land is an essential foundation for safeguarding national food security.

更正.zh: 报社在发现报道中的数据有误后，立即在次日的头版刊登了更正声明。
