更正.py: Bàoshè zài fāxiàn bàodào zhōng de shùjù yǒuwù hòu, lìjí zài cìrì de tóubǎn kāndēng le gēngzhèng shēngmíng.
更正.en: After discovering an error in the data within the report, the newspaper promptly published a correction statement on the front page the following day.

根深蒂固.zh: 这些陈旧的传统观念在当地村民心中根深蒂固，短期内难以改变。
根深蒂固.py: Zhèxiē chénjiù de chuántǒng guānniàn zài dāngdì cūnmín xīnzhōng gēnshēn-dìgù, duǎnqī nèi nányǐ gǎibiàn.
根深蒂固.en: These outdated traditional ideas are deeply ingrained in the hearts of the local villagers and difficult to change in the short term.

格式.zh: 提交学术论文之前，请务必按照期刊的要求调整排版格式。
格式.py: Tíjiāo xuéshù lùnwén zhīqián, qǐng wùbì ànzhào qīkān de yāoqiú tiáozhěng páibǎn géshì.
格式.en: Before submitting an academic paper, please be sure to adjust the layout format according to the journal's requirements.

各抒己见.zh: 在研讨会上，与会专家围绕城市规划方案各抒己见，展开了热烈讨论。
各抒己见.py: Zài yántǎohuì shang, yùhuì zhuānjiā wéirào chéngshì guīhuà fāng'àn gèshū-jǐjiàn, zhǎnkāi le rèliè tǎolùn.
各抒己见.en: At the seminar, participating experts each voiced their own views on the urban planning proposal and engaged in a lively discussion.

歌颂.zh: 诗人用充满激情的诗句歌颂了劳动者对社会发展所做出的巨大奉献。
歌颂.py: Shīrén yòng chōngmǎn jīqíng de shījù gēsòng le láodòngzhě duì shèhuì fāzhǎn suǒ zuòchū de jùdà fèngxiàn.
歌颂.en: The poet used passionate verses to sing the praises of the immense contributions workers made to social development.

公安局.zh: 居民若遇到护照遗失或身份证明补办，应尽快前往当地公安局的出入境管理部门咨询。
公安局.py: Jūmín ruò yùdào hùzhào yíshī huò shēnfèn zhèngmíng bǔbàn, yīng jǐnkuài qiánwǎng dāngdì gōng'ānjú de chūrùjìng guǎnlǐ bùmén zīxún.
公安局.en: Residents who lose their passports or need replacement identity documents should visit the exit-entry administration department of the local public security bureau as soon as possible.

供不应求.zh: 由于核心芯片短缺，该款新型智能手机自上市以来便处于供不应求的状态。
供不应求.py: Yóuyú héxīn xīnpiàn duǎnquē, gāi kuǎn xīnxíng zhìnéng shǒujī zì shàngshì yǐlái biàn chǔyú gōngbùyìngqiú de zhuàngtài.
供不应求.en: Due to a shortage of core chips, this new smartphone has been in a state where demand exceeds supply ever since it hit the market.

公道.zh: 这家老字号餐馆不仅饭菜可口，而且价格公道，因此深受附近居民的喜爱。
公道.py: Zhè jiā lǎozìhào cānguǎn bùjǐn fàncài kěkǒu, érqiě jiàgé gōngdào, yīncǐ shēn shòu fùjìn jūmín de xǐ'ài.
公道.en: This time-honored restaurant not only serves delicious meals but also charges fair prices, making it a favorite among nearby residents.

攻克.zh: 科研团队经过数年的不懈努力，终于成功攻克了这项困扰行业多年的技术难关。
攻克.py: Kēyán tuánduì jīngguò shù nián de bùxiè nǔlì, zhōngyú chénggōng gōngkè le zhè xiàng kùnrǎo hángyè duō nián de jìshù nánguān.
攻克.en: After years of unremitting effort, the scientific research team finally succeeded in overcoming this technical hurdle that had plagued the industry for years.

功劳.zh: 项目能够提前圆满完成，全体团队成员各司其职、通力合作是最大的功劳。
功劳.py: Xiàngmù nénggòu tíqián yuánmǎn wánchéng, quántǐ tuánduì chéngyuán gè sī qí zhí, tōnglì hézuò shì zuìdà de gōngláo.
功劳.en: That the project was completed smoothly ahead of schedule is largely thanks to the meritorious contributions of all team members fulfilling their duties and collaborating closely.

共鸣.zh: 这部记录普通人奋斗历程的纪录片真实感人，在广大青年观众中引起了强烈共鸣。
共鸣.py: Zhè bù jìlù pǔtōngrén fèndòu lìchéng de jìlùpiàn zhēnshí gǎnrén, zài guǎngdà qīngnián guānzhòng zhōng yǐnqǐ le qiángliè gòngmíng.
共鸣.en: This documentary portraying ordinary people's struggles was authentic and touching, eliciting a strong resonance among young audiences.

公婆.zh: 结婚之后，她每个周末都会陪着丈夫回老家探望公婆。
公婆.py: Jiéhūn zhīhòu, tā měi gè zhōumò dōuhuì péizhe zhàngfu huí lǎojiā tànwàng gōngpó.
公婆.en: After getting married, she accompanies her husband back to his hometown every weekend to visit her parents-in-law.

公然.zh: 任何企业都不得公然违反环保法规向河流排放未经处理的工业废水。
公然.py: Rènhé qǐyè dōu bùdé gōngrán wéifǎn huánbǎo fǎguī xiàng héliú páifàng wèijīng chǔlǐ de gōngyè fèishuǐ.
公然.en: No enterprise is permitted to openly violate environmental regulations by discharging untreated industrial wastewater into rivers.

公务.zh: 市长此次出访主要是为了执行招商引资的公务，行程安排得非常紧凑。
公务.py: Shìzhǎng cǐcì chūfǎng zhǔyào shì wèile zhíxíng zhāoshāng yǐnzī de gōngwù, xíngchéng ānpái de fēicháng jǐncòu.
公务.en: The mayor's foreign visit was primarily to conduct official business regarding investment attraction, and the itinerary was tightly scheduled.

公证.zh: 出国留学前，学生需要携带毕业证书原件及翻译件去公证处办理公证手续。
公证.py: Chūguó liúxué qián, xuésheng xūyào xiédài bìyè zhèngshū yuánjiàn jí fānyìjiàn qù gōngzhèngchù bànlǐ gōngzhèng shǒuxù.
公证.en: Before studying abroad, students need to bring their original graduation certificates and translations to the notary office to complete notarization procedures.

勾结.zh: 经调查，某些中介机构勾结内部人员非法套取客户个人隐私信息。
勾结.py: Jīng diàochá, mǒuxiē zhōngjiè jīgòu gōujié nèibù rényuán fēifǎ tàoqǔ kèhù gèrén yǐnsī xìnxī.
勾结.en: An investigation revealed that certain intermediary agencies colluded with internal staff to illegally obtain clients' private personal information.

构思.zh: 建筑师在构思这座文化艺术中心的外观时，巧妙地融入了中国传统折扇的元素。
构思.py: Jiànzhùshī zài gòusī zhè zuò wénhuà yìshù zhōngxīn de wàiguān shí, qiǎomiào de róngrù le Zhōngguó chuántǒng zhéshàn de yuánsù.
构思.en: When conceiving the exterior of this cultural and arts center, the architect ingeniously integrated elements of traditional Chinese folding fans.

贯彻.zh: 公司领导层要求各部门认真贯彻新的安全生产管理规程，消除潜在隐患。
贯彻.py: Gōngsī lǐngdǎocéng yāoqiú gè bùmén rènzhēn guànchè xīn de ānquán shēngchǎn guǎnlǐ guīchéng, xiāochú qiánzài yǐnhuàn.
贯彻.en: The company management instructed all departments to conscientiously implement the new safety production management procedures and eliminate potential hazards.

灌溉.zh: 当地兴修了现代化的水利工程，利用干渠有效灌溉了数万亩干旱的农田。
灌溉.py: Dāngdì xīngxiū le xiàndàihuà de shuǐlì gōngchéng, lìyòng gànqú yǒuxiào guàngài le shù wàn mǔ gānhàn de nóngtián.
灌溉.en: The local area constructed modern water conservancy works, utilizing main canals to effectively irrigate tens of thousands of acres of arid farmland.

光彩.zh: 她站在颁奖典礼的领奖台上，从容优雅的仪态让她整个人光彩照人。
光彩.py: Tā zhàn zài bānjiǎng diǎnlǐ de lǐngjiǎngtái shang, cóngróng yōuyǎ de yítài ràng tā zhěngrén guāngcǎi zhàorén.
光彩.en: Standing on the podium at the awards ceremony, her composed and elegant demeanor made her radiate with splendor.

光辉.zh: 老教授将毕生心血奉献给了祖国的教育事业，书写了光辉而充实的一生。
光辉.py: Lǎo jiàoshòu jiāng bìshēng xīnxuè fèngxiàn gěi le zǔguó de jiàoyù shìyè, shūxiě le guānghuī ér chōngshí de yìshēng.
光辉.en: The old professor dedicated his life's blood to the nation's educational cause, authoring a glorious and fulfilling life.

光芒.zh: 清晨的第一缕阳光透过层层薄雾，在平静的海面上洒下耀眼的光芒。
光芒.py: Qīngchén de dì yī lǚ yángguāng tòuguò céngcéng bówù, zài píngjìng de hǎimiàn shang sǎxià yàoyǎn de guāngmáng.
光芒.en: The first ray of morning sunlight penetrated through layers of mist, casting a brilliant glow upon the calm sea surface.

惯例.zh: 按照国际外交惯例，两国元首会晤后双方将共同签署联合公报。
惯例.py: Ànzhào guójì wàijiāo guànlì, liǎng guó yuánshǒu huìwù hòu shuāngfāng jiāng gòngtóng qiānshǔ liánhé gōngbào.
惯例.en: In accordance with international diplomatic convention, after the two heads of state meet, both parties will jointly sign a joint communique.

管辖.zh: 该水域属于国家级自然保护区的管辖范围，严禁任何捕捞和商业开发活动。
管辖.py: Gāi shuǐyù shǔyú guójiājí zìrán bǎohùqū de guǎnxiá fànwéi, yánjìn rènhé bǔlāo hé shāngyè kāifā huódòng.
管辖.en: These waters fall under the jurisdiction of the national nature reserve, where all fishing and commercial development activities are strictly prohibited.

鼓动.zh: 他在集会上极力鼓动大家共同参与社区绿化改善行动。
鼓动.py: Tā zài jíhuì shang jílì gǔdòng dàjiā gòngtóng cānyù shèqū lǜhuà gǎishàn xíngdòng.
鼓动.en: At the gathering, he vigorously encouraged everyone to participate together in the community greening improvement initiative.

股份.zh: 为了激励核心技术人才，这家初创科技企业决定向高级工程师分配期权股份。
股份.py: Wèile jīlì héxīn jìshù réncái, zhè jiā chūchuàng kējì qǐyè juédìng xiàng gāojí gōngchéngshī fēnpèi qīquán gǔfèn.
股份.en: To incentivize core technical talent, this tech startup decided to allocate stock options to senior engineers.

骨干.zh: 医院每年都会选派一批年轻的业务骨干前往海外知名医疗机构进修学习。
骨干.py: Yīyuàn měinián dōuhuì xuǎnpài yī pī niánqīng de yèwù gǔgàn qiánwǎng hǎiwài zhīmíng yīliáo jīgòu jìnxiū xuéxí.
骨干.en: Every year, the hospital selects a group of young core personnel to pursue advanced studies at renowned medical institutions overseas.

规格.zh: 生产线上所有的精密零件都必须严格符合国家标准所规定的尺寸规格。
规格.py: Shēngchǎnxiàn shang suǒyǒu de jīngmì língjiàn dōu bìxū yángé fúhé guójiā biāozhǔn suǒ guīdìng de chǐcùn guīgé.
规格.en: All precision components on the production line must strictly conform to the dimensional specifications stipulated by national standards.

归根到底.zh: 企业之间的激烈竞争，归根到底还是人才素质与科技创新能力的竞争。
归根到底.py: Qǐyè zhījiān de jīliè jìngzhēng, guīgēndàodǐ hái shì réncái sùzhì yǔ kējì chuàngxīn nénglì de jìngzhēng.
归根到底.en: The fierce competition among enterprises, in the final analysis, comes down to competition in talent caliber and technological innovation capacity.

归纳.zh: 导师建议同学们在阅读大量学术文献后，尝试归纳出当前研究的主要争议焦点。
归纳.py: Dǎoshī jiànyì tóngxuémen zài yuèdú dàliàng xuéshù wénxiàn hòu, chángshì guīnà chū dāngqián yánjiū de zhǔyào zhēngyì jiāodiǎn.
归纳.en: The advisor suggested that after reading extensive academic literature, students should attempt to summarize the main focal points of contention in current research.

规章.zh: 新入职的员工必须认真学习本单位的各项内部管理规章，自觉遵守劳动纪律。
规章.py: Xīn rùzhí de yuángōng bìxū rènzhēn xuéxí běn dānwèi de gè xiàng nèibù guǎnlǐ guīzhāng, zìjué zūnshǒu láodòng jìlǜ.
规章.en: Newly recruited employees must carefully study the unit's internal management regulations and conscientiously observe labor discipline.

顾虑.zh: 面对即将开启的跨国合作项目，投资者依然对汇率波动带来的财务风险存有顾虑。
顾虑.py: Miànduì jíjiāng kāiqǐ de kuàguó hézuò xiàngmù, tóuzīzhě yīrán duì huìlǜ bōdòng dàilái de cáiwù fēngxiǎn cúnyǒu gùlǜ.
顾虑.en: Facing the upcoming cross-border collaborative project, investors still harbor misgivings about financial risks brought on by exchange rate fluctuations.

棍棒.zh: 现代家庭教育更加倡导平等沟通与说理，而不是简单粗暴地依赖棍棒体罚。
棍棒.py: Xiàndài jiātíng jiàoyù gèngjiā chàngdǎo píngděng gōutōng yǔ shuōlǐ, ér bù shì jiǎndān cūbào de yīlài gùnbàng tǐfá.
棍棒.en: Modern family education advocates equal communication and reasoning rather than relying simplistically and brutally on corporal punishment with sticks.

国防.zh: 维护国家的和平稳定与领土完整，是建设现代化坚强国防的核心目标。
国防.py: Wéihù guójiā de hépíng wěndìng yǔ lǐngtǔ wánzhěng, shì jiànshè xiàndàihuà jiānqiáng guófáng de héxīn mùbiāo.
国防.en: Safeguarding the nation's peace, stability, and territorial integrity is the core objective of building a modern, formidable national defense.

过滤.zh: 这种高端净水装置能够高效过滤自来水中的微小杂质、余氯和有害细菌。
过滤.py: Zhè zhǒng gāoduān jìngshuǐ zhuāngzhì nénggòu gāoxiào guòlǜ zìláishuǐ zhōng de wēixiǎo zázhì, yúlǜ hé yǒuhài xìjūn.
过滤.en: This high-end water purifier can efficiently filter minute impurities, residual chlorine, and harmful bacteria from tap water.

过失.zh: 由于现场操作人员的疏忽过失，实验室的一台精密测量仪器受到了严重损坏。
过失.py: Yóuyú xiànchǎng cāozuò rényuán de shūhu guòshī, shíyànshì de yī tái jīngmì cèliáng yíqì shòudào le yánzhòng sǔnhuài.
过失.en: Due to the negligence and error of the on-site operator, a precision measuring instrument in the laboratory was severely damaged.

国务院.zh: 国务院常务会议审议并通过了一系列支持民营经济高质量发展的新政策。
国务院.py: Guówùyuàn chángwù huìyì shěnyì bìng tōngguò le yí xìliè zhīchí mínyíng jīngjì gāo zhìliàng fāzhǎn de xīn zhèngcè.
国务院.en: The executive meeting of the State Council deliberated and adopted a series of new policies supporting the high-quality development of the private economy.

过瘾.zh: 在炎热的夏日午后，痛痛快快地游完泳再喝上一大杯冰镇西瓜汁，别提多过瘾了。
过瘾.py: Zài yánrè de xiàrì wǔhòu, tòngtòngkuàikuài de yóuwán yǒng zài hē shang yí dà bēi bīngzhèn xīguāzhī, biétí duō guòyǐn le.
过瘾.en: On a scorching summer afternoon, having an invigorating swim followed by a huge cup of iced watermelon juice is wonderfully satisfying.

姑且.zh: 既然双方对合作细节尚有分歧，我们姑且搁置争议，先推进达成共识的部分。
姑且.py: Jìrán shuāngfāng duì hézuò xìjié shàng yǒu fēnqí, wǒmen gūqiě gēzhì zhēngyì, xiān tuījìn dáchéng gòngshí de bùfen.
姑且.en: Since both parties still have disagreements over cooperation details, let us tentatively shelve the disputes for now and first advance the parts where consensus has been reached.

固然.zh: 追求经济效益固然重要，但企业绝不能以牺牲生态环境为代价来换取短期利润。
固然.py: Zhuīqiú jīngjì xiàoyì gùrán zhòngyào, dàn qǐyè jué bùnéng yǐ xīshēng shēngtài huánjìng wéi dàijià lái huànqǔ duǎnqī lìrùn.
固然.en: While pursuing economic benefits is admittedly important, enterprises must never sacrifice the ecological environment in exchange for short-term profits.

嗨.zh: 嗨！好久不见，没想到能在这场国际学术研讨会上碰见你。
嗨.py: Hāi! Hǎojiǔ bú jiàn, méi xiǎngdào néng zài zhè chǎng guójì xuéshù yántǎohuì shang pèngjiàn nǐ.
嗨.en: Hey! Long time no see; I didn't expect to run into you at this international academic symposium.

海滨.zh: 每年盛夏，成千上万的中外游客都会涌向这座风光旖旎的海滨度假胜地。
海滨.py: Měinián shèngxià, chéng qiān shàng wàn de zhōngwài yóukè dōuhuì yǒngxiàng zhè zuò fēngguāng yǐnǐ de hǎibīn dùjià shèngdì.
海滨.en: Every midsummer, thousands of domestic and foreign tourists flock to this scenic seaside resort destination.

行列.zh: 经过持续的技术革新，该企业成功跨入了全球顶级高端装备制造商的行列。
行列.py: Jīngguò chíxù de jìshù gēxīn, gāi qǐyè chénggōng kuàrù le quánqiú dǐngjí gāoduān zhuāngbèi zhìzàoshāng de hángliè.
行列.en: Through ongoing technological innovation, the enterprise successfully joined the ranks of the world's top high-end equipment manufacturers.

航天.zh: 空间站核心舱的顺利在轨运行，标志着我国载人航天工程迈入了全新阶段。
航天.py: Kōngjiānzhàn héxīncāng de shùnlì zàiguǐ yùnxíng, biāozhì zhe wǒguó zàirén hángtiān gōngchéng màirù le quánxīn jiēduàn.
航天.en: The smooth in-orbit operation of the space station's core module marks a brand-new stage for our country's manned space flight program.

含糊.zh: 发言人在面对记者的关键提问时辞令含糊，没有给出任何明确的正面回应。
含糊.py: Fāyánrén zài miànduì jìzhě de guānjiàn tíwèn shí cílìng hánhu, méiyǒu gěichū rènhé míngquè de zhèngmiàn huíyìng.
含糊.en: When faced with key questions from reporters, the spokesperson's wording was vague and offered no clear, direct response.

捍卫.zh: 作为一名职业法律工作者，他始终坚定地捍卫法律的尊严与公民的合法权益。
捍卫.py: Zuòwéi yī míng zhíyè fǎlǜ gōngzuòzhě, tā shǐzhōng jiāndìng de hànwèi fǎlǜ de zūnyán yǔ gōngmín de héfǎ quányì.
捍卫.en: As a professional legal practitioner, he has always steadfastly defended the dignity of the law and the legitimate rights and interests of citizens.

寒暄.zh: 两位多年未见的老友在酒店大堂热情寒暄了几句，随后便一同前往餐厅叙旧。
寒暄.py: Liǎng wèi duō nián wèi jiàn de lǎoyǒu zài jiǔdiàn dàtáng rèqíng hánxuān le jǐ jù, suíhòu biàn yītóng qiánwǎng cāntīng xùjiù.
寒暄.en: The two old friends who had not seen each other for years exchanged warm pleasantries in the hotel lobby and then headed to the restaurant together to reminisce.

耗费.zh: 编写这部综合性历史巨著耗费了专家学者们整整二十年的光阴与心血。
耗费.py: Biānxiě zhè bù zōnghéxìng lìshǐ jùzhù hàofèi le zhuānjiā xuézhěmen zhěngzhěng èrshí nián de guāngyīn yǔ xīnxuè.
耗费.en: Compiling this comprehensive historical masterpiece consumed a full twenty years of time and painstaking effort of the experts and scholars.

豪迈.zh: 雄伟的交响乐与诗歌交相辉映，展现出战士们奔赴前线时的豪迈气概。
豪迈.py: Xióngwěi de jiāoxiǎngyuè yǔ shīgē jiāoxiāng huìyìng, zhǎnxiàn chū zhànshìmen bēnfù qiánxiàn shí de háomài qìgài.
豪迈.en: The majestic symphony and poetry complemented each other, showcasing the heroic and bold spirit of the soldiers as they marched to the front lines.

和解.zh: 经过法官多轮耐心的调解工作，双方当事人最终达成和解，化解了长达三年的财产纠纷。
和解.py: Jīngguò fǎguān duō lún nàixīn de tiáojiě gōngzuò, shuāngfāng dāngshìrén zuìzhōng dáchéng héjiě, huàjiě le cháng dá sān nián de cáichǎn jiūfēn.
和解.en: After multiple rounds of patient mediation by the judge, both parties ultimately reached a settlement, resolving a property dispute that had lasted three years.

和睦.zh: 邻里之间若能互相包容、守望相助，整个社区的氛围自然会变得非常和睦。
和睦.py: Línlǐ zhījiān ruò néng hùxiāng bāoróng, shǒuwàngxiāngzhù, zhěnggè shèqū de fēnwéi zìrán huì biànde fēicháng hémù.
和睦.en: If neighbors can be tolerant of one another and watch out for each other, the atmosphere of the entire community will naturally become very harmonious.

恨不得.zh: 接到母亲病愈出院的喜讯后，在外求学的他恨不得立刻买票飞回故乡。
恨不得.py: Jiēdào mǔqīn bìngyù chūyuàn de xǐxùn hòu, zàiwài qiúxué de tā hènbu dé lìkè mǎi piào fēi huí gùxiāng.
恨不得.en: Upon receiving the good news that his mother had recovered and was discharged from the hospital, he, studying away from home, was dying to buy a ticket immediately and fly back to his hometown.

哼.zh: 面对对手毫无根据的冷嘲热讽，他只是冷哼了一声，根本不予理睬。
哼.py: Miànduì duìshǒu háowú gēnjù de lěngcháorèfěng, tā zhǐshì lěng hēng le yī shēng, gēnběn bù yǔ lǐcǎi.
哼.en: Facing his opponent's unfounded sarcasm, he merely gave a cold snort and ignored it completely.

狠心.zh: 为了让孩子早日独立生活并适应艰苦环境，父母狠心拒绝了为他继续提供额外资助。
狠心.py: Wèile ràng háizi zǎorì dúlì shēnghuó bìng shìyìng jiānkǔ huánjìng, fùmǔ hěnxīn jùjué le wèi tā jìxù tígōng éwài zīzhù.
狠心.en: In order to help their child become independent early and adapt to challenging environments, the parents steeled their hearts and refused to continue providing him with extra financial support.

和气.zh: 这家杂货店的老板待人和气，因此吸引了不少老顾客。
和气.py: Zhè jiā záhuòdiàn de lǎobǎn dài rén héqi, yīncǐ xīyǐn le bù shǎo lǎo gùkè.
和气.en: The grocery store owner treats people amiably, which has attracted many regular customers.

合身.zh: 这套西装是根据他的体型量身定做的，穿起来非常合身。
合身.py: Zhè tào xīzhuāng shì gēnjù tā de tǐxíng liángshēn dìngzuò de, chuān qǐlai fēicháng héshēn.
合身.en: This suit was tailored to his measurements, and it fits him perfectly.

合算.zh: 如果你每天都要坐地铁上班，买月票会更合算一些。
合算.py: Rúguǒ nǐ měitiān dōu yào zuò dìtiě shàngbān, mǎi yuèpiào huì gèng hésuàn yīxiē.
合算.en: If you commute by subway every day, buying a monthly pass is much more economical.

哄.zh: 他的幽默模仿逗得台下的观众哄堂大笑。
哄.py: Tā de yōumò mófǎng dòu de táixià de guānzhòng hōngtáng-dàxiào.
哄.en: His humorous imitation made the audience burst into hearty laughter.

烘.zh: 面包房里正在烘烤新出炉的法棍，香气弥漫了整条街。
烘.py: Miànbāofáng lǐ zhèngzài hōngkǎo xīn chūlú de fǎgùn, xiāngqì mímàn le zhěng tiáo jiē.
烘.en: The bakery was baking fresh baguettes, and the aroma filled the entire street.

宏观.zh: 政府正在通过宏观调控手段来稳定房地产市场的健康发展。
宏观.py: Zhèngfǔ zhèngzài tōngguò hóngguān tiáokòng shǒuduàn lái wěndìng fángdìchǎn shìchǎng de jiànkāng fāzhǎn.
宏观.en: The government is using macroeconomic control measures to stabilize the healthy development of the real estate market.

宏伟.zh: 这座依山而建的古老宫殿规模宏伟，气势十分恢宏。
宏伟.py: Zhè zuò yī shān ér jiàn de gǔlǎo gōngdiàn guīmó hóngwěi, qìshì shífēn huīhóng.
宏伟.en: This ancient palace built against the mountain is grand in scale and magnificent in presence.

吼.zh: 狂风在海面上怒吼，掀起了数米高的巨浪。
吼.py: Kuángfēng zài hǎimiàn shang nùhǒu, xiānqǐ le shù mǐ gāo de jùlàng.
吼.en: The gale roared across the sea, whipping up waves several meters high.

后顾之忧.zh: 完善的医疗和养老保障体系解决了工人们的后顾之忧。
后顾之忧.py: Wánshàn de yīliáo hé yǎnglǎo bǎozhàng tǐxì jiějué le gōngrénmen de hòugùzhīyōu.
后顾之忧.en: A comprehensive medical and pension system eliminated the workers' worries about the future.

后勤.zh: 运动会能够顺利举行，离不开后勤部门周密细致的保障。
后勤.py: Yùndònghuì nénggòu shùnlì jǔxíng, lí bù kāi hòuqín bùmén zhōumì xìzhì de bǎozhàng.
后勤.en: The smooth running of the sports games is inseparable from the meticulous support of the logistics department.

花瓣.zh: 春风吹过，粉红色的樱花花瓣如雪片般纷纷飘落。
花瓣.py: Chūnfēng chuīguò, fěnhóngsè de yīnghuā huābàn rú xuěpiàn bān fēnfēn piāoluò.
花瓣.en: When the spring breeze blew, the pink cherry blossom petals drifted down like snowflakes.

化肥.zh: 过度使用化肥会导致土壤板结，甚至污染周边地下水。
化肥.py: Guòdù shǐyòng huàféi huì dǎozhì tǔrǎng bǎnjié, shènzhì wūrǎn zhōubiān dìxiàshuǐ.
化肥.en: Excessive use of chemical fertilizers can cause soil compaction and even contaminate surrounding groundwater.

荒凉.zh: 穿过这片寸草不生的荒凉戈壁，才能抵达绿洲城镇。
荒凉.py: Chuānguò zhè piàn cùncǎobùshēng de huāngliáng gēbì, cái néng dǐdá lǜzhōu chéngzhèn.
荒凉.en: Only by crossing this desolate, barren Gobi desert can one reach the oasis town.

恍然大悟.zh: 听了老师深入浅出的讲解，困惑已久的他终于恍然大悟。
恍然大悟.py: Tīng le lǎoshī shēnrù-qiǎnchū de jiǎngjiě, kùnhuò yǐ jiǔ de tā zhōngyú huǎngrándàwù.
恍然大悟.en: After listening to the teacher's accessible explanation, he who had been confused for a long time finally saw the light.

缓和.zh: 经过多轮艰苦的外交谈判，两国之间的紧张局势终于有所缓和。
缓和.py: Jīngguò duō lún jiānkǔ de wàijiāo tánpàn, liǎng guó zhījiān de jǐnzhāng júshì zhōngyú yǒu suǒ huǎnhé.
缓和.en: After several rounds of arduous diplomatic negotiations, the tension between the two countries has finally eased.

华侨.zh: 许多旅居海外的华侨始终心系祖国，积极支持家乡的教育事业。
华侨.py: Xǔduō lǚjū hǎiwài de Huáqiáo shǐzhōng xīn xì zǔguó, jījí zhīchí jiāxiāng de jiàoyù shìyè.
华侨.en: Many overseas Chinese living abroad always care deeply about their homeland and actively support education in their hometowns.

化验.zh: 医生建议他先去化验血液，以便更准确地查明病因。
化验.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā xiān qù huàyàn xuèyè, yǐbiàn gèng zhǔnquè de chámíng bìngyīn.
化验.en: The doctor suggested that he first do a blood test to more accurately determine the cause of the illness.

悔恨.zh: 他为自己当初一时冲动所犯下的过错感到无比悔恨。
悔恨.py: Tā wèi zìjǐ dāngchū yīshí chōngdòng suǒ fànxià de guòcuò gǎndào wúbǐ huǐhèn.
悔恨.en: He felt immense remorse for the mistake he made in an impulsive moment.

辉煌.zh: 这支年轻的球队凭借顽强的拼搏精神，创造了辉煌的战绩。
辉煌.py: Zhè zhī niánqīng de qiúduì píngjiè wánqiáng de pīnbó jīngshén, chuàngzào le huīhuáng de zhànjì.
辉煌.en: With their tenacious fighting spirit, this young team achieved glorious results.

挥霍.zh: 他不知珍惜父辈积攒的财富，短短几年就将遗产挥霍一空。
挥霍.py: Tā bù zhī zhēnxī fùbèi jīzǎn de cáifù, duǎnduǎn jǐ nián jiù jiāng yíchǎn huīhuò yī kōng.
挥霍.en: Not knowing how to cherish the wealth accumulated by his parents, he squandered his entire inheritance in just a few years.

贿赂.zh: 任何企图通过贿赂官员来获取商业利益的行为都是违法的。
贿赂.py: Rènhé qǐtú tōngguò huìlù guānyuán lái huòqǔ shāngyè lìyì de xíngwéi dōu shì wéifǎ de.
贿赂.en: Any attempt to gain commercial interests by bribing officials is illegal.

毁灭.zh: 那场突如其来的巨大火山爆发彻底毁灭了繁华的庞贝古城。
毁灭.py: Nà chǎng tūrúqílái de jùdà huǒshān bàofā chèdǐ huǐmiè le fánhuá de Pángbèi gǔchéng.
毁灭.en: That sudden massive volcanic eruption completely destroyed the bustling ancient city of Pompeii.

会晤.zh: 两国领导人在峰会期间举行了长达两小时的闭门会晤。
会晤.py: Liǎng guó lǐngdǎorén zài fēnghuì qījiān jǔxíng le cháng dá liǎng xiǎoshí de bìmén huìwù.
会晤.en: The leaders of the two countries held a two-hour closed-door meeting during the summit.

浑身.zh: 徒步爬上高耸的山顶之后，他累得浑身酸痛，动弹不得。
浑身.py: Túbù pá shàng gāosǒng de shāndǐng zhīhòu, tā lèi de húnshēn suāntòng, dòngtan bù dé.
浑身.en: After hiking to the high mountain peak, he was so tired that he ached all over and could hardly move.

混浊.zh: 连续几天的暴雨过后，原本清澈见底的溪水变得异常混浊。
混浊.py: Liánxù jǐ tiān de bàoyǔ guòhòu, yuánběn qīngchè jiàn dǐ de xīshuǐ biàn de yìcháng hùnzhuó.
混浊.en: After several consecutive days of torrential rain, the creek water, which was once crystal clear, became exceptionally turbid.

活该.zh: 朋友们早就提醒过他注意防范风险，他不听劝告导致亏损，真是活该。
活该.py: Péngyoumen zǎojiù tíxǐng guò tā zhùyì fángfàn fēngxiǎn, tā bù tīng quàngào dǎozhì kuīsǔn, zhēnshi huógāi.
活该.en: His friends had warned him long ago to guard against risks; he ignored their advice and suffered losses, so it serves him right.

火药.zh: 火药作为中国古代四大发明之一，对人类军事与文明进程产生了深远影响。
火药.py: Huǒyào zuòwéi Zhōngguó gǔdài sì dà fāmíng zhī yī, duì rénlèi jūnshì yǔ wénmíng jìnchéng chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
火药.en: As one of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China, gunpowder had a profound impact on the course of human military history and civilization.

呼啸.zh: 高速列车伴随着呼啸的风声从站台飞驰而过。
呼啸.py: Gāosù lièchē bànsuí zhe hūxiào de fēngshēng cóng zhàntái fēichí ér guò.
呼啸.en: The high-speed train sped past the platform accompanied by the whistling sound of the wind.

呼吁.zh: 环保组织呼吁公众减少使用一次性塑料制品，以保护海洋生态。
呼吁.py: Huánbǎo zǔzhī hūyù gōngzhòng jiǎnshǎo shǐyòng yīcìxìng sùliào zhìpǐn, yǐ bǎohù hǎiyáng shēngtài.
呼吁.en: Environmental organizations appeal to the public to reduce the use of single-use plastics to protect marine ecosystems.

拣.zh: 母亲在菜市场耐心地拣出最新鲜的水果放入菜篮。
拣.py: Mǔqīn zài càishìchǎng nàixīn de jiǎn chū zuì xīnxiān de shuǐguǒ fàng rù càilán.
拣.en: Mother patiently picked out the freshest fruit at the food market and put it into her shopping basket.

溅.zh: 汽车飞快驶过路边的水坑，溅了路人一身泥水。
溅.py: Qìchē fēikuài shǐguò lùbiān de shuǐkēng, jiàn le lùrén yī shēn níshuǐ.
溅.en: The car sped through a roadside puddle, splashing muddy water all over the pedestrians.

鉴别.zh: 专家借助显微镜仔细观察瓷器的釉色，以鉴别其真伪。
鉴别.py: Zhuānjiā jièzhù xiǎnwéijìng zǐxì guānchá cíqì de yòusè, yǐ jiànbié qí zhēnwěi.
鉴别.en: Using a microscope, the expert carefully examined the glaze color of the porcelain to authenticate whether it was genuine or fake.

剪彩.zh: 市长受邀出席新图书馆的落成典礼，并为开馆仪式剪彩。
剪彩.py: Shìzhǎng shòuyāo chūxí xīn túshūguǎn de luòchéng diǎnlǐ, bìng wèi kāiguǎn yíshì jiǎncǎi.
剪彩.en: The mayor was invited to attend the inauguration ceremony of the new library and cut the ribbon for the opening.

尖端.zh: 这家科研机构聚集了众多人才，致力于尖端半导体技术的研发。
尖端.py: Zhè jiā kēyán jīgòu jùjí le zhòngduō réncái, zhìlì yú jiānduān bàndǎotǐ jìshù de yánfā.
尖端.en: This scientific research institute brings together many talents dedicated to the research and development of cutting-edge semiconductor technology.

见多识广.zh: 他多年来游历了数十个国家，见多识广，谈吐十分幽默风趣。
见多识广.py: Tā duōnián lái yóulì le shù shí gè guójiā, jiànduō-shíguǎng, tántù shífēn yōumò fēngqù.
见多识广.en: Having traveled to dozens of countries over the years, he is widely experienced and knowledgeable, and converses with great wit and humor.

桨.zh: 选手们整齐划一地摇动着船桨，赛艇飞速向前驶去。
桨.py: Xuǎnshǒumen zhěngqí-huàyī de yáodòng zhe chuánjiǎng, sàitǐng fēisù xiàng qián shǐ qù.
桨.en: The rowers pulled the oars in perfect unison, and the rowing boat shot forward at high speed.

奖赏.zh: 公司设立了丰厚的高额奖金，以奖赏在技术创新中作出突出贡献的员工。
奖赏.py: Gōngsī shèlì le fēnghòu de gāo'é jiǎngjīn, yǐ jiǎngshǎng zài jìshù chuàngxīn zhōng zuòchū tūchū gòngxiàn de yuángōng.
奖赏.en: The company established generous bonuses to reward employees who made outstanding contributions to technological innovation.

简陋.zh: 虽然山村小学的办学条件十分简陋，但孩子们依然渴望求知。
简陋.py: Suīrán shāncūn xiǎoxué de bànxué tiáojiàn shífēn jiǎnlòu, dàn háizimen yīrán kěwàng qiúzhī.
简陋.en: Although the facilities of the mountain village primary school are very rudimentary, the children remain eager to learn.

监视.zh: 警方通过街头的安防摄像头，二十四小时密切监视该区域的可疑动向。
监视.py: Jǐngfāng tōngguò jiētóu de ānfáng shèxiàngtóu, èrshísì xiǎoshí mìqiè jiānshì gāi qūyù de kěyí dòngxiàng.
监视.en: Through street security cameras, the police closely monitored suspicious movements in the area 24 hours a day.

践踏.zh: 游客在公园游览时应自觉爱护花草，切勿随意践踏草坪。
践踏.py: Yóukè zài gōngyuán yóulǎn shí yīng zìjué àihù huācǎo, qièwù suíyì jiàntà cǎopíng.
践踏.en: When visiting the park, tourists should consciously protect plants and avoid trampling the lawn.

检讨.zh: 项目失败后，整个团队进行了深刻的检讨，认真分析了失误的原因。
检讨.py: Xiàngmù shībài hòu, zhěnggè tuánduì jìnxíng le shēnkè de jiǎntǎo, rènzhēn fēnxī le shīwù de yuányīn.
检讨.en: After the project failed, the entire team conducted a deep self-examination and thoroughly analyzed the reasons for the errors.

舰艇.zh: 多艘现代化的海军舰艇在领海边界顺利完成了远洋巡航任务。
舰艇.py: Duō sōu xiàndàihuà de hǎijūn jiàntǐng zài lǐnghǎi biānjiè shùnlì wánchéng le yuǎnyáng xúnháng rènwu.
舰艇.en: Several modern naval warships successfully completed an ocean patrol mission along the territorial waters boundary.

见闻.zh: 他将自己在这次跨国考察中的丰富见闻整理成了一本旅行札记。
见闻.py: Tā jiāng zìjǐ zài zhè cì kuàguó kǎochá zhōng de fēngfù jiànwén zhěnglǐ chéng le yī běn lǚxíng zhájì.
见闻.en: He compiled his rich experiences and observations from this international expedition into a travel book.

简要.zh: 在正式讨论开始前，经理向大家简要介绍了本次会议的主要议题。
简要.py: Zài zhèngshì tǎolùn kāishǐ qián, jīnglǐ xiàng dàjiā jiǎnyào jièshào le běn cì huìyì de zhǔyào yìtí.
简要.en: Before the formal discussion began, the manager briefly introduced the main topics of this meeting to everyone.

鉴于.zh: 鉴于近期恶劣的暴风雪天气，组委会决定将室外比赛推迟举行。
鉴于.py: Jiànyú jìnqī èliè de bàofēngxuě tiānqì, zǔwěihuì juédìng jiāng shìwài bǐsài tuīchí jǔxíng.
鉴于.en: In view of the recent severe blizzard weather, the organizing committee decided to postpone the outdoor competition.

较量.zh: 经过几个回合的激烈较量，他终于战胜了实力强劲的卫冕冠军。
较量.py: Jīngguò jǐ gè huíhé de jīliè jiàoliàng, tā zhōngyú zhànshèng le shílì qiángjìng de wèimiǎn guànjūn.
较量.en: After several rounds of fierce contest, he finally defeated the formidable defending champion.

缴纳.zh: 所有企业都应当依法按时足额缴纳各项税费。
缴纳.py: Suǒyǒu qǐyè dōu yīngdāng yīfǎ ànshí zú'é jiǎonà gè xiàng shuìfèi.
缴纳.en: All enterprises should pay all taxes and fees in full and on time according to law.

娇气.zh: 他虽然从小生活在城市，但在艰苦的野外训练中一点儿也不娇气。
娇气.py: Tā suīrán cóngxiǎo shēnghuó zài chéngshì, dàn zài jiānkǔ de yěwài xùnliàn zhōng yīdiǎnr yě bù jiāoqì.
娇气.en: Although he grew up in the city, he was not at all delicate during the arduous outdoor field training.

交涉.zh: 行李遗失后，乘客代表多次与航空公司交涉索赔事宜。
交涉.py: Xíngli yíshī hòu, chéngkè dàibiǎo duō cì yǔ hángkōng gōngsī jiāoshè suǒpéi shìyí.
交涉.en: After the luggage was lost, passenger representatives negotiated with the airline multiple times regarding compensation matters.

假使.zh: 假使明天天气突变无法出行，我们的备选方案也能按时启动。
假使.py: Jiǎshǐ míngtiān tiānqì tūbiàn wúfǎ chūxíng, wǒmen de bèixuǎn fāng'àn yě néng ànshí qǐdòng.
假使.en: If the weather suddenly changes tomorrow and prevents travel, our backup plan can also be launched on time.

佳肴.zh: 在中秋节的家庭聚会上，餐桌上摆满了母亲精心烹制的美味佳肴。
佳肴.py: Zài Zhōngqiūjié de jiātíng jùhuì shang, cānzhuō shang bǎimǎn le mǔqīn jīngxīn pēngzhì de měiwèi jiāyáo.
佳肴.en: At the Mid-Autumn Festival family gathering, the dining table was filled with delicious delicacies meticulously prepared by mother.

家喻户晓.zh: 这位作家的童话作品语言通俗、情节生动，在全国各地几乎家喻户晓。
家喻户晓.py: Zhè wèi zuòjiā de tónghuà zuòpǐn yǔyán tōngsú, qíngjié shēngdòng, zài quánguó gèdì jīhū jiāyùhùxiǎo.
家喻户晓.en: This author's fairy tales have accessible language and vivid plots, making them household names across the country.

夹杂.zh: 寒风中夹杂着细细的雪花，让走在街上的行人们不由得裹紧了厚厚的大衣。
夹杂.py: Hánfēng zhōng jiāzá zhe xìxì de xuěhuā, ràng zǒu zài jiē shang de xíngrén men bùyóude guǒjǐn le hòuhòu de dàyī.
夹杂.en: The cold wind was mingled with fine snowflakes, making pedestrians on the street involuntarily wrap their thick coats tightly around themselves.

机动.zh: 为了应对突发情况，组委会特意在紧凑的日程中预留了半天的机动时间。
机动.py: Wèile yìngduì tūfā qíngkuàng, zǔwěihuì tèyì zài jǐncòu de rìchéng zhōng yùliú le bàntiān de jīdòng shíjiān.
机动.en: To cope with unforeseen circumstances, the organizing committee deliberately reserved half a day of flexible time in the tight schedule.

皆.zh: 只要坚持不懈地付出努力，凡是看似遥不可及的梦想皆有可能实现。
皆.py: Zhǐyào jiānchí-bùxiè de fùchū nǔlì, fánshì kànsì yáobùkějí de mèngxiǎng jiē yǒu kěnéng shíxiàn.
皆.en: As long as one perseveres and puts in the effort, even dreams that seem out of reach are all possible to achieve.

揭发.zh: 几名知情员工联合向监管部门提供了翔实的证据，勇敢地揭发了该公司的财务造假行为。
揭发.py: Jǐ míng zhīqíng yuángōng liánhé xiàng jiānguǎn bùmén tígōng le xiángshí de zhèngjù, yǒnggǎn de jiēfā le gāi gōngsī de cáiwù zàojiǎ xíngwéi.
揭发.en: Several insider employees jointly provided detailed evidence to regulators, bravely exposing the company's fraudulent accounting practices.

结晶.zh: 这部历时十年精心打磨的学术巨著，是团队全体科研人员智慧与心血的结晶。
结晶.py: Zhè bù lìshí shí nián jīngxīn dǎmó de xuéshù jùzhù, shì tuánduì quántǐ kēyán rényuán zhìhuì yǔ xīnxuè de jiéjīng.
结晶.en: This major academic work, meticulously polished over ten years, is the crystallization of the wisdom and painstaking efforts of the entire research team.

解剖.zh: 医学生在显微镜下仔细解剖实验标本，以直观理解生物组织的微观构造。
解剖.py: Yīxuéshēng zài xiǎnwéijìng xià zǐxì jiěpōu shíyàn biāoběn, yǐ zhíguān lǐjiě shēngwù zǔzhī de wēiguān gòuzào.
解剖.en: Medical students carefully dissected the experimental specimen under a microscope to visually understand the microscopic structure of biological tissue.

结算.zh: 财务部门通常在每月末集中进行账目核对与结算，以确保收支明细准确无误。
结算.py: Cáiwù bùmén tōngcháng zài měi yuèmò jízhōng jìnxíng zhàngmù héduì yǔ jiésuàn, yǐ quèbǎo shōuzhī míngxì zhǔnquè wúwù.
结算.en: The finance department usually conducts account verification and settlement at the end of each month to ensure that revenue and expenditure details are accurate.

解体.zh: 由于内部利益冲突不断加剧，这个曾经辉煌一时的商业联盟最终走向了解体。
解体.py: Yóuyú nèibù lìyì chōngtū bùduàn jiājù, zhège céngjīng huīhuáng yīshí de shāngyè liánméng zuìzhōng zǒuxiàng le jiětǐ.
解体.en: Due to intensifying internal conflicts of interest, this once-prominent business alliance ultimately disintegrated.

界限.zh: 在职场人际交往中，保持亲和力的同时也要清晰地划分公私界限。
界限.py: Zài zhíchǎng rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng, bǎochí qīnhélì de tóngshí yě yào qīngxī de huàfēn gōngsī jièxiàn.
界限.en: In workplace interpersonal communication, while maintaining approachability, one must also clearly delineate the boundary between personal and professional matters.

急功近利.zh: 基础科学研究需要长期的积累与坐冷板凳的定力，绝不能抱有急功近利的心态。
急功近利.py: Jīchǔ kēxué yánjiū xūyào chángqī de jīlěi yǔ zuò lěngbǎndèng de dìnglì, juébù néng bàoyǒu jígōngjìnlì de xīntài.
急功近利.en: Basic scientific research demands long-term accumulation and patient perseverance, and one must never adopt a mentality of seeking quick results and instant gain.

籍贯.zh: 在填报入职信息登记表时，他工整地写下了自己的出生年月和籍贯。
籍贯.py: Zài tiánbào rùzhí xìnxī dēngjì biǎo shí, tā gōngzhěng de xiěxià le zìjǐ de chūshēng niányuè hé jíguàn.
籍贯.en: When filling out the employee registration form, he neatly wrote down his date of birth and ancestral hometown.

急剧.zh: 随着新一轮强冷空气的突袭，该地区的气温在短短数小时内急剧下降。
急剧.py: Suízhe xīn yī lún qiáng lěng kōngqì de tūxí, gāi dìqū de qìwēn zài duǎnduǎn shù xiǎoshí nèi jíjù xiàjiàng.
急剧.en: With the sudden onset of a new cold wave, temperatures in the region dropped sharply within just a few hours.

机灵.zh: 这个小男孩非常机灵，遇到陌生人问路时既热情解答又时刻保持着警惕。
机灵.py: Zhège xiǎo nánhái fēicháng jīling, yùdào mòshēngrén wènlù shí jì rèqíng jiědá yòu shíkè bǎochí zhe jǐngtì.
机灵.en: This little boy is very sharp; when a stranger asks him for directions, he answers warmly while remaining constantly alert.

茎.zh: 这种攀缘植物会沿着竹竿向上缠绕生长，其脆弱的茎部需要搭设支架以防折断。
茎.py: Zhè zhǒng pānyuán zhíwù huì yánzhe zhúgān xiàngshàng chánrào shēngzhǎng, qí cuìruò de jīngbù xūyào dāshè zhījià yǐ fáng zhéduàn.
茎.en: This climbing plant winds upward along the bamboo pole, and its fragile stems require trellises for support to prevent breaking.

精打细算.zh: 创业初期启动资金十分紧张，团队在各项开支上都精打细算，力争把每分钱用在刀刃上。
精打细算.py: Chuàngyè chūqī qǐdòng zījīn shífēn jǐnzhāng, tuánduì zài gè xiàng kāizhī shang dōu jīngdǎxìsuàn, lìzhēng bǎ měi fēn qián yòng zài dāorèn shang.
精打细算.en: In the early stages of starting a business when initial funds were tight, the team budgeted meticulously on every expense, striving to spend every penny where it counted most.

惊动.zh: 他深夜悄悄溜进房间换衣服，生怕发出声响惊动了熟睡中的父母。
惊动.py: Tā shēnyè qiāoqiāo liūjìn fángjiān huàn yīfu, shēngpà fāchū shēngxiǎng jīngdòng le shúshuì zhōng de fùmǔ.
惊动.en: Late at night, he slipped quietly into his room to change clothes, afraid that making any sound might disturb his soundly sleeping parents.

精华.zh: 这部文集汇聚了多位文学名家的代表作，充分展现了中国现当代散文的精华。
精华.py: Zhè bù wénjí huìjù le duō wèi wénxué míngjiā de dàibiǎozuò, chōngfèn zhǎnxiàn le Zhōngguó xiàn-dāngdài sǎnwén de jīnghuá.
精华.en: Gathering representative works of multiple renowned literary masters, this anthology fully showcases the quintessence of modern and contemporary Chinese prose.

精简.zh: 为了提高运营效率并降低管理成本，公司决定精简冗余的审批流程。
精简.py: Wèile tígāo yùnyíng xiàolǜ bìng jiàngdī guǎnlǐ chéngběn, gōngsī juédìng jīngjiǎn rǒngyú de shěnpī liúchéng.
精简.en: In order to enhance operational efficiency and lower administrative costs, the company decided to streamline redundant approval processes.

境界.zh: 真正的艺术大师在技艺纯熟之后，更追求一种情景交融、天人合一的精神境界。
境界.py: Zhēnzhèng de yìshù dàshī zài jìyì chúnshú zhīhòu, gèng zhuīqiú yī zhǒng qíngjǐng-jiāoróng, tiānrén-héyī de jīngshén jìngjiè.
境界.en: True art masters, after mastering their technique, pursue a spiritual realm where emotion harmonizes with setting, and humanity unifies with nature.

兢兢业业.zh: 李老师在偏远山区的乡村小学里兢兢业业地耕耘了三十年，深受村民和孩子们的爱戴。
兢兢业业.py: Lǐ lǎoshī zài piānyuǎn shānqū de xiāngcūn xiǎoxué lǐ jīngjīngyèyè de gēngyún le sānshí nián, shēn shòu cūnmín hé háizi men de àidài.
兢兢业业.en: Teacher Li has worked assiduously in a remote mountainous village school for thirty years, earning the deep respect and love of villagers and children.

敬礼.zh: 升国旗仪式开始时，全场官兵表情庄重地举起右手向国旗敬礼。
敬礼.py: Shēng guóqí yíshì kāishǐ shí, quánchǎng guānbīng biǎoqíng zhuāngzhòng de jǔqǐ yòushǒu xiàng guóqí jìnglǐ.
敬礼.en: As the flag-raising ceremony began, all officers and soldiers solemnly raised their right hands to salute the national flag.

精密.zh: 这台高科技芯片制造设备结构极其精密，对工作车间的洁净度和温度要求苛刻。
精密.py: Zhè tái gāo kējì xīnpiàn zhìzào shèbèi jiégòu jíqí jīngmì, duì gōngzuò chējiān de jiéjìngdù hé wēndù yāoqiú kēkè.
精密.en: This high-tech chip manufacturing equipment has an extremely precise structure and imposes stringent requirements on the cleanliness and temperature of the workshop.

惊奇.zh: 考察队员们惊奇地发现，在这片干旱荒芜的沙漠深处竟然孕育着一处生机勃勃的绿洲。
惊奇.py: Kǎochá duìyuán men jīngqí de fāxiàn, zài zhè piàn gānhàn huāngwú de shāmò shēnchù jìngrán yùnyù zhe yī chù shēngjī-bóbó de lǜzhōu.
惊奇.en: The expedition members were astonished to discover that deep within this arid and barren desert lay a vibrant oasis teeming with life.

经纬.zh: 地球仪表面纵横交错的经纬网，为航海家在全球范围内准确定位航向提供了科学依据。
经纬.py: Dìqiúyí biǎomiàn zònghéng jiāocuò de jīngwěi wǎng, wèi hánghǎijiā zài quánqiú fànwéi nèi zhǔnquè dìngwèi hángxiàng tígōng le kēxué yījù.
经纬.en: The crisscrossing grid of latitude and longitude on the globe provides navigators with a scientific basis for accurately determining their course worldwide.

精益求精.zh: 这位钟表工匠本着精益求精的职业精神，哪怕是对肉眼几乎看不见的微小零件也雕琢得毫无瑕疵。
精益求精.py: Zhè wèi zhōngbiǎo gōngjiàng běnzhe jīngyìqiújīng de zhíyè jīngshén, nǎpà shì duì ròuyǎn jīhū kànbujiàn de wēixiǎo língjiàn yě diāozhuó de háowú xiácī.
精益求精.en: Upholding a professional spirit of constantly striving for perfection, this watchmaker polishes even minuscule parts barely visible to the naked eye until they are flawless.

浸泡.zh: 在烹饪干木耳之前，需要先将它们放入温水中充分浸泡半小时使其彻底泡发。
浸泡.py: Zài pēngrèn gān mù'ěr zhīqián, xūyào xiān jiāng tāmen fàngrù wēnshuǐ zhōng chōngfèn jìnpào bàn xiǎoshí shǐ qí chèdǐ pàofā.
浸泡.en: Before cooking dried wood ear mushrooms, they need to be thoroughly soaked in warm water for half an hour to rehydrate completely.

紧迫.zh: 随着交付截止日期日益临近，研发团队深刻感受到了任务的艰巨与时间的紧迫。
紧迫.py: Suízhe jiāofù jiézhǐ rìqī rìyì línjìn, yánfā tuánduì shēnkè gǎnshòudào le rènwù de jiānjù yǔ shíjiān de jǐnpò.
紧迫.en: As the delivery deadline approached day by day, the R&D team keenly felt the arduousness of the task and the urgency of time.

晋升.zh: 凭借卓越的业绩和优秀的领导能力，他在短短三年内就由普通工程师晋升为技术总监。
晋升.py: Píngjiè zhuóyuè de yèjì hé yōuxiù de lǐngdǎo nénglì, tā zài duǎnduǎn sān nián nèi jiù yóu pǔtōng gōngchéngshī jìnshēng wéi jìshù zǒngjiān.
晋升.en: By virtue of outstanding performance and exceptional leadership, he was promoted from a regular engineer to technical director in just three years.

劲头.zh: 听到项目通过终审的好消息，大家干活的劲头更足了，纷纷主动留下来完善细节。
劲头.py: Tīngdào xiàngmù tōngguò zhōngshěn de hǎo xiāoxi, dàjiā gànhuó de jìntóu gèng zú le, fēnfēn zhǔdòng liú xiàlái wánshàn xìjié.
劲头.en: Hearing the good news that the project had passed the final review, everyone tackled their work with even greater vigor, voluntarily staying late to polish details.

锦绣前程.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长深情寄语全体毕业生，祝愿他们在未来的广阔天地里大展宏图、拥有锦绣前程。
锦绣前程.py: Bìyè diǎnlǐ shang, xiàozhǎng shēnqíng jìyǔ quántǐ bìyèshēng, zhùyuàn tāmen zài wèilái de guǎngkuò tiāndì lǐ dàzhǎnhóngtú, yǒngyǒu jǐnxiùqiánchéng.
锦绣前程.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal gave an affectionate message to all graduates, wishing them great success and a brilliant future in the wide world ahead.

寄托.zh: 这位孤独的老人将晚年全部的感情寄托在花鸟草木和心爱的宠物身上。
寄托.py: Zhè wèi gūdú de lǎorén jiāng wǎnnián quánbù de gǎnqíng jìtuō zài huā niǎo cǎomù hé xīn'ài de chǒngwù shēnshang.
寄托.en: In his later years, this lonely elderly man placed all his affections onto flowers, birds, plants, and his beloved pets.

就近.zh: 市政府在各社区周边兴建了便民菜市场和卫生服务站，方便市民就近买菜和看病。
就近.py: Shì zhèngfǔ zài gè shèqū zhōubiān xīngjiàn le biànmín càishìchǎng hé wèishēng fúwùzhàn, fāngbiàn shìmín jiùjìn mǎicài hé kànbìng.
就近.en: The municipal government built convenient food markets and health service stations around each community to make it easy for residents to buy groceries and seek medical care nearby.

就职.zh: 新任校长在隆重的就职仪式上发表演讲，阐述了他对未来学校学术发展的战略规划。
就职.py: Xīnrèn xiàozhǎng zài lóngzhòng de jiùzhí yíshì shang fābiǎo yǎnjiǎng, chǎnshù le tā duì wèilái xuéxiào xuéshù fāzhǎn de zhànlüè guīhuà.
就职.en: At the grand inauguration ceremony, the newly appointed principal delivered a speech expounding his strategic plan for the university's future academic development.

继往开来.zh: 当代青年肩负着继往开来的历史重任，需要在前人开创的成果基础上勇于开拓创新。
继往开来.py: Dāngdài qīngnián jiānfù zhe jìwǎngkāilái de lìshǐ zhòngrèn, xūyào zài qiánrén kāichuàng de chéngguǒ jīchǔ shang yǒngyú kāituò chuàngxīn.
继往开来.en: Today's youth shoulder the historical mission of carrying forward past traditions while opening up paths for the future, boldly innovating upon the foundation laid by predecessors.

讥笑.zh: 面对同伴的不解与讥笑，他并未动摇自己的科研设想，而是用严谨的实验结果作出了有力回应。
讥笑.py: Miànduì tóngbàn de bùjiě yǔ jīxiào, tā bìng wèi dòngyáo zìjǐ de kēyán shèxiǎng, ér shì yòng yánjǐn de shíyàn jiéguǒ zuòchū le yǒulì huíyìng.
讥笑.en: In the face of his peers' incomprehension and mockery, he did not waver in his scientific hypothesis, but instead responded powerfully with rigorous experimental results.

纪要.zh: 会议结束后，秘书迅速整理出了一份准确详实的会议纪要并分发给所有参会人员。
纪要.py: Huìyì jiéshù hòu, mìshū xùnsù zhěnglǐ chū le yī fèn zhǔnquè xiángshí de huìyì jìyào bìng fēnfā gěi suǒyǒu cānhuì rényuán.
纪要.en: After the meeting concluded, the secretary promptly compiled an accurate and detailed summary of the meeting and distributed it to all attendees.

急于求成.zh: 学习一门新语言是一个循序渐进的过程，急于求成往往会导致基础薄弱、欲速不达。
急于求成.py: Xuéxí yī mén xīn yǔyán shì yī gè xúnxù-jiànjìn de guòchéng, jíyúqiúchéng wǎngwǎng huì dǎozhì jīchǔ bóruò, yùsù-bùdá.
急于求成.en: Learning a new language is a step-by-step process; being impatient for quick results often leads to weak fundamentals and the opposite of what one desires.

急躁.zh: 在处理复杂的客户投诉时，客服人员必须保持耐心与冷静，切忌产生急躁情绪。
急躁.py: Zài chǔlǐ fùzá de kèhù tóusù shí, kèfú rényuán bìxū bǎochí nàixīn yǔ lěngjìng, qièjì chǎnshēng jízào qíngxù.
急躁.en: When handling complex customer complaints, customer service representatives must maintain patience and composure, avoiding any impatience or irritability.

机智.zh: 面对突如其来的舞台突发状况，主持人机智幽默地巧妙圆场，赢得了观众阵阵掌声。
机智.py: Miànduì tūrúqílái de wǔtái tūfā zhuàngkuàng, zhǔchírén jīzhì yōumò de qiǎomiào yuánchǎng, yíngdé le guānzhòng zhènzhèn zhǎngshēng.
机智.en: Facing an unexpected mishap on stage, the host tactfully and humorously smoothed things over, winning rounds of applause from the audience.

局部.zh: 气象部门预报显示，虽然全市整体天气晴好，但午后局部地区仍可能出现短时雷阵雨。
局部.py: Qìxiàng bùmén yùbào xiǎnshì, suīrán quán shì zhěngtǐ tiānqì qínghǎo, dàn wǔhòu júbù dìqū réng kěnéng chūxiàn duǎnshí léizhènyǔ.
局部.en: Meteorological forecasts indicate that while the city overall will enjoy clear weather, local areas may still experience brief thundershowers in the afternoon.

咀嚼.zh: 这篇散文字句优美、意蕴深远，值得读者静下心来反复咀嚼与品味。
咀嚼.py: Zhè piān sǎnwén zìjù yōuměi, yìyùn shēnyuǎn, zhídé dúzhě jìng xià xīn lái fǎnfù jǔjué yǔ pǐnwèi.
咀嚼.en: With its beautiful phrasing and profound meaning, this essay is worthy of readers calming their minds to repeatedly mull over and savor.

拘留.zh: 因严重扰乱公共交通秩序并拒不听从劝阻，当事人被公安机关依法处以行政拘留十天。
拘留.py: Yīn yánzhòng rǎoluàn gōnggòng jiāotōng zhìxù bìng jùbù tīngcóng quànzǔ, dāngshìrén bèi gōng'ān jīguān yīfǎ chǔyǐ xíngzhèng jūliú shí tiān.
拘留.en: For seriously disrupting public transportation order and refusing to heed warnings, the person involved was legally placed in administrative detention for ten days by public security authorities.

沮丧.zh: 尽管面试再次失利让他感到十分沮丧，但他很快重拾信心，开始认真复盘准备下一次机会。
沮丧.py: Jǐnguǎn miànshì zàicì shīlì ràng tā gǎndào shífēn jǔsàng, dàn tā hěn kuài chóngshí xìnxīn, kāishǐ rènzhēn fùpán zhǔnbèi xià yī cì jīhuì.
沮丧.en: Although failing the interview once again made him feel very dejected, he quickly regained confidence and began carefully reviewing his performance to prepare for the next opportunity.

举世闻名.zh: 雄伟的万里长城蜿蜒盘旋于崇山峻岭之间，是一处举世闻名的中国历史文化古迹。
举世闻名.py: Xióngwěi de Wànlǐ Chángchéng wānyán pánxuán yú chóngshān-jùnlǐng zhījiān, shì yī chù jǔshì-wénmíng de Zhōngguó lìshǐ wénhuà gǔjì.
举世闻名.en: The majestic Great Wall winds through steep mountains and ridges, standing as a world-famous Chinese historical and cultural monument.

举世瞩目.zh: 经过数十年的快速发展，中国在脱贫攻坚和科技创新领域取得了举世瞩目的巨大成就。
举世瞩目.py: Jīngguò shù shí nián de kuàisù fāzhǎn, Zhōngguó zài tuōpín gōngjiān hé kējì chuàngxīn lǐngyù qǔdé le jǔshì-zhǔmù de jùdà chéngjiù.
举世瞩目.en: After decades of rapid development, China has achieved tremendous accomplishments that have attracted worldwide attention in poverty alleviation and technological innovation.

拘束.zh: 初次来到陌生人的家庭聚会，性格腼腆的他显得有些局促和拘束。
拘束.py: Chūcì láidào mòshēngrén de jiātíng jùhuì, xìnggé miǎntiǎn de tā xiǎnde yǒuxiē júcù hé jūshù.
拘束.en: Attending a family gathering of strangers for the first time, he felt somewhat awkward and ill at ease due to his shy personality.

据悉.zh: 据悉，这条连接两座重要省会城市的高速铁路将于今年年底正式开通运营。
据悉.py: Jùxī, zhè tiáo liánjiē liǎng zuò zhòngyào shěnghuì chéngshì de gāosù tiělù jiāng yú jīnnián niándǐ zhèngshì kāitōng yùnyíng.
据悉.en: According to reports, this high-speed railway connecting two major provincial capitals will officially begin operation by the end of this year.

举足轻重.zh: 作为核心零部件的独家供应商，该企业在全球半导体产业链中占据着举足轻重的战略地位。
举足轻重.py: Zuòwéi héxīn língbùjiàn de dújiā gōngyìngshāng, gāi qǐyè zài quánqiú bàndǎotǐ chǎnyèliàn zhōng zhànjù zhe jǔzú-qīngzhòng de zhànlüè dìwèi.
举足轻重.en: As an exclusive supplier of core components, this enterprise occupies a pivotal strategic position in the global semiconductor industry chain.

开采.zh: 为了保护当地脆弱的生态环境，政府决定严厉限制在该保护区内开采煤炭。
开采.py: Wèile bǎohù dāngdì cuìruò de shēngtài huánjìng, zhèngfǔ juédìng yánlì xiànzhì zài gāi bǎohùqū nèi kāicǎi méitàn.
开采.en: In order to protect the fragile local ecological environment, the government decided to strictly restrict coal mining in the protected area.

开阔.zh: 站在山顶俯瞰，眼前是一片开阔的平原与奔流不息的江河。
开阔.py: Zhàn zài shāndǐng fǔkàn, yǎnqián shì yípiàn kāikuò de píngyuán yǔ bēnliú bùxī de jiānghé.
开阔.en: Standing on the mountaintop looking down, before our eyes was a wide, expansive plain and an endlessly flowing river.

开朗.zh: 她性格热情开朗，无论遇到什么困难总能用乐观的心态去面对。
开朗.py: Tā xìnggé rèqíng kāilǎng, wúlùn yùdào shénme kùnnan zǒng néng yòng lèguān de xīntài qù miànduì.
开朗.en: She has a warm and cheerful personality, and she always faces difficulties with an optimistic attitude.

开明.zh: 这位父亲思想非常开明，始终尊重并支持女儿自由选择未来的职业发展。
开明.py: Zhè wèi fùqīn sīxiǎng fēicháng kāimíng, shǐzhōng zūnzhòng bìng zhīchí nǚ'ér zìyóu xuǎnzé wèilái de zhíyè fāzhǎn.
开明.en: The father is very open-minded, always respecting and supporting his daughter's freedom in choosing her future career path.

开辟.zh: 这家创新型科技公司在激烈的市场竞争中开辟了一条全新的发展路径。
开辟.py: Zhè jiā chuàngxīn xíng kējì gōngsī zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng kāipì le yì tiáo quánxīn de fāzhǎn lùjìng.
开辟.en: This innovative tech company carved out a brand-new development path amidst fierce market competition.

勘探.zh: 地质考察队深入戈壁沙漠进行长期勘探，终于发现了一处大型油气田。
勘探.py: Dìzhì kǎochá duì shēnrù gēbì shāmò jìnxíng chángqī kāntàn, zhōngyú fāxiàn le yí chù dàxíng yóuqìtián.
勘探.en: The geological expedition ventured deep into the Gobi Desert for prolonged exploration and finally discovered a large oil and gas field.

刊物.zh: 这篇学术论文经过同行严谨的审稿后，成功发表在国际知名学术刊物上。
刊物.py: Zhè piān xuéshù lùnwén jīngguò tóngháng yánjǐn de shěngǎo hòu, chénggōng fābiǎo zài guójì zhīmíng xuéshù kānwù shang.
刊物.en: After rigorous peer review, this academic paper was successfully published in an internationally renowned scholarly publication.

靠拢.zh: 随着船只缓缓向码头靠拢，岸上的迎接人群纷纷挥手致意。
靠拢.py: Suízhe chuánzhī huǎnhuǎn xiàng mǎtou kàolǒng, àn shang de yíngjiē rénqún fēnfēn huīshǒu zhìyì.
靠拢.en: As the ship slowly drew close to the dock, the welcoming crowd on the shore waved their greetings.

卡通.zh: 妹妹房间的墙壁上贴满了各种经典卡通人物的海报与明信片。
卡通.py: Mèimei fángjiān de qiángbì shang tiēmǎn le gèzhǒng jīngdiǎn kǎtōng rénwù de hǎibào yǔ míngxìnpiàn.
卡通.en: The walls of my younger sister's room are covered with posters and postcards of various classic cartoon characters.

磕.zh: 他下楼时不小心踩空，膝盖重重地磕在了坚硬的水泥台阶上。
磕.py: Tā xiàlóu shí bù xiǎoxīn cǎikōng, xīgài zhòngzhòng de kē zài le jiānyìng de shuǐní táijiē shang.
磕.en: He accidentally missed a step going downstairs and knocked his knee hard against the rigid concrete stairs.

刻不容缓.zh: 洪灾过后重建家园与防范次生灾害的工作已经到了刻不容缓的地步。
刻不容缓.py: Hóngzāi guòhòu chóngjiàn jiāyuán yǔ fángfàn cìshēng zāihài de gōngzuò yǐjīng dào le kèbùrónghuǎn de dìbù.
刻不容缓.en: The work of rebuilding homes and preventing secondary disasters after the flood has reached a point that brooks no delay.

可观.zh: 得益于产品结构优化，该公司今年海外业务的营收取得了可观的增长。
可观.py: Déyì yú chǎnpǐn jiégòu yōuhuà, gāi gōngsī jīnnián hǎiwài yèwù de yíngshōu qǔdé le kěguān de zēngzhǎng.
可观.en: Benefiting from optimized product structure, the company achieved considerable revenue growth in its overseas business this year.

颗粒.zh: 沙尘暴来袭时，空气中悬浮的细小沙尘颗粒会严重影响市民的呼吸健康。
颗粒.py: Shāchénbào láixí shí, kōngqì zhōng xuánfú de xìxiǎo shāchén kēlì huì yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng shìmín de hūxī jiànkāng.
颗粒.en: When a sandstorm hits, tiny sand particles suspended in the air can severely affect residents' respiratory health.

啃.zh: 为了攻克这个技术难关，团队连续几个星期啃下了几十本厚重的外文专著。
啃.py: Wèile gōngkè zhège jìshù nánguān, tuánduì liánxù jǐ gè xīngqī kěn xià le jǐ shí běn hòuzhòng de wàiwén zhuānzhù.
啃.en: To overcome this technical bottleneck, the team spent several consecutive weeks wading through dozens of hefty foreign monographs.

坑.zh: 经过连日大雨的冲刷，村口原本平整的泥土路面被冲出了许多深浅不一的坑。
坑.py: Jīngguò liánrì dàyǔ de chōngshuā, cūnkǒu yuánběn píngzhěng de nítǔ lùmiàn bèi chōng chū le xǔduō shēnqiǎn bùyī de kēng.
坑.en: After days of heavy rain erosion, many pits of varying depths were washed into the originally flat dirt road at the village entrance.

恳切.zh: 面对大家的误解，他态度恳切地向同事们说明了事情的原委并道歉。
恳切.py: Miànduì dàjiā de wùjiě, tā tàidù kěnqiè de xiàng tóngshìmen shuōmíng le shìqing de yuánwěi bìng dàoqiàn.
恳切.en: In the face of everyone's misunderstanding, he explained the circumstances to his colleagues with an earnest attitude and apologized.

可恶.zh: 那些利用老年人的同情心进行养老诈骗的犯罪分子实在令人感到可恶。
可恶.py: Nàxiē lìyòng lǎoniánrén de tóngqíngxīn jìnxíng yǎnglǎo zhàpiàn de fànzuì fènzǐ shízài lìng rén gǎndào kěwù.
可恶.en: Those criminals who exploit the sympathy of senior citizens to carry out pension scams are truly abominable.

孔.zh: 木工师傅先用手摇钻在木板中央钻了几个细小的圆孔以便固定螺丝。
孔.py: Mùgōng shīfu xiān yòng shǒuyáozuàn zài mùbǎn zhōngyāng zuān le jǐ gè xìxiǎo de yuánkǒng yǐbiàn gùdìng luósī.
孔.en: The carpenter first drilled several small round holes in the center of the wooden board with a hand drill to fix the screws.

恐吓.zh: 他拒绝向恶势力低头，即使收到匿名的恐吓信也毅然选择向警方报案。
恐吓.py: Tā jùjué xiàng è shìlì dītóu, jíshǐ shōudào nìmíng de kǒnghè xìn yě yìrán xuǎnzé xiàng jǐngfāng bào'àn.
恐吓.en: He refused to bow to malicious forces, and even upon receiving anonymous threatening letters, he resolutely chose to report it to the police.

空前绝后.zh: 这位传奇运动员在一届奥运会上独揽八枚金牌，创下了空前绝后的壮举。
空前绝后.py: Zhè wèi chuánqí yùndòngyuán zài yí jiè Àoyùnhuì shang dálǎn bā méi jīnpái, chuàngxià le kōngqiánjuéhòu de zhuàngjǔ.
空前绝后.en: This legendary athlete swept eight gold medals in a single Olympic Games, setting an unprecedented and unsurpassable feat.

空想.zh: 幸福生活是靠踏踏实实的劳动创造出来的，脱离现实的空想没有任何意义。
空想.py: Xìngfú shēnghuó shì kào tātashíshí de láodòng chuàngzào chūlái de, tuōlí xiànshí de kōngxiǎng méiyǒu rènhé yìyì.
空想.en: A happy life is created through down-to-earth labor; fantasies divorced from reality are completely meaningless.

空虚.zh: 虽然他在物质生活上十分富足，但由于缺乏精神追求，内心时常感到空虚。
空虚.py: Suīrán tā zài wùzhì shēnghuó shang shífēn fùzú, dàn yóuyú quēfá jīngshén zhuīqiú, nèixīn shícháng gǎndào kōngxū.
空虚.en: Although he was materially very well-off, he often felt empty inside due to a lack of spiritual pursuits.

挎.zh: 清晨，奶奶挎着一个装满新鲜蔬菜的竹篮从集市上慢步走回家。
挎.py: Qīngchén, nǎinai kuàzhe yí gè zhuāngmǎn xīnxiān shūcài de zhúlán cóng jíshì shang mànbù zǒu huí jiā.
挎.en: In the early morning, grandma walked home slowly from the market carrying a bamboo basket filled with fresh vegetables slung over her arm.

款待.zh: 当地居民用独具特色的传统佳肴和热情的歌舞款待了远道而来的客人们。
款待.py: Dāngdì jūmín yòng dújù tèsè de chuántǒng jiāyáo hé rèqíng de gēwǔ kuǎndài le yuǎndào'érlái de kèrénmen.
款待.en: The local residents hospitably entertained the guests who had come from afar with distinctive traditional delicacies and lively songs and dances.

筐.zh: 果农们手脚麻利地将刚从树上采摘下来的苹果装入竹筐中运往仓库。
筐.py: Guǒnóngmen shǒujiǎomálì de jiāng gāng cóng shù shang cǎizhāi xiàlái de píngguǒ zhuāngrù zhúkuāng zhōng yùn wǎng cāngkù.
筐.en: The fruit farmers deftly loaded freshly picked apples into bamboo baskets to transport them to the warehouse.

框架.zh: 两国代表经过数轮深入谈判，终于达成了全面经济合作协议的基本框架。
框架.py: Liǎng guó dàibiǎo jīngguò shù lún shēnrù tánpàn, zhōngyú dáchéng le quánmiàn jīngjì hézuò xiéyì de jīběn kuàngjià.
框架.en: After several rounds of in-depth negotiations, representatives from both countries finally reached the basic framework of a comprehensive economic cooperation agreement.

旷课.zh: 学校严格规定，无故旷课累计达到一定时限的学生将受到严肃的纪律处分。
旷课.py: Xuéxiào yángé guīdìng, wúgù kuàngkè lěijì dádào yídìng shíxiàn de xuésheng jiāng shòudào yánsù de jìlǜ chǔfèn.
旷课.en: The school strictly stipulates that students who skip classes without reason totaling a certain duration will face severe disciplinary sanctions.

亏待.zh: 老板向老员工们承诺，只要大家齐心协力把业务做好，公司绝不会亏待任何贡献者。
亏待.py: Lǎobǎn xiàng lǎo yuángōngmen chéngnuò, zhǐyào dàjiā qíxīnxílì bǎ yèwù zuò hǎo, gōngsī jué búhuì kuīdài rènhé gòngxiànzhě.
亏待.en: The boss promised the senior employees that as long as everyone worked together to do good business, the company would never treat any contributor unfairly.

枯竭.zh: 长期的过度开采导致地下水资源日益枯竭，给周边农业灌溉带来了严重威胁。
枯竭.py: Chángqī de guòdù kāicǎi dǎozhì dìxiàshuǐ zīyuán rìyì kūjié, gěi zhōubiān nóngyè guàngài dài lái le yánzhòng wēixié.
枯竭.en: Prolonged over-extraction has caused groundwater resources to become increasingly depleted, posing a severe threat to surrounding agricultural irrigation.

捆绑.zh: 某些手机应用程序在下载时会私自捆绑其他无关插件，引发了消费者的普遍反感。
捆绑.py: Mǒuxiē shǒujī yìngyòng chéngxù zài xiàzǎi shí huì sīzì kǔnbǎng qítā wúguān chājiàn, yǐnfā le xiāofèizhě de pǔbiàn fǎngǎn.
捆绑.en: Certain mobile apps secretly bundle other irrelevant plug-ins during downloads, provoking widespread resentment among consumers.

扩充.zh: 随着海外业务的快速拓展，公司决定进一步扩充研发团队的技术人才储备。
扩充.py: Suízhe hǎiwài yèwù de kuàisù tuòzhǎn, gōngsī juédìng jìnyíbù kuòchōng yánfā tuánduì de jìshù réncái chǔbèi.
扩充.en: With the rapid expansion of overseas business, the company decided to further expand the technical talent pool of its R&D team.

来历.zh: 馆长耐心地向前来参观的学者们讲述了这件出土青铜器的神秘来历与历史背景。
来历.py: Guǎnzhǎng nàixīn de xiàng qiánlái cānguān de xuézhěmen jiǎngshù le zhè jiàn chūtǔ qīngtóngqì de shénmì láilì yǔ lìshǐ bèijǐng.
来历.en: The curator patiently recounted the mysterious origin and historical background of this excavated bronze artifact to the visiting scholars.

狼狈.zh: 突如其来的倾盆大雨把没有带伞的他淋得浑身湿透，样子十分狼狈。
狼狈.py: Tūrúqílái de qīngpén dàyǔ bǎ méiyǒu dài sǎn de tā lín de húnshēn shītòu, yàngzi shífēn lángbèi.
狼狈.en: The sudden downpour drenched him completely without an umbrella, leaving him looking thoroughly battered and disheveled.

捞.zh: 母亲用漏勺从翻滚的热汤里捞出煮熟的饺子，香气顿时弥漫了整个厨房。
捞.py: Mǔqīn yòng lòusháo cóng fāngǔn de rètāng lǐ lāo chū zhǔshú de jiǎozi, xiāngqì dùnshí mímàn le zhènggè chúfáng.
捞.en: Mother scooped the cooked dumplings out of the rolling hot broth with a slotted spoon, and the aroma instantly filled the entire kitchen.

牢固.zh: 工人们用高强度钢缆将脚手架牢固地固定在建筑外墙上，以确保高空作业安全。
牢固.py: Gōngrénmen yòng gāo qiángdù gānglǎn jiāng jiǎoshǒujià láogù de gùdìng zài jiànzhù wàiqiáng shang, yǐ quèbǎo gāokōng zuòyè ānquán.
牢固.en: The workers securely fastened the scaffolding to the building's exterior wall using high-strength steel cables to ensure the safety of high-altitude operations.

愣.zh: 听到这个令人震惊的消息，他整个人愣在原地，好半天都说不出一句话来。
愣.py: Tīngdào zhège lìng rén zhènjīng de xiāoxi, tā zhěng gè rén lèng zài yuándì, hǎo bàntiān dōu shuō bù chū yí jù huà lái.
愣.en: Hearing this shocking news, he froze blankly on the spot, unable to utter a single word for quite a while.

冷酷.zh: 他虽然表面上看起来冷酷而难以接近，内心深处却始终关爱着身边的朋友。
冷酷.py: Tā suīrán biǎomiàn shang kàn qǐlái lěngkù ér nányǐ jiējìn, nèixīn shēnchù què shǐzhōng guān'ài zhe shēnbiān de péngyou.
冷酷.en: Although he appears cold-hearted and unapproachable on the surface, deep down inside he always cares for the friends around him.

谅解.zh: 经过坦诚深入的沟通，双方终于消除了长久以来的分歧并达成了相互谅解。
谅解.py: Jīngguò tǎnchéng shēnrù de gōutōng, shuāngfāng zhōngyú xiāochú le chángjiǔ yǐlái de fēnqí bìng dáchéng le xiānghù liàngjiě.
谅解.en: Through frank and in-depth communication, both parties finally eliminated their long-standing differences and reached mutual understanding.

联欢.zh: 每年元旦前夕，全校师生都会在大礼堂举办盛大的迎新年联欢晚会。
联欢.py: Měinián yuándàn qiánxī, quán xiào shīshēng dōu huì zài dà lǐtáng jǔbàn shèngdà de yíng xīnnián liánhuān wǎnhuì.
联欢.en: Every year on the eve of New Year's Day, teachers and students across the school hold a grand New Year celebration gala in the auditorium.

廉洁.zh: 他在政府部门工作了三十余年，始终坚守廉洁自律的职业操守，深得百姓爱戴。
廉洁.py: Tā zài zhèngfǔ bùmén gōngzuò le sānshí yú nián, shǐzhōng jiānshǒu liánjié zìlǜ de zhíyè cāoshǒu, shēn dé bǎixìng àidài.
廉洁.en: Having worked in government departments for over thirty years, he consistently maintained honest and incorruptible professional integrity, earning the deep affection of the public.

连年.zh: 该地区得益于科学的种植技术与充足的日照，粮食产量连年保持稳步增长。
连年.py: Gāi dìqū déyì yú kēxué de zhòngzhí jìshù yǔ chōngzú de rìzhào, liángshi chǎnliàng liánnián bǎochí wěnbù zēngzhǎng.
连年.en: Benefiting from scientific planting techniques and ample sunshine, grain output in this region has maintained steady growth for successive years.

连锁.zh: 某大型跨国超市集团计划在未来三年内在新兴市场开设数百家连锁门店。
连锁.py: Mǒu dàxíng kuàguó chāoshì jítuán jìhuà zài wèilái sān nián nèi zài xīnxīng shìchǎng kāishè shù bǎi jiā liánsuǒ méndiàn.
连锁.en: A major multinational supermarket group plans to open hundreds of chain stores in emerging markets over the next three years.

理睬.zh: 尽管对方一再出言挑衅，他依然专注于手中的工作，丝毫不予理睬。
理睬.py: Jǐnguǎn duìfāng yízài chūyán tiǎoxìn, tā yīrán zhuānzhù yú shǒuzhōng de gōngzuò, sīháo bù yǔ lǐcǎi.
理睬.en: Despite the other party's repeated verbal provocations, he remained focused on the work at hand and paid them no heed whatsoever.

里程碑.zh: 这项空间站对接实验的圆满成功，标志着我国航天事业迈上了一个新的里程碑。
里程碑.py: Zhè xiàng kōngjiānzhàn duìjiē shíyàn de yuánmǎn chénggōng, biāozhì zhe wǒ guó hángtiān shìyè mài shàng le yí gè xīn de lǐchéngbēi.
里程碑.en: The complete success of this space station docking experiment marks a new milestone for our country's aerospace endeavor.

历代.zh: 博物馆内珍藏着历代文人墨客创作的名家书法与山水国画。
历代.py: Bówùguǎn nèi zhēncáng zhe lìdài wénrén mòkè chuàngzuò de míngjiā shūfǎ yǔ shānshuǐ guóhuà.
历代.en: The museum houses famous calligraphy works and traditional landscape paintings created by scholars and artists of successive dynasties.

列举.zh: 教授在讲座中列举了大量翔实的行业案例，以论证人工智能对现代金融的深刻影响。
列举.py: Jiàoshòu zài jiǎngzuò zhōng lièjǔ le dàliàng xiángshí de hángyè ànlì, yǐ lùnzhèng réngōng zhìnéng duì xiàndài jīnróng de shēnkè yǐngxiǎng.
列举.en: In the lecture, the professor enumerated numerous detailed industry cases to demonstrate the profound impact of artificial intelligence on modern finance.

利害.zh: 在做出重大商业投资决定之前，董事会必须深入权衡其中的各种利害关系。
利害.py: Zài zuòchū zhòngdà shāngyè tóuzī juédìng zhīqián, dǒngshìhuì bìxū shēnrù quánhéng qízhōng de gèzhǒng lìhài guānxì.
利害.en: Before making a major commercial investment decision, the board of directors must thoroughly weigh the various stakes and interests involved.

立交桥.zh: 这座新建的五层互通式立交桥有效缓解了市区早晚高峰期严重的交通拥堵。
立交桥.py: Zhè zuò xīnjiàn de wǔ céng hùtōng shì lìjiāoqiáo yǒuxiào huǎnjiě le shìqū zǎowǎn gāofēng qī yánzhòng de jiāotōng yōngdǔ.
立交桥.en: This newly constructed five-level interchange overpass effectively eased the severe traffic congestion in the city center during morning and evening rush hours.

历来.zh: 中华文化历来提倡尊老爱幼与勤俭节约，这些美德在现代社会依然具有深远价值。
历来.py: Zhōnghuá wénhuà lìlái tíchàng zūnlǎo'àiyòu yǔ qínjiǎnjiéyuē, zhèxiē měidé zài xiàndài shèhuì yīrán jùyǒu shēnyuǎn jiàzhí.
历来.en: Chinese culture has historically advocated respecting the elderly, cherishing the young, diligence, and thrift, and these virtues still hold profound value in modern society.

伶俐.zh: 这个小女孩口齿伶俐、反应敏捷，在全国少儿演讲比赛中赢得了评委们的一致好评。
伶俐.py: Zhège xiǎonǚhái kǒuchǐ línglì, fǎnyìng mǐnjié, zài quánguó shào'ér yǎnjiǎng bǐsài zhōng yíngdé le píngwěimen de yízhì hǎopíng.
伶俐.en: This little girl is articulate and quick-witted, winning unanimous praise from the judges in the national children's speech contest.

领悟.zh: 经过多年的实践与沉思，他终于深刻领悟了这门艺术的真谛。
领悟.py: Jīngguò duō nián de shíjiàn yǔ chénsī, tā zhōngyú shēnkè lǐngwù le zhè mén yìshù de zhēndì.
领悟.en: After years of practice and contemplation, he finally gained a deep understanding of the true essence of this art.

零星.zh: 天空中飘着零星的雨点，行人纷纷加快了回家的脚步。
零星.py: Tiānkōng zhōng piāozhe língxīng de yǔdiǎn, xíngrén fēnfēn jiākuài le huíjiā de jiǎobù.
零星.en: Sporadic raindrops drifted down from the sky, and pedestrians quickened their pace to head home.

力所能及.zh: 社区志愿者经常利用业余时间，为独居老人做一些力所能及的家务。
力所能及.py: Shèqū zhìyuànzhě jīngcháng lìyòng yèyú shíjiān, wèi dújū lǎorén zuò yìxiē lìsuǒnéngjí de jiāwù.
力所能及.en: Community volunteers often use their spare time to do household chores within their capabilities for elderly people living alone.

立体.zh: 这座现代化的展厅利用先进技术，为观众呈现了极具震撼力的立体视觉效果。
立体.py: Zhè zuò xiàndàihuà de zhǎntīng lìyòng xiānjìn jìshù, wèi guānzhòng chéngxiàn le jí jù zhènhànlì de lìtǐ shìjué xiàoguǒ.
立体.en: Using advanced technology, this modern exhibition hall presents a stunning three-dimensional visual experience to the audience.

力图.zh: 新一届管理层力图打破原有的业务壁垒，开辟更广阔的海外市场。
力图.py: Xīn yí jiè guǎnlǐcéng lìtú dǎpò yuányǒu de yèwù bìlěi, kāipì gèng guǎngkuò de hǎiwài shìchǎng.
力图.en: The new management team strives to break through existing business barriers and open up broader overseas markets.

溜.zh: 会议还没结束，他就趁大家不注意悄悄从后门溜走了。
溜.py: Huìyì hái méi jiéshù, tā jiù chèn dàjiā bú zhùyì qiāoqiāo cóng hòumén liū zǒu le.
溜.en: Before the meeting ended, he quietly slipped away through the back door while no one was paying attention.

流浪.zh: 他年轻时曾带着一把吉他四处流浪，积累了丰富的创作灵感。
流浪.py: Tā niánqīng shí céng dàizhe yì bǎ jítā sìchù liúlàng, jīlěi le fēngfù de chuàngzuò línggǎn.
流浪.en: When he was young, he wandered everywhere with a guitar, accumulating a wealth of creative inspiration.

留恋.zh: 毕业典礼结束后，同学们在校园里漫步，心中充满了对大学时光的留恋。
留恋.py: Bìyè diǎnlǐ jiéshù hòu, tóngxuémen zài xiàoyuán lǐ mànbù, xīnzhōng chōngmǎn le duì dàxué shíguāng de liúliàn.
留恋.en: After the graduation ceremony, students strolled through the campus, their hearts filled with nostalgia and reluctance to leave their college days behind.

留念.zh: 访问结束前，两位学者在研究所门前合影留念。
留念.py: Fǎngwèn jiéshù qián, liǎng wèi xuézhě zài yánjiūsuǒ ménqián héyǐng liúniàn.
留念.en: Before the visit concluded, the two scholars took a photo together in front of the research institute as a souvenir.

留神.zh: 雨天路面湿滑，上下楼梯时一定要多加留神。
留神.py: Yǔtiān lùmiàn shīhuá, shàngxià lóutī shí yídìng yào duōjiā liúshén.
留神.en: The road surface is slippery on rainy days, so be sure to take extra care when going up and down the stairs.

力争.zh: 项目团队正夜以继日地工作，力争在月底前按时交付系统。
力争.py: Xiàngmù tuánduì zhèng yèyǐjìrì de gōngzuò, lìzhēng zài yuèdǐ qián ànshí jiāofù xìtǒng.
力争.en: The project team is working around the clock, striving to deliver the system on time before the end of the month.

理直气壮.zh: 既然我们没有违反任何合同条款，就可以理直气壮地拒绝对方的不合理要求。
理直气壮.py: Jìrán wǒmen méiyǒu wéifǎn rènhé hétong tiáokuǎn, jiù kěyǐ lǐzhí-qìzhuàng de jùjué duìfāng de bù hélǐ yāoqiú.
理直气壮.en: Since we have not violated any terms of the contract, we can refuse their unreasonable demands with full confidence and justification.

立足.zh: 这家初创企业立足本土市场，凭借优质的服务逐步赢得了客户的信赖。
立足.py: Zhè jiā chūchuàng qǐyè lìzú běntǔ shìchǎng, píngjiè yōuzhì de fúwù zhúbù yíngdé le kèhù de xìnlài.
立足.en: Grounded in the local market, this startup has gradually won customer trust through high-quality services.

垄断.zh: 政府出台反垄断法案，旨在防止大型科技企业过度垄断市场资源。
垄断.py: Zhèngfǔ chūtái fǎn lǒngduàn fǎ'àn, zhǐzài fángzhǐ dàxíng kējì qǐyè guòdù lǒngduàn shìchǎng zīyuán.
垄断.en: The government introduced antitrust legislation aimed at preventing large tech companies from excessively monopolizing market resources.

笼罩.zh: 清晨，弥漫的晨雾笼罩着整座山谷，宛如一幅淡雅的水墨画。
笼罩.py: Qīngchén, mímàn de chénwù lǒngzhào zhe zhěng zuò shāngǔ, wǎnrú yì fú dànyǎ de shuǐmòhuà.
笼罩.en: In the early morning, pervading mist enveloped the entire valley, resembling an elegant ink-wash painting.

隆重.zh: 学校在崭新的大礼堂为建校百年举行了隆重的庆祝大会。
隆重.py: Xuéxiào zài zhǎnxīn de dà lǐtáng wèi jiànxiào bǎinián jǔxíng le lóngzhòng de qìngzhù dàhuì.
隆重.en: The school held a grand celebration in its brand-new auditorium to mark its centennial anniversary.

搂.zh: 他搂起衣袖，弯腰把散落在地上的麦穗一把搂到了竹筐里。
搂.py: Tā lōu qǐ yīxiù, wānyāo bǎ sànluò zài dìshang de màisuì yì bǎ lōu dào le zhúkuāng lǐ.
搂.en: He rolled up his sleeves, bent down, and swept up the scattered ears of wheat into the bamboo basket.

屡次.zh: 尽管专家屡次提出警告，该工厂依然没有及时整改排污设施。
屡次.py: Jǐnguǎn zhuānjiā lǚcì tíchū jǐnggào, gāi gōngchǎng yīrán méiyǒu jíshí zhěnggǎi páiwū shèshī.
屡次.en: Despite repeated warnings from experts, the factory still failed to promptly overhaul its sewage disposal facilities.

掠夺.zh: 殖民统治者在历史上肆意掠夺当地的矿产资源和文化瑰宝。
掠夺.py: Zhímín tǒngzhìzhě zài lìshǐ shang sìyì lüèduó dāngdì de kuàngchǎn zīyuán hé wénhuà guībǎo.
掠夺.en: Colonial rulers historically pillaged local mineral resources and cultural treasures without restraint.

略微.zh: 听到这个令人意外的消息，他略微皱了皱眉，随即恢复了平静。
略微.py: Tīngdào zhè ge lìngrén yìwài de xiāoxi, tā lüèwēi zhòu le zhòu méi, suíjí huīfù le píngjìng.
略微.en: Hearing this unexpected news, he frowned slightly, and immediately regained his composure.

轮廓.zh: 夕阳西下，远处群山连绵的优美轮廓在晚霞中格外清晰。
轮廓.py: Xīyáng xīxià, yuǎnchù qúnshān liánmián de yōuměi lúnkuò zài wǎnxiá zhōng gèwài qīngxī.
轮廓.en: As the sun set, the graceful contours of the distant rolling mountains stood out clearly against the sunset glow.

落成.zh: 经过三年的紧张施工，这座现代化的国家大剧院终于顺利落成。
落成.py: Jīngguò sān nián de jǐnzhāng shīgōng, zhè zuò xiàndàihuà de guójiā dà jùyuàn zhōngyú shùnlì luòchéng.
落成.en: After three years of intensive construction, this modern national grand theater was finally completed successfully.

螺丝钉.zh: 技术工人仔细检查了机器的底座，并将松动的螺丝钉逐一拧紧。
螺丝钉.py: Jìshù gōngrén zǐxì jiǎnchá le jīqì de dǐzuò, bǐngjiāng sōngdòng de luósīdīng zhúyī nǐngjǐn.
螺丝钉.en: The technician carefully inspected the machine base and tightened each loose screw one by one.

啰唆.zh: 这份报告只要简明扼要地列出核心数据即可，无需进行过于啰唆的叙述。
啰唆.py: Zhè fèn bàogào zhǐyào jiǎnmíng'èyào de lièchū héxīn shùjù jíkě, wúxū jìnxíng guòyú luōsuo de xùshù.
啰唆.en: This report only needs to concisely present the core data, without the need for overly verbose descriptions.

络绎不绝.zh: 春节期间，前来这座古老寺庙祈福的香客络绎不绝。
络绎不绝.py: Chūnjié qījiān, qiánlái zhè zuò gǔlǎo sìmiào qífú de xiāngkè luòyì-bùjué.
络绎不绝.en: During the Spring Festival, an endless stream of pilgrims came to this ancient temple to pray for blessings.

炉灶.zh: 厨师在点火前仔细擦拭了炉灶，以确保厨房的操作安全。
炉灶.py: Chúshī zài diǎnhuǒ qián zǐxì cāshì le lúzào, yǐ quèbǎo chúfáng de cāozuò ānquán.
炉灶.en: The chef carefully wiped down the stove before lighting the fire to ensure kitchen operational safety.

麻痹.zh: 在安全生产管理上容不得半点麻痹大意，否则极易引发重大事故。
麻痹.py: Zài ānquán shēngchǎn guǎnlǐ shang róngbùdé bàndiǎn mábì dàyì, fǒuzé jíyì yǐnfā zhòngdà shìgù.
麻痹.en: In production safety management, there is no room for the slightest slackening of vigilance, otherwise serious accidents can easily occur.

埋没.zh: 真正的才华或许会被暂时埋没，但只要坚持努力，终究会闪闪发光。
埋没.py: Zhēnzhèng de cáihuá huòxǔ huì bèi zànshí máimò, dàn zhǐyào jiānchí nǔlì, zhōngjiū huì shǎnshǎn fāguāng.
埋没.en: True talent might be temporarily overlooked, but as long as one perseveres, it will eventually shine brightly.

埋葬.zh: 这位德高望重的老教授逝世后，被安详地埋葬在他倾注心血的大学后山。
埋葬.py: Zhè wèi dégāowàngzhòng de lǎo jiàoshòu shìshì hòu, bèi ānxiáng de máizàng zài tā qīngzhù xīnxuè de dàxué hòushān.
埋葬.en: After the highly respected old professor passed away, he was peacefully buried on the hill behind the university to which he had devoted his life.

慢性.zh: 长期保持规律的作息和健康的饮食，有助于有效预防多种慢性疾病。
慢性.py: Chángqī bǎochí guīlǜ de zuòxī hé jiànkāng de yǐnshí, yǒuzhù yú yǒuxiào yùfáng duō zhǒng mànxìng jíbìng.
慢性.en: Maintaining a regular daily routine and a healthy diet over the long term helps effectively prevent many chronic diseases.

冒充.zh: 不法分子企图冒充公职人员拨打电话，诱骗受害者转账汇款。
冒充.py: Bùfǎ fènzǐ qǐtú màochōng gōngzhí rényuán bōdǎ diànhuà, yòupiàn shòuhàizhě zhuǎnzhàng huìkuǎn.
冒充.en: Criminals attempted to impersonate public officials over phone calls to trick victims into transferring money.

茂盛.zh: 雨季过后，山坡上的植被变得异常茂盛，漫山遍野一片翠绿。
茂盛.py: Yǔjì guòhòu, shānpō shang de zhíbèi biàn de yìcháng màoshèng, mànshān-biànyě yí piàn cuìlǜ.
茂盛.en: After the rainy season, the vegetation on the hillside became exceptionally lush, covering the whole mountain in vibrant green.

枚.zh: 凭借在决赛中的出色发挥，这位年轻选手摘得了一枚宝贵的奥运金牌。
枚.py: Píngjiè zài juésài zhōng de chūsè fāhuī, zhè wèi niánqīng xuǎnshǒu zhāidé le yì méi bǎoguì de àoyùn jīnpái.
枚.en: With an outstanding performance in the final, this young athlete won a precious Olympic gold medal.

媒介.zh: 语言不仅是人们沟通思想的工具，也是传播人类文明的重要媒介。
媒介.py: Yǔyán bùjǐn shì rénmen gōutōng sīxiǎng de gōngjù, yě shì chuánbō rénlèi wénmíng de zhòngyào méijiè.
媒介.en: Language is not only a tool for people to communicate ideas, but also an important medium for transmitting human civilization.

美满.zh: 他们夫妻相互尊重、扶持多年，共同经营着一个美满幸福的家庭。
美满.py: Tāmen fūqī xiānghù zūnzhòng, fúchí duō nián, gòngtóng jīngyíngzhe yí ge měimǎn xìngfú de jiātíng.
美满.en: The couple has respected and supported each other for many years, jointly nurturing a blissful and happy family.

没辙.zh: 电脑频繁蓝屏死机，连维修人员反复排查后也感到束手无策、彻底没辙了。
没辙.py: Diànnǎo pínfán lánpíng sǐjī, lián wéixiū rényuán fǎnfù páichá hòu yě gǎndào shùshǒu-wúcè, chèdǐ méizhé le.
没辙.en: The computer kept crashing with blue screens, leaving even the repair technician at a complete loss after repeatedly troubleshooting it.

猛烈.zh: 台风携带着猛烈的暴风雨登陆沿海城市，造成多处树木被连根拔起。
猛烈.py: Táifēng xiédàizhe měngliè de bàofēngyǔ dēnglù yánhǎi chéngshì, zàochéng duō chù shùmù bèi liángēn báqǐ.
猛烈.en: The typhoon made landfall in coastal cities with fierce rainstorms, causing trees to be uprooted in many places.

萌芽.zh: 春天来临，泥土中沉睡的花草种子纷纷开始破土萌芽。
萌芽.py: Chūntiān láilín, nítǔ zhōng chénshuì de huācǎo zhǒngzi fēnfēn kāishǐ pòtǔ méngyá.
萌芽.en: With the arrival of spring, the sleeping seeds of flowers and grass in the soil began to sprout through the earth.

眯.zh: 突然刮起的一阵强风吹起漫天沙尘，一下眯了他的眼睛。
眯.py: Tūrán guāqǐ de yí zhèn qiángfēng chuīqǐ màntiān shāchén, yíxià mí le tā de yǎnjing.
眯.en: A sudden strong gust of wind blew up clouds of dust, momentarily blinding his eyes.

勉励.zh: 校长在开学典礼上发表讲话，勉励全体新生在求学道路上勇攀学术高峰。
勉励.py: Xiàozhǎng zài kāixué diǎnlǐ shang fābiǎo jiǎnghuà, miǎnlì quántǐ xīnshēng zài qiúxué dàolù shang yǒng pān xuéshù gāofēng.
勉励.en: The principal delivered a speech at the opening ceremony, encouraging all freshmen to courageously scale academic heights on their journey of learning.

渺小.zh: 站在茫茫无际的星空下，人们常常会深切感受到自身的渺小。
渺小.py: Zhàn zài mángmáng-wújì de xīngkōng xià, rénmen chángcháng huì shēnqiè gǎnshòudào zìshēn de miǎoxiǎo.
渺小.en: Standing beneath the boundless starry sky, people often deeply feel their own insignificance.

蔑视.zh: 正义的人们向来蔑视那些恃强凌弱的霸道行径。
蔑视.py: Zhèngyì de rénmen xiànglái mièshì nàxiē shìqiáng-língruò de bàdào xíngjìng.
蔑视.en: Upright people have always despised the tyrannical behavior of those who bully the weak.

密封.zh: 实验结束后，研究员将试剂瓶盖好并用胶带严格密封，以防止挥发。
密封.py: Shíyàn jiéshù hòu, yánjiūyuán bǎ shìjìpíng gài hǎo bǐng yòng jiāodài yángé mìfēng, yǐ fángzhǐ huīfā.
密封.en: After the experiment ended, the researcher capped the reagent bottle and strictly sealed it with tape to prevent volatilization.

迷惑.zh: 嫌疑人故意制造了虚假的行踪信息，企图迷惑负责调查的警官。
迷惑.py: Xiányírén gùyì zhìzào le xūjiǎ de xíngzōng xìnxī, qǐtú míhuo fùzé diàochá de jǐngguān.
迷惑.en: The suspect deliberately fabricated false whereabouts information in an attempt to confuse the investigating police officers.

名次.zh: 经过几个月的刻苦备战，他在全国中学生数学竞赛中取得了优异的名次。
名次.py: Jīngguò jǐ ge yuè de kèkǔ bèizhàn, tā zài quánguó zhōngxuéshēng shùxué jìngsài zhōng qǔdé le yōuyì de míngcì.
名次.en: After months of arduous preparation, he achieved an excellent rank in the national high school mathematics competition.

名副其实.zh: 这家餐厅食材新鲜且厨艺精湛，堪称名副其实的米其林三星餐厅。
名副其实.py: Zhè jiā cāntīng shícái xīnxiān qiě chúyì jīngzhàn, kānchēng míngfù-qíshí de mǐqílín sān xīng cāntīng.
名副其实.en: With fresh ingredients and exquisite culinary artistry, this restaurant is truly worthy of its three-star Michelin reputation.

敏捷.zh: 那位经验丰富的攀岩运动员动作敏捷，仅用了几分钟就登上了陡峭的岩壁。
敏捷.py: Nà wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de pānyán yùndòngyuán dòngzuò mǐnjié, jǐn yòng le jǐ fēnzhōng jiù dēngshàng le dǒuqiào de yánbì.
敏捷.en: That experienced rock climber was so agile that he scaled the steep cliff face in just a few minutes.

民用.zh: 该航空制造基地不仅生产货运飞机，还积极拓展民用客机的研发业务。
民用.py: Gāi hángkōng zhìzào jīdì bùjǐn shēngchǎn huòyùn fēijī, hái jījí tuòzhǎn mínyòng kèjī de yánfā yèwù.
民用.en: The aviation manufacturing base not only produces cargo planes, but also actively expands into the research and development of civilian passenger aircraft.

磨合.zh: 新团队组建初期难免出现分歧，但经过一段时间的磨合，配合变得十分默契。
磨合.py: Xīn tuánduì zǔjiàn chūqī nánmiǎn chūxiàn fēnqí, dàn jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān de móhé, pèihé biàn de shífēn mòqì.
磨合.en: In the early stages of forming a new team, differences were inevitable, but after a period of running-in and adaptation, their coordination became very seamless.

抹杀.zh: 无论外界如何评价，任何人都无法抹杀老一辈科学家为国家航天事业做出的巨大贡献。
抹杀.py: Wúlùn wàijiè rúhé píngjià, rènhé rén dōu wúfǎ mǒshā lǎoyíbèi kēxuéjiā wèi guójiā hángtiān shìyè zuòchū de jùdà gòngxiàn.
抹杀.en: Regardless of outside evaluations, no one can obliterate the immense contributions made by the older generation of scientists to the nation's aerospace cause.

墨水儿.zh: 这支钢笔里的墨水儿快用完了，需要重新吸一点儿。
墨水儿.py: Zhè zhī gāngbǐ lǐ de mòshuǐr kuài yòng wán le, xūyào chóngxīn xī yīdiǎnr.
墨水儿.en: The ink in this fountain pen has almost run out and needs to be refilled.

摸索.zh: 经过团队几个月的摸索，我们终于找到了一套高效的工作流程。
摸索.py: Jīngguò tuánduì jǐ gè yuè de mōsuo, wǒmen zhōngyú zhǎodào le yí tào gāoxiào de gōngzuò liúchéng.
摸索.en: After several months of exploration by the team, we finally found an efficient workflow.

谋求.zh: 两国政府正在积极谋求通过和平谈判解决长久以来的边界争端。
谋求.py: Liǎng guó zhèngfǔ zhèngzài jījí móuqiú tōngguò hépíng tànpàn jiějué chángjiǔ yǐlái de biānjiè zhēngduān.
谋求.en: Both governments are actively seeking to resolve the long-standing border dispute through peaceful negotiations.

沐浴.zh: 清晨，整座城市沐浴在温暖而明亮的阳光之中。
沐浴.py: Qīngchén, zhěng zuò chéngshì mùyù zài wēnnuǎn ér míngliàng de yángguāng zhī zhōng.
沐浴.en: In the early morning, the entire city was bathed in warm and bright sunshine.

耐用.zh: 这种新型材料不仅轻便环保，而且非常结实耐用。
耐用.py: Zhè zhǒng xīnxíng cáiliào bùjǐn qīngbiàn huánbǎo, érqiě fēicháng jiēshi nàiyòng.
耐用.en: This new type of material is not only lightweight and eco-friendly, but also very sturdy and durable.

纳闷儿.zh: 他平时总是准时到岗，今天却无故迟到了一个小时，大家都很纳闷儿。
纳闷儿.py: Tā píngshí zǒngshì zhǔnshí dàogǎng, jīntiān què wúgù chídào le yí gè xiǎoshí, dàjiā dōu hěn nàmènr.
纳闷儿.en: He is always punctual for work, but today he was an hour late without reason, which made everyone wonder.

难堪.zh: 当众被揭穿谎言让他感到十分难堪，恨不得找个地缝钻进去。
难堪.py: Dāngzhòng bèi jiēchuān huǎngyán ràng tā gǎndào shífēn nánkān, hènbude zhǎo gè dìfèng zuān jìnqu.
难堪.en: Having his lie exposed in public made him feel extremely embarrassed, wishing he could sink into the ground.

难能可贵.zh: 他在巨大的诱惑面前依然坚守原则，这种品质确实难能可贵。
难能可贵.py: Tā zài jùdà de yòuhuò miànqián yīrán jiānshǒu yuánzé, zhè zhǒng pǐnzhì quèshí nánnéngkěguì.
难能可贵.en: Sticking to his principles even in the face of great temptation is truly a commendable quality.

恼火.zh: 电脑突然死机导致未保存的文件全部丢失，让他感到异常恼火。
恼火.py: Diànnǎo tūrán sǐjī dǎozhì wèi bǎocún de wénjiàn quánbù diūshī, ràng tā gǎndào yìcháng nǎohuǒ.
恼火.en: The computer suddenly crashing and causing all unsaved files to be lost made him exceptionally annoyed.

内幕.zh: 这位资深记者在深度调查报告中揭露了该行业鲜为人知的内幕。
内幕.py: Zhè wèi zīshēn jìzhě zài shēndù diàochá bàogào zhōng jiēlù le gāi hángyè xiǎnwéirénzhī de nèimù.
内幕.en: In an in-depth investigative report, the senior journalist revealed the little-known inside story of this industry.

拟定.zh: 筹备委员会已经拟定了一份详细的活动方案，供领导层审阅。
拟定.py: Chóubèi wěiyuánhuì yǐjīng nǐdìng le yí fèn xiángxì de huódòng fāng'àn, gōng lǐngdǎocéng shěnyuè.
拟定.en: The preparatory committee has drafted a detailed activity plan for management's review.

捏.zh: 看着那名杂技演员在钢丝上摇晃，所有观众都为他捏了一把冷汗。
捏.py: Kànzhe nà míng zájì yǎnyuán zài gāngsī shang yáohuàng, suǒyǒu guānzhòng dōu wèi tā niē le yì bǎ lěnghàn.
捏.en: Watching the acrobat wobble on the tightrope, all the spectators broke into a cold sweat for him.

拧.zh: 洗完衣服后，她用力将床单上的水分拧干。
拧.py: Xǐ wán yīfu hòu, tā yònglì jiāng chuángdān shang de shuǐfèn níng gān.
拧.en: After washing the clothes, she vigorously wrung the water out of the bedsheet.

凝固.zh: 气温骤降使得山涧里的流水迅速凝固成了晶莹的冰块。
凝固.py: Qìwēn zhòujiàng shǐde shānjiàn lǐ de liúshuǐ xùnsù nínggù chéng le jīngyíng de bīngkuài.
凝固.en: The sudden drop in temperature caused the running water in the mountain stream to quickly solidify into translucent ice.

凝聚.zh: 这座跨海大桥凝聚了无数工程师和建设者多年的心血与智慧。
凝聚.py: Zhè zuò kuàhǎi dàqiáo níngjù le wúshù gōngchéngshī hé jiànshèzhě duō nián de xīnxuè yǔ zhìhuì.
凝聚.en: This sea-crossing bridge embodies years of painstaking effort and wisdom from countless engineers and builders.

凝视.zh: 老人静静地凝视着墙上泛黄的老照片，陷入了对往事的回忆。
凝视.py: Lǎorén jìngjìng de níngshì zhe qiáng shang fànhuáng de lǎo zhàopiàn, xiànrù le duì wǎngshì de huíyì.
凝视.en: The old man gazed quietly at the yellowed photograph on the wall, lost in memories of the past.

纽扣儿.zh: 衬衫领口上掉了一颗纽扣儿，出门前她特意找针线补上了。
纽扣儿.py: Chènshān lǐngkǒu shang diào le yì kē niǔkòur, chūmén qián tā tèyì zhǎo zhēnxiàn bǔ shang le.
纽扣儿.en: A button had fallen off the collar of the shirt, so before going out she specially found needle and thread to sew it back on.

扭转.zh: 经过及时的战术调整，该队终于在上半场结束前扭转了被动局面。
扭转.py: Jīngguò jíshí de zhànshù tiáozhěng, gāi duì zhōngyú zài shàngbànchǎng jiéshù qián niǔzhuǎn le bèidòng júmiàn.
扭转.en: Through timely tactical adjustments, the team finally turned around the unfavorable situation before the end of the first half.

挪.zh: 客厅显得有点拥挤，我们决定把这把单人沙发往角落挪一挪。
挪.py: Kètīng xiǎnde yǒudiǎnr yōngjǐ, wǒmen juédìng bǎ zhè bǎ dānrén shāfā wǎng jiǎoluò nuó yi nuó.
挪.en: The living room looks a bit crowded, so we decided to move this armchair slightly toward the corner.

殴打.zh: 几名蓄意滋事的人员因在公共场所殴打他人而受到了法律的严惩。
殴打.py: Jǐ míng xùyì zīshì de rényuán yīn zài gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ ōudǎ tārén ér shòudào le fǎlǜ de yánchéng.
殴打.en: Several individuals who deliberately caused trouble were severely punished by the law for beating people in a public place.

呕吐.zh: 吃了不卫生的海鲜之后，他整夜腹痛并伴有剧烈的呕吐症状。
呕吐.py: Chī le bù wèishēng de hǎixiān zhīhòu, tā zhěng yè fùtòng bìng bànyǒu jùliè de ǒutù zhèngzhuàng.
呕吐.en: After eating unsanitary seafood, he suffered from abdominal pain and severe vomiting throughout the night.

趴.zh: 连续工作了十几个小时后，他实在太累了，直接趴在桌子上睡着了。
趴.py: Liánxù gōngzuò le shí jǐ gè xiǎoshí hòu, tā shízài tài lèi le, zhíjiē pā zài zhuōzi shang shuìzháo le.
趴.en: After working continuously for over a dozen hours, he was so exhausted that he fell asleep resting right on his desk.

派别.zh: 在这个学术领域中，不同派别的学者们经常就理论基础展开热烈讨论。
派别.py: Zài zhè gè xuéshù lǐngyù zhōng, bùtóng pàibié de xuézhěmen jīngcháng jiù lǐlùn jīchǔ zhǎnkāi rèliè tǎolùn.
派别.en: In this academic field, scholars from different schools of thought frequently engage in heated discussions over theoretical foundations.

排斥.zh: 一个优秀的团队应该包容多元观点，而不是排斥提出建设性意见的新人。
排斥.py: Yí gè yōuxiù de tuánduì yīnggāi bāoróng duōyuán guāndiǎn, ér bú shì páichì tíchū jiànshèxìng yìjiàn de xīnrén.
排斥.en: An excellent team should embrace diverse viewpoints rather than reject newcomers who offer constructive suggestions.

徘徊.zh: 面对两个同样诱人的录用通知，他在选择上反复徘徊，迟迟难以下定决心。
徘徊.py: Miànduì liǎng gè tóngyàng yòurén de lùyòng tōngzhī, tā zài xuǎnzé shang fǎnfù páihuái, chíchí nányǐ xiàdìng juéxīn.
徘徊.en: Facing two equally enticing job offers, he wavered repeatedly in making a choice and hesitated to come to a final decision.

派遣.zh: 总部决定派遣几位技术骨干前往海外分公司协助调试新设备。
派遣.py: Zǒngbù juédìng pàiqiǎn jǐ wèi jìshù gǔgàn qiánwǎng hǎiwài fēngōngsī xiézhù tiáoshì xīn shèbèi.
