派遣.en: Headquarters decided to dispatch several key technical experts to the overseas branch to assist in commissioning the new equipment.

畔.zh: 傍晚时分，许多市民喜欢漫步在湖畔，欣赏夕阳西下的美景。
畔.py: Bàngwǎn shífēn, xǔduō shìmín xǐhuan mànbù zài húpàn, xīnshǎng xīyáng xī xià de měijǐng.
畔.en: At dusk, many residents enjoy taking a stroll by the lake, admiring the beautiful view of the setting sun.

攀登.zh: 登山队员们克服了高寒缺氧的极端恶劣环境，成功攀登上了主峰。
攀登.py: Dēngshān duìyuánmen kèfú le gāohán quēyǎng de jíduān èliè huánjìng, chénggōng pāndēng shang le zhǔfēng.
攀登.en: The mountaineers overcame extreme conditions of severe cold and lack of oxygen, successfully scaling the main peak.

盘旋.zh: 一只雄鹰展翅在高空盘旋，敏锐地搜寻着草原上的猎物。
盘旋.py: Yì zhī xióngyīng zhǎnchì zài gāokōng pánxuán, mǐnruì de sōuxún zhe cǎoyuán shang de lièwù.
盘旋.en: An eagle spread its wings and circled high in the sky, keenly searching for prey across the grassland.

泡沫.zh: 经济学家警告称，部分资产价格的非理性暴涨正在催生巨大的市场泡沫。
泡沫.py: Jīngjì xuéjiā jǐnggào chēng, bùfen zīchǎn jiàgé de fēilǐxìng bàozhǎng zhèngzài cuīshēng jùdà de shìchǎng pàomò.
泡沫.en: Economists warn that the irrational surge in certain asset prices is generating a massive market bubble.

抛弃.zh: 在面对突如其来的危机时，他们团结一心，绝不抛弃任何一名同伴。
抛弃.py: Zài miànduì tūruqílái de wēijī shí, tāmen tuánjié yìxīn, jué bù pāoqì rènhé yì míng tóngbàn.
抛弃.en: When facing a sudden crisis, they stood united and refused to abandon any teammate.

盆地.zh: 四川盆地四周群山环绕，气候温和湿润，土壤十分肥沃。
盆地.py: Sìchuān Péndì sìzhōu qúnshān huánrào, qìhòu wēnhé shīrùn, tǔrǎng shífēn féiwò.
盆地.en: The Sichuan Basin is surrounded by mountains on all sides, with a mild, humid climate and very fertile soil.

劈.zh: 伐木工熟练地挥动斧头，轻而易举地将那截厚重的圆木劈成了两半。
劈.py: Fámùgōng shúliàn de huīdòng fǔtou, qīng'éryǐjǔ de jiāng nà jié hòuzhòng de yuánmù pī chéng le liǎng bàn.
劈.en: The lumberjack swung the axe skillfully, effortlessly splitting the thick log into two.

偏差.zh: 实验仪器的微小偏差可能会对最终的科研数据产生不可忽视的影响。
偏差.py: Shíyàn yíqì de wéixiǎo piānchā kěnéng huì duì zuìzhōng de kēyán shùjù chǎnshēng bùkě hūshì de yǐngxiǎng.
偏差.en: A slight deviation in experimental instruments may have a non-negligible impact on the final scientific data.

片断.zh: 纪录片播放了几个珍贵的历史片断，生动再现了当年的动人场景。
片断.py: Jìlùpiàn bōfàng le jǐ gè zhēnguì de lìshǐ piànduàn, shēngdòng zàixiàn le dāngnián de dòngrén chǎngjǐng.
片断.en: The documentary broadcast several precious historical fragments, vividly recreating the moving scenes of that era.

偏僻.zh: 这座乡村图书馆建在偏僻的山村里，为当地孩子们打开了通往广阔世界的窗口。
偏僻.py: Zhè zuò xiāngcūn túshūguǎn jiàn zài piānpì de shāncūn lǐ, wèi dāngdì háizimen dǎkāi le tōngwǎng guǎngkuò shìjiè de chuāngkǒu.
偏僻.en: This rural library was built in a remote mountain village, opening a window to the wider world for local children.

偏偏.zh: 我今天出门偏偏忘了带雨伞，结果半路上突然下起了倾盆大雨。
偏偏.py: Wǒ jīntiān chūmén piānpiān wàng le dài yǔsǎn, jiéguǒ bànlù shang tūrán xià qǐ le qīngpén dàyǔ.
偏偏.en: Of all days, today I just had to forget my umbrella when leaving, and as luck would have it, it poured heavily halfway there.

漂浮.zh: 宇航员在空间站失重环境中能够轻松地在舱内漂浮。
漂浮.py: Yǔhángyuán zài kōngjiānzhàn shīzhòng huánjìng zhōng nénggòu qīngsōng de zài cāng nèi piāofú.
漂浮.en: Astronauts can easily float inside the cabin in the weightless environment of the space station.

飘扬.zh: 鲜艳的国旗在雄壮的国歌声中冉冉升起，在微风中迎风飘扬。
飘扬.py: Xiānyàn de guóqí zài xióngzhuàng de guógē shēng zhōng rǎnrǎn shēngqǐ, zài wēifēng zhōng yíngfēng piāoyáng.
飘扬.en: The bright national flag rose slowly to the majestic national anthem, fluttering in the breeze.

批发.zh: 他在城郊开了一家农产品批发中心，每天向各大超市供应新鲜蔬菜。
批发.py: Tā zài chéngjiāo kāi le yì jiā nóngchǎnpǐn pīfā zhōngxīn, měitiān xiàng gè dà chāoshì gōngyìng xīnxiān shūcài.
批发.en: He opened an agricultural wholesale center on the outskirts of the city, supplying fresh vegetables to major supermarkets every day.

拼搏.zh: 运动健儿们在赛场上顽强拼搏，最终为国家赢得了宝贵的金牌。
拼搏.py: Yùndòng jiàn'érmen zài sàichǎng shang wánqiáng pīnbó, zuìzhōng wèi guójiā yíngdé le bǎoguì de jīnpái.
拼搏.en: The athletes fought tenaciously on the field and ultimately won a precious gold medal for the country.

品德.zh: 学校在传授文化知识的同时，也非常注重培养学生诚实守信的优良品德。
品德.py: Xuéxiào zài chuánshòu wénhuà zhīshi de tóngshí, yě fēicháng zhùzhòng péiyǎng xuésheng chéngshí shǒuxìn de yōuliáng pǐndé.
品德.en: While imparting academic knowledge, the school also places great emphasis on cultivating students' fine moral character of honesty and trustworthiness.

贫乏.zh: 长期缺乏深入阅读会导致一个人的词汇量和思想内容都变得贫乏。
贫乏.py: Chángqī quēfá shēnrù yuèdú huì dǎozhì yí gè rén de cíhuìliàng hé sīxiǎng nèiróng dōu biànde pínfá.
贫乏.en: A prolonged lack of deep reading can cause a person's vocabulary and thoughts to become impoverished.

平面.zh: 建筑师在平面图上清晰地标明了各个功能区的位置和走廊尺寸。
平面.py: Jiànzhùshī zài píngmiàntú shang qīngxī de biāomíng le gè ge gōngnéngqū de wèizhi hé zǒuláng chǐcun.
平面.en: The architect clearly marked the locations of each functional zone and corridor dimensions on the floor plan.

屏障.zh: 广袤的防护林就像一道绿色的天然屏障，有效阻挡了风沙的侵袭。
屏障.py: Guǎngmào de fánghùlín jiù xiàng yí dào lǜsè de tiānrán píngzhàng, yǒuxiào zǔdǎng le fēngshā de qīnxí.
屏障.en: The vast shelterbelt is like a natural green barrier, effectively blocking the invasion of sandstorms.

品行.zh: 他在工作中不仅业务精湛，而且品行端正，深受同事们的尊敬。
品行.py: Tā zài gōngzuò zhōng bùjǐn yèwù jīngzhàn, érqiě pǐnxíng duānzhèng, shēnshòu tóngshìmen de zūnjìng.
品行.en: In his work, he not only exhibits superb professional skill but also upright moral conduct, earning deep respect from his colleagues.

批判.zh: 大学教育应当鼓励学生培养批判性思维，而不是盲目接受现成结论。
批判.py: Dàxué jiàoyù yīngdāng gǔlì xuésheng péiyǎng pīpànxìng sīwéi, ér bú shì mángmù jiēshòu xiànchéng jiélùn.
批判.en: Higher education should encourage students to cultivate critical thinking rather than blindly accept ready-made conclusions.

颇.zh: 这篇学术论文见解独到且论证严谨，在学术界引起了颇多关注与讨论。
颇.py: Zhè piān xuéshù lùnwén jiànjiě dúdào qiě lùnzhèng yánjǐn, zài xuéshùjiè yǐnqǐ le pō duō guānzhù yǔ tǎolùn.
颇.en: This academic paper offered insightful viewpoints and rigorous reasoning, attracting considerable attention and discussion in academia.

迫害.zh: 这位科学家在战争期间遭受了残酷的政治迫害，但他始终没有放弃对真理的追求。
迫害.py: Zhè wèi kēxuéjiā zài zhànzhēng qījiān zàoshòu le cánkù de zhèngzhì pòhài, dàn tā shǐzhōng méiyǒu fàngqì duì zhēnlǐ de zhuīqiú.
迫害.en: The scientist suffered cruel political persecution during the war, but he never gave up his pursuit of truth.

魄力.zh: 新任执行官以非凡的魄力推行了公司重组计划，成功带领企业走出危机。
魄力.py: Xīnrèn zhíxíngguān yǐ fēifán de pòlì tuīxíng le gōngsī chóngzǔ jìhuà, chénggōng dàilǐng qǐyè zǒuchū wēijī.
魄力.en: With remarkable boldness and determination, the newly appointed CEO implemented the corporate restructuring plan, successfully leading the enterprise out of crisis.

朴实.zh: 这位老教授生活十分朴实，把大部分积蓄都捐给了贫困学生。
朴实.py: Zhè wèi lǎo jiàoshòu shēnghuó shífēn pǔshí, bǎ dà bùfen jīxù dōu juān gěile pínkùn xuésheng.
朴实.en: This elderly professor lives a very simple life and donated most of his savings to underprivileged students.

掐.zh: 园艺师轻轻掐掉了多余的花蕾，以确保主花能开得更加饱满。
掐.py: Yuányìshī qīngqīng qiādiàole duōyú de huālěi, yǐ quèbǎo zhǔhuā néng kāi de gèngjiā bǎomǎn.
掐.en: The gardener gently pinched off the excess buds to ensure the main flower would bloom more fully.

恰到好处.zh: 这道菜的咸淡调得恰到好处，既保留了海鲜的原味，又十分鲜美。
恰到好处.py: Zhè dào cài de xiándàn tiáo de qiàdàohǎochù, jì bǎoliúle hǎixiān de yuánwèi, yòu shífēn xiānměi.
恰到好处.en: The seasoning of this dish is just right, preserving the original flavor of the seafood while being delicious.

牵扯.zh: 这项改革方案牵扯到很多部门的利益，需要各方进行充分协商。
牵扯.py: Zhè xiàng gǎigé fāng'àn qiānchě dào hěnduō bùmén de lìyì, xūyào gèfāng jìnxíng chōngfèn xiéshāng.
牵扯.en: This reform plan involves the interests of many departments and requires thorough consultation among all parties.

千方百计.zh: 研发团队千方百计地克服了技术瓶颈，终于按期交付了产品。
千方百计.py: Yánfā tuánduì qiānfāng bǎijì de kèfúle jìshù píngjǐng, zhōngyú ànqī jiāofùle chǎnpǐn.
千方百计.en: The R&D team tried every possible means to overcome technical bottlenecks and finally delivered the product on schedule.

迁就.zh: 在人际交往中，一味迁就别人往往会让自己感到委屈和疲惫。
迁就.py: Zài rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng, yíwèi qiānjiù biérén wǎngwǎng huì ràng zìjǐ gǎndào wěiqu hé píbèi.
迁就.en: In interpersonal interactions, constantly accommodating others often leaves one feeling aggrieved and exhausted.

迁徙.zh: 每年深秋，成群的候鸟都会迁徙到温暖的南方过冬。
迁徙.py: Měinián shēnqiū, chéngqún de hòuniǎo dōuhuì qiānxǐ dào wēnnuǎn de nánfāng guòdōng.
迁徙.en: Every late autumn, flocks of migratory birds migrate to the warm south to spend the winter.

潜移默化.zh: 家庭环境对孩子品格的形成起着潜移默化的作用。
潜移默化.py: Jiātíng huánjìng duì háizi pǐngé de xíngchéng qǐzhe qiányí mòhuà de zuòyòng.
潜移默化.en: The family environment exerts a subtle, imperceptible influence on the formation of a child's character.

谴责.zh: 国际社会一致谴责这种针对平民的暴力袭击行为。
谴责.py: Guójì shèhuì yízhì qiǎnzé zhè zhǒng zhēnduì píngmín de bàolì xíjī xíngwéi.
谴责.en: The international community unanimously condemned this violent attack targeting civilians.

牵制.zh: 前锋队员在前场积极跑位，成功牵制了对方的主力后卫。
牵制.py: Qiánfēng duìyuán zài qiánchǎng jījí pǎowèi, chénggōng qiānzhìle duìfāng de zhǔlì hòuwèi.
牵制.en: The forward moved actively in the attacking third, successfully tying down the opponent's key defender.

翘.zh: 游子们翘首期盼着假期的到来，希望能早日与家人团聚。
翘.py: Yóuzǐmen qiáoshǒu qīpànzhe jiàqī de dàolái, xīwàng néng zǎorì yǔ jiārén tuánjù.
翘.en: Travelers living far from home eagerly look forward to the coming vacation, hoping to reunite with their families soon.

器材.zh: 学校的体育馆里配备了各种现代化的健身器材。
器材.py: Xuéxiào de tǐyùguǎn lǐ pèibèile gèzhǒng xiàndàihuà de jiànshēn qìcái.
器材.en: The school gymnasium is equipped with various modern fitness equipment.

起草.zh: 法律顾问正在加班起草一份新的合作合同。
起草.py: Fǎlǜ gùwèn zhèngzài jiābān qǐcǎo yí fèn xīn de hézuò hétong.
起草.en: The legal counsel is working overtime to draft a new cooperation contract.

启程.zh: 考察队整装待发，准备明天清晨正式启程前往极地。
启程.py: Kǎocháduì zhěngzhuāng dàifā, zhǔnbèi míngtiān qīngchén zhèngshì qǐchéng qiánwǎng jídì.
启程.en: Packed and ready, the expedition team is prepared to set out officially for the polar region tomorrow morning.

锲而不舍.zh: 凭借着锲而不舍的努力，她终于攻克了这项复杂的科学难题。
锲而不舍.py: Píngjièzhe qiè'érbùshě de nǔlì, tā zhōngyú gōngkèle zhè xiàng fùzá de kēxué nántí.
锲而不舍.en: With unremitting perseverance, she finally conquered this complex scientific problem.

气概.zh: 登山队员们面对暴风雪毫无惧色，展现出了顽强无畏的英雄气概。
气概.py: Dēngshān duìyuánmen miànduì bàofēngxuě háowú jùsè, zhǎnxiànchūle wánqiáng wúwèi de yīngxióng qìgài.
气概.en: Facing the blizzard without fear, the mountaineers displayed tenacious and fearless heroic mettle.

气功.zh: 这位老人坚持每天清晨在公园里练习气功，身体十分硬朗。
气功.py: Zhè wèi lǎorén jiānchí měitiān qīngchén zài gōngyuán lǐ liànxí qìgōng, shēntǐ shífēn yìnglǎng.
气功.en: This elderly man insists on practicing qigong in the park every morning and remains in robust health.

起哄.zh: 当演员在台上出现失误时，台下几名无礼的观众开始大声起哄。
起哄.py: Dāng yǎnyuán zài táishàng chūxiàn shīwù shí, táixià jǐ míng wúlǐ de guānzhòng kāishǐ dàshēng qǐhòng.
起哄.en: When the actor made a mistake on stage, several rude spectators in the audience began heckling loudly.

迄今为止.zh: 这是迄今为止该领域发现的最古老的化石标本。
迄今为止.py: Zhè shì qìjīnwéizhǐ gāi lǐngyù fāxiàn de zuì gǔlǎo de huàshí biāoběn.
迄今为止.en: This is the oldest fossil specimen discovered in this field to date.

氢.zh: 氢是一种清洁能源，在燃烧后只产生水，不会对环境造成污染。
氢.py: Qīng shì yì zhǒng qīngjié néngyuán, zài ránshāo hòu zhǐ chǎnshēng shuǐ, búhuì duì huánjìng zàochéng wūrǎn.
氢.en: Hydrogen is a clean energy source that produces only water after combustion and does not cause environmental pollution.

请柬.zh: 我们已经向所有亲朋好友寄出了婚礼的请柬。
请柬.py: Wǒmen yǐjīng xiàng suǒyǒu qīnpéng hǎoyǒu jìchūle hūnlǐ de qǐngjiǎn.
请柬.en: We have already sent out wedding invitations to all our relatives and close friends.

情理.zh: 他因为突发疾病而缺席会议，这在情理之中，大家都表示理解。
情理.py: Tā yīnwèi tūfā jíbìng ér quēxí huìyì, zhè zài qínglǐ zhīzhōng, dàjiā dōu biǎoshì lǐjiě.
情理.en: His absence from the meeting due to a sudden illness was only reasonable, and everyone understood.

请示.zh: 遇到重大紧急情况时，我们必须先向主管部门请示，不可擅自决定。
请示.py: Yùdào zhòngdà jǐnjí qíngkuàng shí, wǒmen bìxū xiān xiàng zhǔguǎn bùmén qǐngshì, bùkě shànzì juédìng.
请示.en: When encountering major emergencies, we must first ask for instructions from the department in charge and not make arbitrary decisions.

倾斜.zh: 这座古塔因地基不均匀沉降而发生了明显的倾斜。
倾斜.py: Zhè zuò gǔtǎ yīn dìjī bù jūnyún chénjiàng ér fāshēngle míngxiǎn de qīngxié.
倾斜.en: This ancient pagoda developed a noticeable tilt due to uneven foundation settlement.

勤俭.zh: 勤俭节约是中华民族的传统美德，任何时候都不应该被丢弃。
勤俭.py: Qínjiǎn jiéyuē shì Zhōnghuá mínzú de chuántǒng měidé, rènhé shíhou dōu bù yīnggāi bèi diūqì.
勤俭.en: Hard work and thrift are traditional virtues of the Chinese nation and should never be abandoned at any time.

勤恳.zh: 他工作踏实勤恳，交代给他的每项任务都能按时保质完成。
勤恳.py: Tā gōngzuò tàshi qínkěn, jiāodài gěi tā de měi xiàng rènwu dōu néng ànshí bǎozhì wánchéng.
勤恳.en: He is dependable and diligent in his work, completing every task assigned to him on time and with high quality.

亲热.zh: 几年不见，姐妹俩一见面就亲热地聊个不停。
亲热.py: Jǐ nián bú jiàn, jiěmèiliǎ yí jiànmiàn jiù qīnrè de liáo gè bùtíng.
亲热.en: Having not seen each other for several years, the two sisters chatted affectionately without stopping as soon as they met.

气魄.zh: 这位青年企业家敢于开拓新市场，展现出了非凡的胆略和气魄。
气魄.py: Zhè wèi qīngnián qǐyèjiā gǎnyú kāituò xīn shìchǎng, zhǎnxiànchūle fēifán de dǎnlüè hé qìpò.
气魄.en: This young entrepreneur dared to open up new markets, demonstrating extraordinary boldness and vision.

气色.zh: 经过一段时间的休养，她的气色明显比之前红润多了。
气色.py: Jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān de xiūyǎng, tā de qìsè míngxiǎn bǐ zhīqián hóngrùn duō le.
气色.en: After a period of recuperation, her complexion looked noticeably rosier than before.

气势.zh: 黄河瀑布奔腾而下，气势磅礴，令人叹为观止。
气势.py: Huánghé pùbù bēnténg ér xià, qìshì pángbó, lìngrén tànwéiguānzhǐ.
气势.en: The Yellow River waterfall cascades down with magnificent momentum, leaving visitors in awe.

齐心协力.zh: 只要大家齐心协力，就没有克服不了的困难。
齐心协力.py: Zhǐyào dàjiā qíxīn xiélì, jiù méiyǒu kèfú bùliǎo de kùnnan.
齐心协力.en: As long as everyone works together with one heart, there is no difficulty that cannot be overcome.

岂有此理.zh: 他无缘无故就把别人的功劳据为己有，真是岂有此理！
岂有此理.py: Tā wúyuán wúgù jiù bǎ biérén de gōngláo jùwéijǐyǒu, zhēnshi qǐyǒucǐlǐ!
岂有此理.en: He claimed other people's credit as his own for no reason at all; this is simply outrageous!

犬.zh: 城市管理部门规定，居民饲养犬只必须按时接种疫苗并办理登记。
犬.py: Chéngshì guǎnlǐ bùmén guīdìng, jūmín sìyǎng quǎnzhī bìxū ànshí jiēzhòng yìmiáo bìng bànlǐ dēngjì.
犬.en: Urban management regulations stipulate that residents keeping dogs must vaccinate and register them on time.

权衡.zh: 在做出最终决定之前，我们必须仔细权衡各种方案的利弊。
权衡.py: Zài zuòchū zuìzhōng juédìng zhīqián, wǒmen bìxū zǐxì quánhéng gèzhǒng fāng'àn de lìbì.
权衡.en: Before making a final decision, we must carefully weigh the pros and cons of various options.

全局.zh: 作为项目负责人，他善于统筹规划，能够从全局出发考虑问题。
全局.py: Zuòwéi xiàngmù fùzérén, tā shànyú tǒngchóu guīhuà, nénggòu cóng quánjú chūfā kǎolǜ wèntí.
全局.en: As the project leader, he is good at overall planning and able to consider issues from the perspective of the big picture.

圈套.zh: 他警惕性很高，一眼就识破了骗子精心设计的圈套。
圈套.py: Tā jǐngtìxìng hěn gāo, yì yǎn jiù shípòle piànzi jīngxīn shèjì de quāntào.
圈套.en: He was very vigilant and immediately saw through the trap meticulously devised by the swindler.

权益.zh: 消费者协会致力于保护广大消费者的合法权益不受侵害。
权益.py: Xiāofèizhě xiéhuì zhìlì yú bǎohù guǎngdà xiāofèizhě de héfǎ quányì bú shòu qīnhài.
权益.en: The consumer association is dedicated to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of consumers from being infringed upon.

取缔.zh: 执法部门依法取缔了数个在居民区内违规设立的黑工厂。
取缔.py: Zhífǎ bùmén yīfǎ qǔdìle shù gè zài jūmínqū nèi wéiguī shèlì de hēi gōngchǎng.
取缔.en: Law enforcement authorities shut down several illegal factories set up in violation of regulations in residential areas according to law.

瘸.zh: 他的左腿在多年前的一场意外中受了伤，走起路来有些瘸。
瘸.py: Tā de zuǒtuǐ zài duōnián qián de yì chǎng yìwài zhōng shòule shāng, zǒuqǐlù lái yǒuxiē qué.
瘸.en: His left leg was injured in an accident years ago, leaving him with a slight limp when walking.

曲折.zh: 这部小说的故事情节十分曲折，引人入胜。
曲折.py: Zhè bù xiǎoshuō de gùshi qíngjié shífēn qūzhé, yǐnrén rùshèng.
曲折.en: The plot of this novel is full of twists and turns, making it fascinating to read.

让步.zh: 经过艰苦的谈判，双方最终都在价格问题上做出了一定让步。
让步.py: Jīngguò jiānkǔ de tánpàn, shuāngfāng zuìzhōng dōu zài jiàgé wèntí shàng zuòchūle yídìng ràngbù.
让步.en: After grueling negotiations, both sides finally made certain concessions on the pricing issue.

扰乱.zh: 故意散布谣言会扰乱公共秩序，将依法受到严厉处罚。
扰乱.py: Gùyì sànbù yáoyán huì rǎoluàn gōnggòng zhìxù, jiāng yīfǎ shòudào yánlì chǔfá.
扰乱.en: Deliberately spreading rumors disrupts public order and will be severely punished according to law.

饶恕.zh: 他的所作所为彻底伤害了家人的信任，这是无论如何也无法饶恕的。
饶恕.py: Tā de suǒzuò suǒwéi chèdǐ shānghàile jiārén de xìnrèn, zhè shì wúlùn rúhé yě wúfǎ ráoshù de.
饶恕.en: His actions completely shattered the trust of his family, which could not be forgiven under any circumstances.

人道.zh: 红十字会向遭受战乱的地区紧急运送了大批人道救援物资。
人道.py: Hóngshízìhuì xiàng zāoshòu zhànluàn de dìqū jǐnjí yùnsòngle dàpī réndào jiùyuán wùzī.
人道.en: The Red Cross rushed a large shipment of humanitarian relief supplies to the war-torn region.

任重道远.zh: 消除贫困和保护生态环境是一项长期的系统工程，可谓任重道远。
任重道远.py: Xiāochú pínkùn hé bǎohù shēngtài huánjìng shì yí xiàng chángqī de xìtǒng gōngchéng, kěwèi rènzhòng dàoyuǎn.
任重道远.en: Eradicating poverty and protecting the ecological environment is a long-term systematic endeavor; the burden is indeed heavy and the road long.

日新月异.zh: 现代信息技术发展日新月异，深刻改变了人们的生活方式。
日新月异.py: Xiàndài xìnxī jìshù fāzhǎn rìxīn yuèyì, shēnkè gǎibiànle rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
日新月异.en: Modern information technology is advancing rapidly with each passing day, profoundly changing people's ways of life.

溶解.zh: 将少量的食盐放入温水中搅拌，很快就会完全溶解。
溶解.py: Jiāng shǎoliàng de shíyán fàngrù wēnshuǐ zhōng jiǎobàn, hěn kuài jiù huì wánquán róngjiě.
溶解.en: Put a small amount of table salt into warm water and stir; it will quickly dissolve completely.

容器.zh: 请将实验剩余的化学试剂密封存放在专用的玻璃容器中。
容器.py: Qǐng jiāng shíyàn shèngyú de huàxué shìjì mìfēng cúnfàng zài zhuānyòng de bōli róngqì zhōng.
容器.en: Please seal and store the surplus chemical reagents from the experiment in dedicated glass containers.

揉.zh: 他长时间盯着电脑屏幕，感到双眼酸痛，便闭上眼睛轻轻揉了揉太阳穴。
揉.py: Tā cháng shíjiān dīngzhe diànnǎo píngmù, gǎndào shuāngyǎn suāntòng, biàn bìshang yǎnjing qīngqīng róule rou tàiyángxué.
揉.en: Having stared at the computer screen for a long time, his eyes felt sore, so he closed his eyes and gently rubbed his temples.

柔和.zh: 卧室里安装了暖光灯，柔和的光线让人感到十分放松。
柔和.py: Wòshì lǐ ānzhuāngle nuǎnguāngdēng, róuhé de guāngxiàn ràng rén gǎndào shífēn fàngsōng.
柔和.en: Warm lighting was installed in the bedroom, and the soft light makes one feel very relaxed.

若干.zh: 专家对这个方案提出了若干项修改意见。
若干.py: Zhuānjiā duì zhège fāng'àn tíchū le ruògān xiàng xiūgǎi yìjiàn.
若干.en: The experts put forward several suggestions for amending this plan.

撒谎.zh: 做人应该讲究诚信，绝不能故意撒谎。
撒谎.py: Zuòrén yīnggāi jiǎngjiu chéngxìn, jué bù néng gùyì sāhuǎng.
撒谎.en: One should value integrity and must never tell lies on purpose.

腮.zh: 外面天气很冷，她的双腮被冻得通红。
腮.py: Wàimiàn tiānqì hěn lěng, tā de shuāng sāi bèi dòng de tōnghóng.
腮.en: The weather was freezing outside, and her cheeks turned bright red from the cold.

散布.zh: 任何人都不得在网络上散布虚假谣言。
散布.py: Rènhé rén dōu bùdé zài wǎngluò shang sànbù xūjiǎ yáoyán.
散布.en: No one is allowed to spread false rumors on the internet.

嫂子.zh: 哥哥结婚后，嫂子对家里人一直非常照顾。
嫂子.py: Gēge jiéhūn hòu, sǎozi duì jiālǐrén yìzhí fēicháng zhàogù.
嫂子.en: After my older brother got married, my sister-in-law has always taken great care of the family.

啥.zh: 你有什么心里话就直接说出来，别吞吞吐吐的，到底怕啥？
啥.py: Nǐ yǒu shénme xīnlǐhuà jiù zhíjiē shuō chūlai, bié tūntūntǔtǔ de, dàodǐ pà shá?
啥.en: If you have something on your mind, just say it directly without hesitating; what on earth are you afraid of?

上进心.zh: 他年轻有为，工作认真，而且富有上进心。
上进心.py: Tā niánqīng yǒuwéi, gōngzuò rènzhēn, érqiě fùyǒu shàngjìnxīn.
上进心.en: He is young and promising, conscientious at work, and full of ambition to improve.

伤脑筋.zh: 如何在有限的预算内完成这项大型工程，确实很让人伤脑筋。
伤脑筋.py: Rúhé zài yǒuxiàn de yùsuàn nèi wánchéng zhè xiàng dàxíng gōngchéng, quèshí hěn ràng rén shāngnǎojīn.
伤脑筋.en: How to complete this large-scale project within a limited budget is indeed a real headache.

上瘾.zh: 长时间沉迷于手机游戏很容易让人上瘾。
上瘾.py: Cháng shíjiān chénmí yú shǒujī yóuxì hěn róngyì ràng rén shàngyǐn.
上瘾.en: Spending long periods engrossed in mobile games easily gets people addicted.

山脉.zh: 这条雄伟的山脉自西向东横跨了整个省份。
山脉.py: Zhè tiáo xióngwěi de shānmài zì xī xiàng dōng héngkuà le zhěnggè shěngfèn.
山脉.en: This magnificent mountain range stretches from west to east across the entire province.

闪烁.zh: 夜晚的星空格外晴朗，无数颗星星在天空中闪烁。
闪烁.py: Yèwǎn de xīngkōng géwài qínglǎng, wúshù kē xīngxing zài tiānkōng zhōng shǎnshuò.
闪烁.en: The night sky was exceptionally clear, with countless stars twinkling overhead.

擅自.zh: 未经公司允许，任何员工都不能擅自离开工作岗位。
擅自.py: Wèijīng gōngsī yǔnxǔ, rènhé yuángōng dōu bù néng shànzì líkāi gōngzuò gǎngwèi.
擅自.en: Without company permission, no employee is allowed to leave their work post without authorization.

哨.zh: 裁判吹响了比赛结束的哨声，全场观众欢呼起来。
哨.py: Cáipàn chuīxiǎng le bǐsài jiéshù de shàoshēng, quánchǎng guānzhòng huānhū qǐlai.
哨.en: The referee blew the final whistle of the match, and the entire audience erupted in cheers.

捎.zh: 你去超市的时候，能帮我捎一盒牛奶回来吗？
捎.py: Nǐ qù chāoshì de shíhou, néng bāng wǒ shāo yì hé niúnǎi huílai ma?
捎.en: When you go to the supermarket, could you bring back a carton of milk for me?

梢.zh: 清晨，几只小鸟站在树梢上欢快地歌唱。
梢.py: Qīngchén, jǐ zhī xiǎoniǎo zhàn zài shùshāo shang huānkuài de gēchàng.
梢.en: In the early morning, a few little birds stood on the treetops singing cheerfully.

奢侈.zh: 追求过度奢侈的生活方式往往会带来沉重的经济负担。
奢侈.py: Zhuīqiú guòdù shēchǐ de shēnghuó fāngshì wǎngwǎng huì dàilái chénzhòng de jīngjì fùdān.
奢侈.en: Pursuing an excessively extravagant lifestyle often brings a heavy financial burden.

深奥.zh: 这本哲学著作内容深奥，需要反复阅读才能理解。
深奥.py: Zhè běn zhéxué zhùzuò nèiróng shēn'ào, xūyào fǎnfù yuèdú cáinéng lǐjiě.
深奥.en: The content of this philosophical book is abstruse and requires repeated reading to understand.

深沉.zh: 父亲虽然话不多，但他对孩子的爱却无比深沉。
深沉.py: Fùqīn suīrán huà bù duō, dàn tā duì háizi de ài què wúbǐ shēnchén.
深沉.en: Although father did not speak much, his love for his children was profoundly deep.

牲畜.zh: 牧民们在辽阔的草原上放牧着成群的牲畜。
牲畜.py: Mùmínmen zài liáokuò de cǎoyuán shang fàngmù zhe chéngqún de shēngchù.
牲畜.en: The herders grazed herds of livestock across the vast grassland.

生机.zh: 春天到了，万物复苏，大地处处充满了生机。
生机.py: Chūntiān dào le, wànwù fùsū, dàdì chùchù chōngmǎn le shēngjī.
生机.en: Spring has arrived, all things are reviving, and the earth is full of vitality everywhere.

生理.zh: 长期睡眠不足会对人体的正常生理功能产生不良影响。
生理.py: Chángqī shuìmián bùzú huì duì réntǐ de zhèngcháng shēnglǐ gōngnéng chǎnshēng bùliáng yǐngxiǎng.
生理.en: Long-term lack of sleep will adversely affect the body's normal physiological functions.

盛情.zh: 面对主人的盛情款待，客人们感到十分温暖和感激。
盛情.py: Miànduì zhǔrén de shèngqíng kuǎndài, kèrénmen gǎndào shífēn wēnnuǎn hé gǎnjī.
盛情.en: In the face of the host's warm hospitality, the guests felt very touched and grateful.

声势.zh: 这场环保宣传活动声势浩大，吸引了数万名市民积极参与。
声势.py: Zhè chǎng huánbǎo xuānchuán huódòng shēngshì hàodà, xīyǐn le shù wàn míng shìmín jījí cānyù.
声势.en: This environmental protection campaign had tremendous momentum, attracting tens of thousands of citizens to participate actively.

生疏.zh: 我已经好几年没拉小提琴了，指法变得有些生疏。
生疏.py: Wǒ yǐjīng hǎo jǐ nián méi lā xiǎotíqín le, zhǐfǎ biàn de yǒuxiē shēngshū.
生疏.en: I haven't played the violin for several years, so my fingerings have become somewhat rusty.

生育.zh: 政府出台了一系列鼓励生育和减轻家庭育儿负担的新政策。
生育.py: Zhèngfǔ chūtái le yíxìliè gǔlì shēngyù hé jiǎnqīng jiātíng yù'ér fùdān de xīn zhèngcè.
生育.en: The government introduced a series of new policies to encourage childbirth and ease the burden of raising children on families.

神气.zh: 弟弟穿上整洁的新校服，走起路来显得格外神气。
神气.py: Dìdi chuān shàng zhěngjié de xīn xiàofú, zǒu qǐlù lái xiǎnde géwài shénqì.
神气.en: Wearing his neat new school uniform, my younger brother looked especially spirited when walking.

深情厚谊.zh: 两国人民在长期的互助合作中结下了深情厚谊。
深情厚谊.py: Liǎng guó rénmín zài chángqī de hùzhù hézuò zhōng jiéxià le shēnqíng hòuyì.
深情厚谊.en: The people of both countries have forged a profound friendship through long-term mutual assistance and cooperation.

神色.zh: 看到医生从手术室走出来，家属们神色紧张地迎了上去。
神色.py: Kàndào yīshēng cóng shǒushùshì zǒu chūlai, jiāshǔmen shénsè jǐnzhāng de yíng le shàngqu.
神色.en: Seeing the doctor emerge from the operating room, the family members nervously stepped forward to meet him.

神态.zh: 老画家作画时神态从容，每一笔都显得游刃有余。
神态.py: Lǎo huàjiā zuòhuà shí shéntài cóngróng, měi yì bǐ dōu xiǎnde yóurènyǒuyú.
神态.en: The veteran painter had a composed demeanor while painting, handling every stroke with effortless ease.

渗透.zh: 数字化技术已经全面渗透到了我们日常生活的方方面面。
渗透.py: Shùzìhuà jìshù yǐjīng quánmiàn shèntòu dào le wǒmen rìcháng shēnghuó de fāngfāngmiànmiàn.
渗透.en: Digital technology has fully permeated every aspect of our daily lives.

神仙.zh: 在中国古代神话中，神仙往往拥有腾云驾雾的本领。
神仙.py: Zài Zhōngguó gǔdài shénhuà zhōng, shénxiān wǎngwǎng yōngyǒu téngyúnjiàwù de běnlǐng.
神仙.en: In ancient Chinese mythology, immortals often possessed the power to ride on clouds and mists.

呻吟.zh: 病房里的伤员因伤口剧痛而忍不住痛苦地呻吟。
呻吟.py: Bìngfáng lǐ de shāngyuán yīn shāngkǒu jùtòng ér rěnbuzhù tòngkǔ de shēnyín.
呻吟.en: The wounded patient in the ward couldn't help but groan in agony because of severe pain from his wound.

摄取.zh: 保持健康需要均衡摄取蛋白质、维生素和矿物质。
摄取.py: Bǎochí jiànkāng xūyào jūnhéng shèqǔ dànbáizhì, wéishēngsù hé kuàngwùzhì.
摄取.en: Maintaining good health requires a balanced intake of protein, vitamins, and minerals.

势必.zh: 如果企业不积极进行技术创新，势必会在激烈的市场竞争中被淘汰。
势必.py: Rúguǒ qǐyè bù jījí jìnxíng jìshù chuàngxīn, shìbì huì zài jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng bèi táotài.
势必.en: If enterprises do not actively pursue technological innovation, they are bound to be eliminated in fierce market competition.

事迹.zh: 这位乡村教师扎根山区三十年的感人事迹在全国广为流传。
事迹.py: Zhè wèi xiāngcūn jiàoshī zhāgēn shānqū sānshí nián de gǎnrén shìjì zài quánguó guǎng wéi liúchuán.
事迹.en: The touching deeds of this rural teacher, who dedicated thirty years to the mountain area, were widely circulated throughout the country.

施加.zh: 家长不要给孩子施加过大的学习压力，应注重身心全面发展。
施加.py: Jiāzhǎng bú yào gěi háizi shījiā guò dà de xuéxí yālì, yīng zhùzhòng shēnxīn quánmiàn fāzhǎn.
施加.en: Parents should not exert too much academic pressure on their children, but should focus on their all-round physical and mental development.

世界观.zh: 青少年时期的阅读和经历，对一个人世界观的形成具有深远影响。
世界观.py: Qīngshàonián shíqī de yuèdú hé jīnglì, duì yí gè rén shìjièguān de xíngchéng jùyǒu shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng.
世界观.en: Reading and experiences during adolescence have a profound impact on the formation of a person's worldview.

逝世.zh: 这位德高望重的科学家于昨日在京逝世，享年九十岁。
逝世.py: Zhè wèi dégāowàngzhòng de kēxuéjiā yú zuórì zài Jīng shìshì, xiǎngnián jiǔshí suì.
逝世.en: The highly respected scientist passed away in Beijing yesterday at the age of ninety.

实事求是.zh: 我们在总结工作经验时，必须坚持实事求是的科学态度。
实事求是.py: Wǒmen zài zǒngjié gōngzuò jīngyàn shí, bìxū jiānchí shíshìqiúshì de kēxué tàidu.
实事求是.en: When summarizing work experience, we must adhere to a scientific attitude of seeking truth from facts.

事态.zh: 警方迅速赶到现场维持秩序，以防事态进一步扩大恶化。
事态.py: Jǐngfāng xùnsù gǎndào xiànchǎng wéichí zhìxù, yǐ fáng shìtài jìnyíbù kuòdà èhuà.
事态.en: The police rushed to the scene immediately to maintain order and prevent the situation from escalating and worsening further.

示意.zh: 主持人向台下的工作人员摆了摆手，示意活动可以准时开始。
示意.py: Zhǔchírén xiàng táixià de gōngzuò rényuán bǎi le bǎi shǒu, shìyì huódòng kěyǐ zhǔnshí kāishǐ.
示意.en: The host waved his hand to the staff offstage, signaling that the event could begin on time.

施展.zh: 公司为优秀的青年人才提供了广阔的平台，让他们尽情施展才华。
施展.py: Gōngsī wèi yōuxiù de qīngnián réncái tígōng le guǎngkuò de píngtái, ràng tāmen jìnqíng shīzhǎn cáihuá.
施展.en: The company provided a broad platform for outstanding young talents to fully display their abilities.

守护.zh: 边防战士长年驻守在高寒雪山上，默默守护着祖国的安全与安宁。
守护.py: Biānfáng zhànshì chángnián zhùshǒu zài gāohán xuěshān shang, mòmò shǒuhù zhe zǔguó de ānquán yǔ ānníng.
守护.en: Border defense soldiers have been stationed on frigid snowy mountains for years, silently guarding the safety and tranquility of the motherland.

手艺.zh: 爷爷做了一辈子的木匠，精湛的手艺深受乡亲们的称赞。
手艺.py: Yéye zuò le yíbèizi de mùjiang, jīngzhàn de shǒuyì shēnshòu xiāngqīnmen de chēngzàn.
手艺.en: Grandfather was a carpenter all his life, and his exquisite craftsmanship was deeply praised by the villagers.

授予.zh: 鉴于他在医学领域的杰出贡献，大学决定授予他名誉博士学位。
授予.py: Jiànyú tā zài yīxué lǐngyù de jiéchū gòngxiàn, dàxué juédìng shòuyǔ tā míngyù bóshì xuéwèi.
授予.en: In view of his outstanding contributions to the medical field, the university decided to confer an honorary doctorate on him.

受罪.zh: 夏天在没有空调的车间里工作，对工人们来说简直是受罪。
受罪.py: Xiàtiān zài méiyǒu kōngtiáo de chējiān lǐ gōngzuò, duì gōngrénmen lái shuō jiǎnzhí shì shòuzuì.
受罪.en: Working in a workshop without air conditioning in summer is sheer torture for the workers.

耍.zh: 遇到问题应该坦诚交流，而不是故意耍小聪明推卸责任。
耍.py: Yùdào wèntí yīnggāi tǎnchéng jiāoliú, ér bú shì gùyì shuǎ xiǎocōngming tuīxiè zérèn.
耍.en: When encountering problems, one should communicate frankly rather than intentionally playing petty tricks to shirk responsibility.

涮.zh: 冬天最惬意的事情，莫过于和三五好友一起围坐在桌旁涮羊肉。
涮.py: Dōngtiān zuì qièyì de shìqing, mò guòyú hé sān wǔ hǎoyǒu yìqǐ wéizuò zài zhuō páng shuàn yángròu.
涮.en: In winter, nothing is more delightful than sitting around a table with a few close friends enjoying instant-boiled mutton.

爽快.zh: 经理为人爽快，听完汇报后毫不犹豫地批准了采购方案。
爽快.py: Jīnglǐ wéirén shuǎngkuai, tīngwán huìbào hòu háobù yóuyù de pīzhǔn le cǎigòu fāng'àn.
爽快.en: The manager is straightforward and approved the procurement plan without hesitation after hearing the report.

束缚.zh: 青年人要敢于打破传统观念的束缚，积极探索新路径。
束缚.py: Qīngniánrén yào gǎnyú dǎpò chuántǒng guānniàn de shùfù, jījí tànsuǒ xīn lùjìng.
束缚.en: Young people should have the courage to break free from the shackles of traditional concepts and actively explore new paths.

水利.zh: 兴修水利工程对防止水旱灾害和促进农业稳产具有重要意义。
水利.py: Xīngxiū shuǐlì gōngchéng duì fángzhǐ shuǐhàn zāihài hé cùjìn nóngyè wěnchǎn jùyǒu zhòngyào yìyì.
水利.en: The construction of water conservancy projects is of great significance for preventing floods and droughts and promoting stable agricultural production.

司令.zh: 司令在作战指挥室里冷静地下达了最后的战略部署指令。
司令.py: Sīlìng zài zuòzhàn zhǐhuìshì lǐ lěngjìng de xiàdále zuìhòu de zhànlüè bùshǔ zhǐlìng.
司令.en: In the combat command room, the commander calmly issued the final orders for strategic deployment.

思索.zh: 面对这一错综复杂的哲学难题，学者陷入了长时间的深沉思索。
思索.py: Miànduì zhè yī cuòzōng fùzá de zhéxué nántí, xuézhě xiànrùle cháng shíjiān de shēnchén sīsuǒ.
思索.en: Facing this intricate philosophical dilemma, the scholar fell into prolonged and deep contemplation.

斯文.zh: 他虽然戴着一副黑框眼镜看起来文质彬彬很斯文，但办起事来却雷厉风行。
斯文.py: Tā suīrán dàizhe yí fù hēikuàng yǎnjìng kàn qǐlái wénzhìbīnbīn hěn sīwen, dàn bàn qǐ shì lái què léilìfēngxíng.
斯文.en: Although he looks refined and scholarly wearing black-rimmed glasses, he is resolute and vigorous in handling affairs.

肆无忌惮.zh: 不法分子肆无忌惮地伪造假冒伪劣商品，严重扰乱了正常的市场秩序。
肆无忌惮.py: Bùfǎ fènzǐ sìwújìdàn de wěizào jiǎmào wěiliè shāngpǐn, yánzhòng rǎoluànle zhèngcháng de shìchǎng zhìxù.
肆无忌惮.en: Lawbreakers unscrupulously fabricated counterfeit and substandard goods, severely disrupting the normal market order.

思绪.zh: 窗外淅淅沥沥的雨声打断了他的思绪，让他无法集中精力继续写作。
思绪.py: Chuāngwài xīxīlìlì de yǔshēng dǎduànle tā de sīxù, ràng tā wúfǎ jízhōng jīnglì jìxù xiězuò.
思绪.en: The patter of rain outside the window disrupted his train of thought, leaving him unable to concentrate on continuing to write.

饲养.zh: 农场主在生态农业示范区内科学饲养了数百头良种肉牛。
饲养.py: Nóngchǎngzhǔ zài shēngtài nóngyè shìfànqū nèi kēxué sìyǎngle shù bǎi tóu liángzhǒng ròuniú.
饲养.en: The farm owner scientifically raised hundreds of fine-breed beef cattle in the ecological agriculture demonstration zone.

四肢.zh: 经过长时间的高强度登山运动后，他感到四肢酸痛、疲惫不堪。
四肢.py: Jīngguò cháng shíjiān de gāo qiángdù dēngshān yùndòng hòu, tā gǎndào sìzhī suāntòng, píbèi bùkān.
四肢.en: After prolonged high-intensity mountain climbing, he felt his limbs aching and was thoroughly exhausted.

私自.zh: 未经公司管理层书面许可，任何人不得私自将内部机密文件带离办公场所。
私自.py: Wèijīng gōngsī guǎnlǐcéng shūmiàn xǔkě, rènhé rén bùdé sīzì jiāng nèibù jīmì wénjiàn dàilí bàngōng chǎngsuǒ.
私自.en: Without the written permission of the company's management, no one may take confidential internal documents away from the office without authorization.

耸.zh: 听到这个不可思议的消息，他无奈地耸了耸肩，表示自己也无能为力。
耸.py: Tīngdào zhège bùkěsīyì de xiāoxi, tā wúnài de sǒngle sǒng jiān, biǎoshì zìjǐ yě wúnéngwéilì.
耸.en: Hearing this unbelievable news, he shrugged helplessly, indicating that he was powerless to do anything about it.

随即.zh: 总裁发表完简短的致辞后，新闻发布会随即进入了媒体提问环节。
随即.py: Zǒngcái fābiǎo wán jiǎnduǎn de zhìcí hòu, xīnwén fābùhuì suíjí jìnrùle méitǐ tíwèn huánjié.
随即.en: After the president delivered brief remarks, the press conference immediately proceeded to the media Q&A session.

索赔.zh: 遭遇航班延误并导致行李受损后，旅客依据相关国际公约向航空公司提出了索赔。
索赔.py: Zāoyù hángbān yánwù bìng dǎozhì xíngli shòusǔn hòu, lǚkè yījù xiāngguān guójì gōngyuē xiàng hángkōng gōngsī tíchūle suǒpéi.
索赔.en: After suffering a flight delay that resulted in damaged luggage, the passenger filed a claim for damages against the airline according to relevant international conventions.

索性.zh: 既然雨越下越大且一时半会儿停不下来，我们索性取消了原定的户外野餐计划。
索性.py: Jìrán yǔ yuè xià yuè dà qiě yīshí bànhuǐr tíng bù xiàlái, wǒmen suǒxìng qǔxiāole yuándìng de hùwài yěcān jìhuà.
索性.en: Since the rain was getting heavier and wouldn't stop anytime soon, we simply cancelled our planned outdoor picnic.

诉讼.zh: 双方未能通过友好协商解决知识产权侵权争议，最终走上了法律诉讼的道路。
诉讼.py: Shuāngfāng wèinéng tōngguò yǒuhǎo xiéshāng jiějué zhīshi chǎnquán qīnquán zhēngyì, zuìzhōng zǒushàngle fǎlǜ sùsòng de dàolù.
诉讼.en: Failing to resolve the intellectual property infringement dispute through amicable negotiation, both parties ultimately took the path of legal litigation.

苏醒.zh: 经过重症监护室医护人员连续数日的全力救治，昏迷的伤员终于苏醒了过来。
苏醒.py: Jīngguò zhòngzhèng jiānhùshì yīhù rényuán liánxù shù rì de quánlì jiùzhì, hūnmí de shāngyuán zhōngyú sūxǐngle guòlái.
苏醒.en: After several days of all-out rescue efforts by ICU medical staff, the comatose patient finally regained consciousness.

塌.zh: 暴雨连续下了三天，导致村口那座年久失修的老房屋顶彻底塌了。
塌.py: Bàoyǔ liánxù xiàle sān tiān, dǎozhì cūnkǒu nà zuò niánjiǔshīxiū de lǎofáng wūdǐng chèdǐ tā le.
塌.en: Three days of continuous torrential rain caused the roof of the dilapidated old house at the village entrance to completely collapse.

泰斗.zh: 这位在心血管医学领域享有盛誉的老教授，被公认为该学科的泰斗。
泰斗.py: Zhè wèi zài xīnxuèguǎn yīxué lǐngyù xiǎngyǒu shèngyù de lǎo jiàoshòu, bèi gōngrèn wéi gāi xuékē de tàidǒu.
泰斗.en: This venerable professor, who enjoys great renown in cardiovascular medicine, is widely recognized as a doyen of the discipline.

糖葫芦.zh: 冬天街头常常能看到小贩推着车售卖红彤彤、酸甜可口的糖葫芦。
糖葫芦.py: Dōngtiān jiētóu chángcháng néng kàndào xiǎofàn tuīzhe chē shòumài hóngtóngtóng, suāntián kěkǒu de tánghúlu.
糖葫芦.en: In winter, one can often see street vendors pushing carts selling bright red, sweet and sour tanghulu.

倘若.zh: 倘若没有导师悉心的指点与同伴的支持，他很难在短时间内完成这项科研任务。
倘若.py: Tǎngruò méiyǒu dǎoshī xīxīn de zhǐdiǎn yǔ tóngbàn de zhīchí, tā hěn nán zài duǎn shíjiān nèi wánchéng zhè xiàng kēyán rènwu.
倘若.en: If it were not for his supervisor's meticulous guidance and his peers' support, he would have found it difficult to complete this research project in such a short time.

摊儿.zh: 每天清晨，胡同口那个卖热腾腾包子豆浆的早点摊儿前总会排起长队。
摊儿.py: Měitiān qīngchén, hútòng kǒu nàge mài rèténgténg bāozi dòujiāng de zǎodiǎn tānr qián zǒng huì pái qǐ chángduì.
摊儿.en: Every morning, a long queue always forms in front of the breakfast stall at the alley entrance selling piping hot steamed buns and soybean milk.

贪污.zh: 这名官员因贪污大笔公共建设资金，最终受到了法律的严厉制裁。
贪污.py: Zhè míng guānyuán yīn tānwū dà bǐ gōnggòng jiànshè zījīn, zuìzhōng shòudàole fǎlǜ de yánlì zhìcái.
贪污.en: This official was severely punished by law for embezzling a large sum of public construction funds.

滔滔不绝.zh: 一提起自己钟爱的航天探索项目，工程师便神采飞扬、滔滔不绝地介绍起来。
滔滔不绝.py: Yì tíqǐ zìjǐ zhōng'ài de hángtiān tànsuǒ xiàngmù, gōngchéngshī biàn shéncǎi fēiyáng, tāotāo bù jué de jièshào qǐlái.
滔滔不绝.en: As soon as his beloved space exploration project was mentioned, the engineer became radiant and spoke about it nonstop.

舔.zh: 小猫温顺地蜷缩在主人的膝盖上，动作轻柔地舔着自己的前爪。
舔.py: Xiǎomāo wēnshùn de quánsuō zài zhǔrén de xīgài shang, dòngzuò qīngróu de tiǎnzhe zìjǐ de qiánzhuǎ.
舔.en: The kitten curled up dociley on its owner's lap, gently licking its front paws.

天伦之乐.zh: 退休以后，爷爷最喜欢在周末和儿孙们团聚一堂，尽情享受天伦之乐。
天伦之乐.py: Tuìxiū yǐhòu, yéye zuì xǐhuan zài zhōumò hé érsūnmen tuánjù yītáng, jìnqíng xiǎngshòu tiānlúnzhīlè.
天伦之乐.en: After retiring, grandfather loves gathering with his children and grandchildren on weekends to fully enjoy the bliss of family life.

天生.zh: 她似乎天生就具有极强的舞台表现力和敏锐的音乐感知能力。
天生.py: Tā sìhū tiānshēng jiù jùyǒu jí qiáng de wǔtái biǎoxiànlì hé mǐnruì de yīnyuè gǎnzhī nénglì.
天生.en: She seems naturally endowed with powerful stage presence and a keen musical sensibility.

挑拨.zh: 我们要保持清醒的判断，绝不能被别有用心之人挑拨同事之间的良好关系。
挑拨.py: Wǒmen yào bǎochí qīngxǐng de pànduàn, jué bùnéng bèi biéyǒuyòngxīn zhī rén tiǎobō tóngshì zhījiān de liánghǎo guānxì.
挑拨.en: We must maintain clear judgment and never let people with ulterior motives drive a wedge into the good relations between colleagues.

调剂.zh: 在紧张忙碌的日常工作之余听听轻音乐，能很好地调剂单调的生活节奏。
调剂.py: Zài jǐnzhāng mánglù de rìcháng gōngzuò zhīyú tīngting qīngyīnyuè, néng hěn hǎo de tiáojì dāndiào de shēnghuó jiézòu.
调剂.en: Listening to light music outside of intense and busy daily work can nicely regulate the monotonous rhythm of life.

条款.zh: 在正式签署商业合作协议之前，法务顾问逐一仔细审查了每一项合同条款。
条款.py: Zài zhèngshì qiānshǔ shāngyè hézuò xiéyì zhīqián, fǎwù gùwèn zhúyī zǐxì shěnchále měi yī xiàng hétóng tiáokuǎn.
条款.en: Prior to formally signing the business cooperation agreement, the legal counsel examined each contract clause one by one with care.

条理.zh: 他的工作汇报结构严谨、条理清晰，获得了在场所有评委的高度赞赏。
条理.py: Tā de gōngzuò huìbào jiégòu yánjǐn, tiáolǐ qīngxī, huòdéle zàichǎng suǒyǒu píngwěi de gāodù zànshǎng.
条理.en: His work report was rigorous in structure and clear in organization, winning high praise from all the judges present.

调料.zh: 大厨选用多种天然香料调制秘制调料，使这道特色菜肴风味独特浓郁。
调料.py: Dàchú xuǎnyòng duō zhǒng tiānrán xiāngliào tiáozhì mìzhì tiáoliào, shǐ zhè dào tèsè càiyáo fēngwèi dútè nóngyù.
调料.en: The chef selected various natural spices to prepare a secret seasoning, giving this specialty dish a unique and rich flavor.

跳跃.zh: 这名年轻运动员凭借出色的跳跃能力，在跳远决赛中一举打破了赛会纪录。
跳跃.py: Zhè míng niánqīng yùndòngyuán píngjiè chūsè de tiàoyuè nénglì, zài tiàoyuǎn juésài zhōng yījǔ dǎpòle sàihuì jìlù.
跳跃.en: Relying on his outstanding jumping ability, this young athlete broke the tournament record in the long jump final.

提拔.zh: 凭借扎实的专业技能和卓越的团队管理业绩，他入职不到三年便被提拔为部门总监。
提拔.py: Píngjiè zhāshi de zhuānyè jìnéng hé zhuóyuè de tuánduì guǎnlǐ yèjì, tā rùzhí bù dào sān nián biàn bèi tíbá wéi bùmén zǒngjiān.
提拔.en: Thanks to his solid professional skills and outstanding team management achievements, he was promoted to department director less than three years after joining.

提炼.zh: 科研人员成功从这种药用植物中提炼出了具有显著抗菌效果的高纯度有效成分。
提炼.py: Kēyán rényuán chénggōng cóng zhè zhǒng yàoyòng zhíwù zhōng tíliànchūle jùyǒu xiǎnzhù kàngjūn xiàoguǒ de gāo chúndù yǒuxiào chéngfèn.
提炼.en: Researchers successfully extracted highly pure active ingredients with significant antibacterial effects from this medicinal plant.

体谅.zh: 作为团队领导者，应当多体谅基层员工在执行紧急项目时所承受的心理压力。
体谅.py: Zuòwéi tuánduì lǐngdǎozhě, yīngdāng duō tǐliàng jīcéng yuángōng zài zhíxíng jǐnjí xiàngmù shí suǒ chéngshòu de xīnlǐ yālì.
体谅.en: As a team leader, one should show greater understanding for the psychological pressure endured by grassroots employees while carrying out urgent projects.

体面.zh: 出席隆重的涉外商务宴请时，得体体面的着装体现了对东道主的礼貌与尊重。
体面.py: Chūxí lóngzhòng de shèwài shāngyè yànqǐng shí, détǐ tǐmiàn de zhuózhuāng tǐxiànle duì dōngdàozhǔ de lǐmào yǔ zūnzhòng.
体面.en: When attending a formal foreign-related business banquet, proper and presentable attire reflects courtesy and respect toward the host.

挺拔.zh: 宽阔的道路两旁矗立着一排排挺拔的白杨树，宛如坚毅的卫士守护着城市。
挺拔.py: Kuānkuò de dàolù liǎngpáng chùlìzhe yì pái pái tǐngbá de báiyángshù, wǎnrú jiānyì de wèishì shǒuhùzhe chéngshì.
挺拔.en: Rows of tall, straight poplars stand on both sides of the wide road, like resolute sentinels guarding the city.

停泊.zh: 暴风雨来临之前，数十艘远洋货轮已平稳停泊在避风港湾内等待天气好转。
停泊.py: Bàofēngyǔ láilín zhīqián, shù shí sōu yuǎnyáng huòlún yǐ píngwěn tíngbó zài bìfēng gǎngwān nèi děngdài tiānqì hǎozhuǎn.
停泊.en: Before the storm arrived, dozens of ocean-going cargo ships had anchored steadily in the sheltered harbor, waiting for the weather to improve.

停滞.zh: 由于关键核心零部件供应中断，该智能终端生产线的组装工作陷入了停滞。
停滞.py: Yóuyú guānjiàn héxīn língbùjiàn gōngyìng zhōngduàn, gāi zhìnéng zhōngduān shēngchǎnxiàn de zǔzhuāng gōngzuò xiànrùle tíngzhì.
停滞.en: Due to the disruption in the supply of critical core components, assembly work on the smart terminal production line came to a standstill.

亭子.zh: 公园湖心小岛上建有一座古色古香的木结构亭子，供游客歇息赏景。
亭子.py: Gōngyuán húxīn xiǎodǎo shang jiànyǒu yí zuò gǔsègǔxiāng de mù jiégòu tíngzi, gōng yóukè xiēxi shǎngjǐng.
亭子.en: An antique wooden pavilion was built on the islet in the center of the park lake for visitors to rest and enjoy the scenery.

同胞.zh: 地震发生后，海内外同胞心系灾区，纷纷慷慨解囊捐款捐物。
同胞.py: Dìzhèn fāshēng hòu, hǎinèiwài tóngbāo xīnxì zāiqū, fēnfēn kāngkǎi jiěnáng juānkuǎn juānwù.
同胞.en: After the earthquake occurred, compatriots both at home and abroad had the disaster area close to their hearts, generously donating funds and relief supplies.

统筹兼顾.zh: 制定区域经济发展规划时，必须统筹兼顾经济增长与生态环境保护的双重目标。
统筹兼顾.py: Zhìdìng qūyù jīngjì fāzhǎn guīhuà shí, bìxū tǒngchóujiāngù jīngjì zēngzhǎng yǔ shēngtài huánjìng bǎohù de shuāngchóng mùbiāo.
统筹兼顾.en: When formulating regional economic development plans, one must take into account both economic growth and ecological environmental protection through overall planning.

通货.zh: 中央银行采取严格的货币调控政策，以稳定通货价值并防范金融市场剧烈波动。
通货.py: Zhōngyāng yínháng cǎiqǔ yángé de huòbì tiáokòng zhèngcè, yǐ wěndìng tōnghuò jiàzhí bìng fángfàn jīnróng shìchǎng jùliè bōdòng.
通货.en: The central bank adopted strict monetary regulation policies to stabilize the value of currency and guard against drastic fluctuations in financial markets.

铜矿.zh: 地质勘探队在西部山区新发现了一处储量极为丰富的露天大型铜矿。
铜矿.py: Dìzhì kāntànduì zài xībù shānqū xīn fāxiànle yí chù chǔliàng jíwéi fēngfù de lùtiān dàxíng tóngkuàng.
铜矿.en: The geological exploration team discovered a large open-pit copper mine with extremely rich reserves in the western mountainous area.

通俗.zh: 这位天文学家善于用通俗易懂的生动语言向大众普及深奥的宇宙物理知识。
通俗.py: Zhè wèi tiānwénxuéjiā shànyú yòng tōngsú yìdǒng de shēngdòng yǔyán xiàng dàzhòng pǔjì shēn'ào de yǔzhòu wùlǐ zhīshi.
通俗.en: This astronomer is adept at using popular and accessible language to explain profound cosmic physics knowledge to the general public.

统统.zh: 图书馆即将闭馆进行全面检修，管理人员要求读者将借阅书籍统统归还。
统统.py: Túshūguǎn jíjiāng bìguǎn jìnxíng quánmiàn jiǎnxiū, guǎnlǐ rényuán yāoqiú dúzhě jiāng jièyuè shūjí tǒngtǒng guīhuán.
统统.en: As the library was about to close for thorough maintenance, the administrators required readers to return all borrowed books completely.

投机.zh: 监管部门严厉打击利用内幕消息进行非法投机的金融违规操作行为。
投机.py: Jiānguǎn bùmén yánlì dǎjī lìyòng nèimù xiāoxi jìnxíng fēifǎ tóujī de jīnróng wéiguī cāozuò xíngwéi.
投机.en: Regulatory authorities are cracking down on financial misconduct involving illegal speculation using insider information.

投掷.zh: 在田径比赛中，参赛选手拼尽全力将手中的标枪投掷向远处的标线区域。
投掷.py: Zài tiánjìng bǐsài zhōng, cānsài xuǎnshǒu pīnjìn quánlì jiāng shǒuzhōng de biāoqiāng tóuzhì xiàng yuǎnchù de biāoxiàn qūyù.
投掷.en: In the track and field competition, the athlete put all his strength into hurling the javelin toward the marked area in the distance.

秃.zh: 他年纪轻轻就因为工作压力过大而大面积脱发，头顶已经有些秃了。
秃.py: Tā niánjì qīngqīng jiù yīnwèi gōngzuò yālì guò dà ér dàmiànjī tuōfà, tóudǐng yǐjīng yǒuxiē tū le.
秃.en: At a young age, he suffered severe hair loss due to excessive work stress, and the top of his head was already somewhat bald.

推理.zh: 这部悬疑小说凭借严密精妙的逻辑推理过程，吸引了无数狂热的读者。
推理.py: Zhè bù xuányí xiǎoshuō píngjiè yánmì jīngmiào de luóji tuīlǐ guòchéng, xīyǐnle wúshù kuángrè de dúzhě.
推理.en: With its rigorous and ingenious process of logical reasoning, this mystery novel has attracted countless avid readers.

推论.zh: 科学家指出，仅仅依靠当前的局部实验数据，尚不足以得出具有普遍意义的科学推论。
推论.py: Kēxuéjiā zhǐchū, jǐnjǐn yīkào dāngqián de júbù shíyàn shùjù, shàng bù zúyǐ déchū jùyǒu pǔbiàn yìyì de kēxué tuīlùn.
推论.en: Scientists pointed out that relying solely on current partial experimental data is not yet sufficient to draw a scientific inference of universal significance.

涂抹.zh: 出门前，她在脸上涂抹了一层防晒霜。
涂抹.py: Chūmén qián, tā zài liǎn shang túmǒ le yì céng fángshàishuāng.
涂抹.en: Before going out, she applied a layer of sunscreen to her face.

唾沫.zh: 他讲得眉飞色舞，嘴角甚至溅出了唾沫。
唾沫.py: Tā jiǎng de méifēisèwǔ, zuǐjiǎo shènzhì jiàn chū le tuòmo.
唾沫.en: He spoke with great animation, saliva even spraying from the corners of his mouth.

妥善.zh: 经过各方协调，这场纠纷终于得到了妥善解决。
妥善.py: Jīngguò gè fāng xiétiáo, zhè chǎng jiūfēn zhōngyú dédào le tuǒshàn jiějué.
妥善.en: Through coordination among all parties, this dispute was finally properly resolved.

歪曲.zh: 媒体不能为了吸引眼球而故意歪曲事实真相。
歪曲.py: Méitǐ bù néng wèile xīyǐn yǎnqiú ér gùyì wāiqū shìshí zhēnxiàng.
歪曲.en: The media must not deliberately distort the truth just to attract attention.

外向.zh: 他的性格开朗外向，非常善于与陌生人沟通。
外向.py: Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng wàixiàng, fēicháng shànyú yǔ mòshēngrén gōutōng.
外向.en: His personality is outgoing and extroverted, and he is very good at communicating with strangers.

瓦解.zh: 内部矛盾的加剧最终导致了这个商业联盟的瓦解。
瓦解.py: Nèibù máodùn de jiājù zuìzhōng dǎozhì le zhè ge shāngyè liánméng de wǎjiě.
瓦解.en: The intensification of internal contradictions eventually led to the collapse of this business alliance.

挖掘.zh: 这门课程旨在挖掘学生在艺术创作方面的潜能。
挖掘.py: Zhè mén kèchéng zhǐ zài wājué xuésheng zài yìshù chuàngzuò fāngmiàn de qiánnéng.
挖掘.en: This course aims to tap into students' potential in artistic creation.

丸.zh: 医生建议他每天饭后服用两丸中成药。
丸.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān fànhòu fúyòng liǎng wán zhōngchéngyào.
丸.en: The doctor advised him to take two Chinese herbal pills after meals every day.

完备.zh: 该实验室配备了完备的科研设施和安全保护系统。
完备.py: Gāi shíyànshì pèibèi le wánbèi de kēyán shèshī hé ānquán bǎohù xìtǒng.
完备.en: The laboratory is equipped with complete scientific research facilities and safety protection systems.

完毕.zh: 会议准备工作已经就绪，所有材料打印完毕。
完毕.py: Huìyì zhǔnbèi gōngzuò yǐjīng jiùxù, suǒyǒu cáiliào dǎyìn wánbì.
完毕.en: Preparations for the meeting are ready, and all materials have finished printing.

往事.zh: 重游故地，那些尘封的往事又浮现在他的脑海中。
往事.py: Chóngyóu gùdì, nàxiē chénfēng de wǎngshì yòu fúxiàn zài tā de nǎohǎi zhōng.
往事.en: Revisiting old places, those dust-covered memories of the past surfaced in his mind once again.

挽回.zh: 管理层采取了紧急措施，试图挽回客户对品牌的信任。
挽回.py: Guǎnlǐcéng cǎiqǔ le jǐnjí cuòshī, shìtú wǎnhuí kèhù duì pǐnpái de xìnrèn.
挽回.en: Management took emergency measures in an attempt to regain customers' trust in the brand.

挽救.zh: 医护人员全力以赴抢救，终于挽救了重伤患者的生命。
挽救.py: Yīhù rényuán quánlì yǐ fù qiǎngjiù, zhōngyú wǎnjiù le zhòngshāng huànzhě de shēngmìng.
挽救.en: Medical personnel spared no effort in emergency treatment and finally saved the critically injured patient's life.

惋惜.zh: 这位天才青年画家英年早逝，令人深感惋惜。
惋惜.py: Zhè wèi tiāncái qīngnián huàjiā yīngnián zǎoshì, lìng rén shēn gǎn wǎnxī.
惋惜.en: The premature death of this talented young painter is deeply regretted by all.

威风.zh: 仪仗队迈着整齐的步伐走过广场，显得威风凛凛。
威风.py: Yízhàngduì màizhe zhěngqí de bùfá zǒu guò guǎngchǎng, xiǎnde wēifēng lǐnlǐn.
威风.en: The honor guard marched across the square with uniform steps, looking truly imposing.

微观.zh: 经济学家既要从宏观把握趋势，也要从微观分析市场主体。
微观.py: Jīngjì xuéjiā jì yào cóng hóngguān bǎwò qūshì, yě yào cóng wēiguān fēnxī shìchǎng zhǔtǐ.
微观.en: Economists must grasp trends from a macro level while also analyzing market entities from a micro level.

威力.zh: 这场强台风展现了惊人的威力，摧毁了沿海的多处建筑。
威力.py: Zhè chǎng qiáng táifēng zhǎnxiàn le jīngrén de wēilì, cuīhuǐ le yánhǎi de duō chù jiànzhù.
威力.en: This powerful typhoon unleashed astonishing power, destroying multiple buildings along the coast.

未免.zh: 只凭一次考试成绩就否定他的能力，未免太武断了。
未免.py: Zhǐ píng yí cì kǎoshì chéngjì jiù fǒudìng tā de nénglì, wèimiǎn tài wǔduàn le.
未免.en: Denying his abilities based on just one test score is really a bit too arbitrary.

为首.zh: 以张教授为首的专家团队历时三年完成了这项科研课题。
为首.py: Yǐ Zhāng jiàoshòu wéi shǒu de zhuānjiā tuánduì lìshí sān nián wánchéng le zhè xiàng kēyán kètí.
为首.en: The expert team headed by Professor Zhang took three years to complete this scientific research project.

问世.zh: 第一台智能手机问世后，彻底改变了人们的生活方式。
问世.py: Dì-yī tái zhìnéng shǒujī wènshì hòu, chèdǐ gǎibiàn le rénmen de shēnghuó fāngshì.
问世.en: After the first smartphone was introduced to the world, it completely transformed people's way of life.

文雅.zh: 他的举止大方文雅，言谈间展现出良好的修养。
文雅.py: Tā de jǔzhǐ dàfāng wényǎ, yántán jiān zhǎnxiàn chū liánghǎo de xiūyǎng.
文雅.en: His demeanor is poised and elegant, and his speech reveals great cultivation.

窝.zh: 两只燕子正在屋檐下忙着筑窝。
窝.py: Liǎng zhī yànzi zhèngzài wūyán xià mángzhe zhù wō.
窝.en: Two swallows are busy building a nest under the eaves.

勿.zh: 博物馆展厅内立着“请勿拍照”的提示牌。
勿.py: Bówùguǎn zhǎntīng nèi lìzhe "qǐng wù pāizhào" de tíshìpái.
勿.en: Inside the museum exhibition hall stood a sign reading "Please do not take photographs."

无比.zh: 看到女儿登上领奖台，父母内心感到无比自豪。
无比.py: Kàndào nǚ'ér dēng shàng lǐngjiǎngtái, fùmǔ nèixīn gǎndào wúbǐ zìháo.
无比.en: Seeing their daughter take the podium, the parents felt incomparably proud in their hearts.

误差.zh: 精密的测量仪器可以把实验误差控制在极小的范围内。
误差.py: Jīngmì de cèliáng yíqì kěyǐ bǎ shíyàn wùchā kòngzhì zài jí xiǎo de fànwéi nèi.
误差.en: Precision measuring instruments can keep experimental errors within an extremely small range.

无偿.zh: 这些热心的律师定期为低收入群体提供无偿法律咨询。
无偿.py: Zhèxiē rèxīn de lǜshī dìngqī wèi dī shōurù qúntǐ tígōng wúcháng fǎlǜ zīxún.
无偿.en: These dedicated lawyers regularly provide free legal consultations to low-income groups.

无动于衷.zh: 面对灾区人民的困境，任何有良知的人都不会无动于衷。
无动于衷.py: Miànduì zāiqū rénmín de kùnjìng, rènhé yǒu liángzhī de rén dōu bú huì wúdòngyúzhōng.
无动于衷.en: In the face of the plight of people in disaster areas, no conscientious person would remain indifferent.

乌黑.zh: 那个小姑娘留着一头乌黑柔顺的长发。
乌黑.py: Nà ge xiǎo gūniang liúzhe yì tóu wūhēi róushùn de chángfà.
乌黑.en: That little girl has a head of jet-black, silky long hair.

无精打采.zh: 他因为昨晚熬夜赶工，今天整个人都无精打采的。
无精打采.py: Tā yīnwèi zuówǎn áoyè gǎngōng, jīntiān zhěng ge rén dōu wújīngdǎcǎi de.
无精打采.en: Because he stayed up late last night rushing work, he looked completely listless today.

无可奈何.zh: 航班因雷暴天气被迫取消，旅客们只好无可奈何地接受改签。
无可奈何.py: Hángbān yīn léibào tiānqì bèipò qǔxiāo, lǚkèmen zhǐhǎo wúkěnàihé de jiēshòu gǎiqiān.
无可奈何.en: With the flight forced to cancel due to thunderstorms, travelers had no choice but to helplessly accept rebooking.

无理取闹.zh: 这件事情分明是你自己的疏忽，请不要继续无理取闹了。
无理取闹.py: Zhè jiàn shìqing fēnmíng shì nǐ zìjǐ de shūhu, qǐng bú yào jìxù wúlǐqǔnào le.
无理取闹.en: This matter was clearly your own oversight; please stop making an unreasonable scene.

污蔑.zh: 他坚决拿起法律武器，反击对手对他人格的恶意污蔑。
污蔑.py: Tā jiānjué ná qǐ fǎlǜ wǔqì, fǎnjī duìshǒu duì tā réngé de è'yì wūmiè.
污蔑.en: He resolutely turned to legal means to fight back against his opponent's malicious slander of his character.

武侠.zh: 他从小就痴迷于金庸笔下的武侠世界。
武侠.py: Tā cóngxiǎo jiù chīmí yú Jīn Yōng bǐ xià de wǔxiá shìjiè.
武侠.en: Since childhood, he has been fascinated by the martial arts world depicted by Jin Yong.

诬陷.zh: 调查结果证明他是无辜的，之前所有的指控纯属诬陷。
诬陷.py: Diàochá jiéguǒ zhèngmíng tā shì wúgū de, zhīqián suǒyǒu de zhǐkòng chúnshǔ wūxiàn.
诬陷.en: The investigation results proved him innocent; all previous accusations were pure fabrications designed to frame him.

溪.zh: 一条清澈的小溪在山谷间缓缓流淌，水底的鹅卵石清晰可见。
溪.py: Yì tiáo qīngchè de xiǎoxī zài shāngǔ jiān huǎnhuǎn liútǎng, shuǐdǐ de éluǎnshí qīngxī kějiàn.
溪.en: A clear creek flowed gently through the valley, with pebbles on the bed clearly visible.

霞.zh: 傍晚时分，绚丽的晚霞染红了半边天空。
霞.py: Bàngwǎn shífēn, xuànlì de wǎnxiá rǎn hóng le bànbiān tiānkōng.
霞.en: At dusk, gorgeous sunset clouds dyed half the sky red.

狭隘.zh: 我们应该开阔视野，避免用狭隘的眼光看待不同文化。
狭隘.py: Wǒmen yīnggāi kāikuò shìyě, bìmiǎn yòng xiá'ài de yǎnguāng kàndài bùtóng wénhuà.
狭隘.en: We should broaden our horizons and avoid viewing different cultures through a narrow lens.

峡谷.zh: 奔腾的江水在两座陡峭的山峰之间冲刷出一条幽深的峡谷。
峡谷.py: Bēnténg de jiāngshuǐ zài liǎng zuò dǒuqiào de shānfēng zhījiān chōngshuā chū yì tiáo yōushēn de xiágǔ.
峡谷.en: The surging river carved a deep canyon between two steep peaks.

弦.zh: 他在演奏前仔细调节了小提琴的每一根弦。
弦.py: Tā zài yǎnzòu qián zǐxì tiáojié le xiǎotíqín de měi yì gēn xián.
弦.en: Before performing, he carefully tuned every string of the violin.

现成.zh: 解决复杂问题不能总依赖现成的模板，需要开拓创新。
现成.py: Jiějué fùzá wèntí bù néng zǒng yīlài xiànchéng de múbǎn, xūyào kāituò chuàngxīn.
现成.en: Solving complex problems cannot always rely on ready-made templates; it requires pioneering innovation.

巷.zh: 穿过这条古朴的小巷，便能看见一片开阔的湖泊。
巷.py: Chuānguò zhè tiáo gǔpǔ de xiǎoxiàng, biàn néng kànjiàn yí piàn kāikuò de húpō.
巷.en: Passing through this quaint lane, one can see an expansive lake.

相辅相成.zh: 理论学习与实践操作相辅相成，二者缺一不可。
相辅相成.py: Lǐlùn xuéxí yǔ shíjiàn cāozuò xiāngfǔ-xiāngchéng, èrzhě quē yī bù kě.
相辅相成.en: Theoretical study and practical operation complement each other; neither can be dispensed with.

镶嵌.zh: 这枚精致的戒指上镶嵌着一颗璀璨的蓝宝石。
镶嵌.py: Zhè méi jīngzhì de jièzhi shang xiāngqiànzhe yì kē cuǐcàn de lánbǎoshí.
镶嵌.en: This exquisite ring is inlaid with a dazzling sapphire.

响应.zh: 广大市民积极响应政府倡导，纷纷加入到植树造林的活动中。
响应.py: Guǎngdà shìmín jījí xiǎngyìng zhèngfǔ chàngdào, fēnfēn jiārù dào zhíshù zàolín de huódòng zhōng.
响应.en: The general public responded actively to the government's call and joined the tree-planting campaign in droves.

乡镇.zh: 近年来，国家加大了对偏远乡镇基础设施建设的投入力度。
乡镇.py: Jìnnián lái, guójiā jiādà le duì piānyuǎn xiāngzhèn jīchǔ shèshī jiànshè de tóurù lìdù.
乡镇.en: In recent years, the state has increased investment in the infrastructure construction of remote townships.

陷害.zh: 他因为遭人暗中陷害，蒙受了巨大的不白之冤。
陷害.py: Tā yīnwèi zāo rén ànzhōng xiànhài, méngshòu le jùdà de bùbáizhīyuān.
陷害.en: Because someone framed him behind the scenes, he suffered a tremendous injustice.

贤惠.zh: 她不仅工作能力出众，在家庭生活中也十分温柔贤惠。
贤惠.py: Tā bùjǐn gōngzuò nénglì chūzhòng, zài jiātíng shēnghuó zhōng yě shífēn wēnróu xiánhuì.
贤惠.en: Not only is she outstanding at work, but she is also very gentle and virtuous in family life.

衔接.zh: 课程改革应注重小学与初中知识阶段的紧密衔接。
衔接.py: Kèchéng gǎigé yīng zhùzhòng xiǎoxué yǔ chūzhōng zhīshi jiēduàn de jǐnmì xiánjiē.
衔接.en: Curriculum reform should emphasize the tight transition of knowledge stages between primary and junior high school.

馅儿.zh: 这种水饺的馅儿是用新鲜的猪肉和大葱调配而成的。
馅儿.py: Zhè zhǒng shuǐjiǎo de xiànr shì yòng xīnxiān de zhūròu hé dàcōng tiáopèi ér chéng de.
馅儿.en: The filling of these dumplings is prepared with fresh pork and scallions.

嫌疑.zh: 警方经过严密排查，最终排除了那位保安的作案嫌疑。
嫌疑.py: Jǐngfāng jīngguò yánmì páichá, zuìzhōng páichú le nà wèi bǎo'ān de zuò'àn xiányí.
嫌疑.en: After thorough screening, the police ultimately ruled out that security guard's suspicion of committing the crime.

销毁.zh: 涉密文件在处理完毕后必须按规定集中销毁。
销毁.py: Shèmì wénjiàn zài chǔlǐ wánbì hòu bìxū àn guīdìng jízhōng xiāohuǐ.
销毁.en: Classified documents must be collected and destroyed in accordance with regulations after processing.

肖像.zh: 未经本人同意，任何单位不得擅自使用其肖像进行商业宣传。
肖像.py: Wèijīng běnrén tóngyì, rènhé dānwèi bùdé shànzì shǐyòng qí xiàoxiàng jìnxíng shāngyè xuānchuán.
肖像.en: Without the person's consent, no organization may use their portrait for commercial promotion without authorization.

效益.zh: 公司通过技术改造不仅降低了生产成本，还显著提高了经济效益。
效益.py: Gōngsī tōngguò jìshù gǎizào bùjǐn jiàngdī le shēngchǎn chéngběn, hái xiǎnzhù tígāo le jīngjì xiàoyì.
效益.en: Through technological transformation, the company not only reduced production costs, but also significantly improved economic returns.

下属.zh: 一位优秀的领导不仅要懂得合理分工，更要善于倾听下属的意见。
下属.py: Yí wèi yōuxiù de lǐngdǎo bùjǐn yào dǒngde hélǐ fēngōng, gèng yào shànyú qīngtīng xiàshǔ de yìjiàn.
下属.en: An outstanding leader must not only know how to delegate tasks reasonably, but also be good at listening to subordinates' opinions.

屑.zh: 切割机工作时会产生大量金属屑，操作时必须佩戴护目镜。
屑.py: Qiēgējī gōngzuò shí huì chǎnshēng dàliàng jīnshǔxiè, cāozuò shí bìxū pèidài hùmùjìng.
屑.en: When the cutting machine is operating, it produces a large amount of metal shavings, so protective goggles must be worn during operation.

谢绝.zh: 出于安全和卫生考虑，病房在非探视时间谢绝外人来访。
谢绝.py: Chūyú ānquán hé wèishēng kǎolǜ, bìngfáng zài fēi tànshì shíjiān xièjué wàirén láifǎng.
谢绝.en: Out of safety and hygiene considerations, the hospital ward politely declines outside visitors during non-visiting hours.

泄气.zh: 虽然这次实验失败了，但他并没有泄气，而是重新调整了方案。
泄气.py: Suīrán zhè cì shíyàn shībài le, dàn tā bìng méiyǒu xièqì, érshì chóngxīn tiáozhěng le fāng'àn.
泄气.en: Although this experiment failed, he did not lose heart, but instead readjusted the plan.

新陈代谢.zh: 经常喝水和适当运动能有效促进人体的新陈代谢。
新陈代谢.py: Jīngcháng hēshuǐ hé shìdàng yùndòng néng yǒuxiào cùjìn réntǐ de xīnchéndàixiè.
新陈代谢.en: Drinking water regularly and exercising appropriately can effectively promote the body's metabolism.

心得.zh: 读书分享会上，大家轮流发言交流各自的阅读心得与感悟。
心得.py: Dúshū fēnxiǎng huì shang, dàjiā lúnliú fāyán jiāoliú gèzì de yuèdú xīndé yǔ gǎnwù.
心得.en: At the book club meeting, everyone took turns speaking to exchange their reading insights and thoughts.

腥.zh: 如果不加生姜和料酒，这道清蒸鱼吃起来难免会有些腥。
腥.py: Rúguǒ bù jiā shēngjiāng hé liàojiǔ, zhè dào qīngzhēngyú chī qǐlái nánmiǎn huì yǒuxiē xīng.
腥.en: If you do not add ginger and cooking wine, this steamed fish will inevitably taste a bit fishy.

性感.zh: 她今晚身着一袭剪裁得体的黑色晚礼服，显得优雅而性感。
性感.py: Tā jīnwǎn shēnzhe yì xí jiǎncái détǐ de hēisè wǎnlǐfú, xiǎnde yōuyǎ ér xìnggǎn.
性感.en: Tonight she wore a well-tailored black evening gown, looking both elegant and glamorous.

兴高采烈.zh: 得知全班考试成绩名列前茅，同学们兴高采烈地欢呼起来。
兴高采烈.py: Dézhī quán bān kǎoshì chéngjì mínglièqiánmáo, tóngxuémen xìnggāocǎiliè de huānhū qǐlái.
兴高采烈.en: Upon hearing that the whole class ranked at the top in the exam, the students cheered in high spirits.

兴隆.zh: 这家百年老店凭借过硬的品质和公道的价格，生意一直十分兴隆。
兴隆.py: Zhè jiā bǎinián lǎodiàn píngjiè guòyìng de pǐnzhì hé gōngdao de jiàgé, shēngyi yìzhí shífēn xīnglóng.
兴隆.en: Relying on superior quality and fair prices, business at this century-old shop has always been booming.

性情.zh: 他的性情温和谦逊，无论遇到什么困难都能沉着应对。
性情.py: Tā de xìngqíng wēnhé qiānxùn, wúlùn yù dào shénme kùnnan dōu néng chénzhuó yìngduì.
性情.en: He has a gentle and modest disposition, and can face any difficulty with composure.

刑事.zh: 任何触犯国家法律的行为，都必须依法承担相应的刑事责任。
刑事.py: Rènhé chùfàn guójiā fǎlǜ de xíngwéi, dōu bìxū yīfǎ chéngdān xiāngyìng de xíngshì zérèn.
刑事.en: Any act that violates national laws must incur corresponding criminal liability according to law.

辛勤.zh: 经过农民们一整年的辛勤耕耘，秋天终于迎来了丰收。
辛勤.py: Jīngguò nóngmínmen yì zhěng nián de xīnqín gēngyún, qiūtiān zhōngyú yínglái le fēngshōu.
辛勤.en: After a full year of industrious tilling by the farmers, autumn finally brought a bountiful harvest.

欣慰.zh: 看到孩子们都健康长大并且学有所成，父母感到由衷的欣慰。
欣慰.py: Kàndào háizimen dōu jiànkāng zhǎngdà bìngqiě xuéyǒusǒuchéng, fùmǔ gǎndào yóuzhōng de xīnwèi.
欣慰.en: Seeing their children grow up healthy and excel in their studies, the parents felt heartfelt gratification.

欣欣向荣.zh: 随着各项扶持政策的落地，当地的乡村旅游呈现出一派欣欣向荣的景象。
欣欣向荣.py: Suízhe gè xiàng fúchí zhèngcè de luòdì, dāngdì de xiāngcūn lǚyóu chéngxiàn chū yí pài xīnxīnxiàngróng de jǐngxiàng.
欣欣向荣.en: With the implementation of various support policies, local rural tourism presents a thriving and prosperous scene.

心血.zh: 这部厚重的学术专著倾注了教授毕生的心血与智慧。
心血.py: Zhè bù hòuzhòng de xuéshù zhuānzhù qīngzhù le jiàoshòu bìshēng de xīnxuè yǔ zhìhuì.
心血.en: This weighty academic monograph embodies the professor's lifelong painstaking effort and wisdom.

心眼儿.zh: 他这人心眼儿好，邻里之间谁遇到难处他都会伸手相助。
心眼儿.py: Tā zhè rén xīnyǎnr hǎo, línlǐ zhījiān shéi yù dào nánchu tā dōu huì shēnshǒu xiāngzhù.
心眼儿.en: He is genuinely kind-hearted, always willing to lend a helping hand whenever a neighbor runs into difficulty.

凶恶.zh: 面对凶恶的歹徒，这位年轻的警察毫不退缩，英勇搏斗。
凶恶.py: Miànduì xiōng'è de dǎitú, zhè wèi niánqīng de jǐngchá háobù tuìsuō, yīngyǒng bódòu.
凶恶.en: Confronting the ferocious criminal, the young police officer did not shrink back at all and fought bravely.

雄厚.zh: 该科研机构拥有雄厚的技术实力和高素质的专业研发团队。
雄厚.py: Gāi kēyán jīgòu yōngyǒu xiónghòu de jìshù shílì hé gāo sùzhì de zhuānyè yánfā tuánduì.
雄厚.en: The scientific research institution possesses strong technical strength and a highly qualified professional R&D team.

胸怀.zh: 做大事的人需要拥有宽广的胸怀和长远的战略眼光。
胸怀.py: Zuò dàshì de rén xūyào yōngyǒu kuānguǎng de xiōnghuái hé chángyuǎn de zhànlüè yǎnguāng.
胸怀.en: Those who achieve great things need to have a broad mind and a long-term strategic vision.

胸膛.zh: 老战士挺起胸膛，目光坚定地注视着缓缓升起的国旗。
胸膛.py: Lǎo zhànshì tǐngqǐ xiōngtáng, mùguāng jiāndìng de zhùshì zhe huǎnhuǎn shēngqǐ de guóqí.
胸膛.en: The old veteran squared his chest, gazing firmly at the slowly rising national flag.

绣.zh: 奶奶在丝绸枕套上精心绣出了一朵栩栩如生的荷花。
绣.py: Nǎinai zài sīchóu zhěntào shang jīngxīn xiù chū le yì duǒ xǔxǔrúshēng de héhuā.
绣.en: Grandmother meticulously embroidered a lifelike lotus flower onto the silk pillowcase.

休养.zh: 医生建议他手术后去空气清新的海边安静休养一段时间。
休养.py: Yīshēng jiànyì tā shǒushù hòu qù kōngqì qīngxīn de hǎibiān ānjìng xiūyǎng yí duàn shíjiān.
休养.en: The doctor advised him to rest and recuperate quietly by the seaside with fresh air for a while after surgery.

喜闻乐见.zh: 创作者应当用群众喜闻乐见的形式来传播优秀传统文化。
喜闻乐见.py: Chuàngzuòzhě yīngdāng yòng qúnzhòng xǐwénlèjiàn de xíngshì lái chuánbō yōuxiù chuántǒng wénhuà.
喜闻乐见.en: Creators should use forms loved and welcomed by the public to spread fine traditional culture.

喜悦.zh: 收到名牌大学录取通知书的那一刻，全家人脸上洋溢着喜悦。
喜悦.py: Shōudào míngpái dàxué lùqǔ tōngzhīshū de nà yí kè, quán jiārén liǎn shang yángyì zhe xǐyuè.
喜悦.en: The moment the prestigious university admission notice was received, the whole family's faces beamed with joy.

悬念.zh: 这部推理小说的情节环环相扣，将悬念一直保留到了最后一刻。
悬念.py: Zhè bù tuīlǐ xiǎoshuō de qíngjié huánhuánxiàngkòu, jiāng xuánniàn yìzhí bǎoliú dào le zuìhòu yí kè.
悬念.en: The plot of this detective novel is closely interconnected, keeping the suspense until the very last moment.

宣扬.zh: 我们应当积极宣扬绿色低碳的生活方式，共同保护生态环境。
宣扬.py: Wǒmen yīngdāng jījí xuānyáng lǜsè dītàn de shēnghuó fāngshì, gòngtóng bǎohù shēngtài huánjìng.
宣扬.en: We should actively promote a green and low-carbon lifestyle to jointly protect the ecological environment.

悬崖峭壁.zh: 这条蜿蜒的盘山公路修建在悬崖峭壁之间，地势极其险峻。
悬崖峭壁.py: Zhè tiáo wānyán de pánshān gōnglù xiūjiàn zài xuányáqiàobì zhījiān, dìshì jíqí xiǎnjùn.
悬崖峭壁.en: This winding mountain road was built among sheer cliffs and steep rock faces, where the terrain is extremely rugged.

削弱.zh: 持续的高通胀严重削弱了普通家庭的实际购买力。
削弱.py: Chíxù de gāo tōngzhàng yánzhòng xuēruò le pǔtōng jiātíng de shíjì gòumǎilì.
削弱.en: Persistent high inflation has severely weakened the actual purchasing power of ordinary families.

雪上加霜.zh: 原材料涨价本就让工厂举步维艰，突如其来的停电更是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.py: Yuáncáiliào zhǎngjià běn jiù ràng gōngchǎng jǔbùwéijiān, tūrúqílái de tíngdiàn gèng shì xuěshàngjiāshuāng.
雪上加霜.en: Rising raw material prices had already made operations difficult for the factory, and the unexpected power outage made matters even worse.

学说.zh: 达尔文提出的进化论学说对现代生物学的发展产生了深远的影响。
学说.py: Dá'ěrwén tíchū de jìnhuàlùn xuéshuō duì xiàndài shēngwùxué de fāzhǎn chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn de yǐngxiǎng.
学说.en: The theory of evolution proposed by Darwin had a profound influence on the development of modern biology.

畜牧.zh: 这片广袤的温带草原水源充足，非常适合发展现代畜牧业。
畜牧.py: Zhè piàn guǎngmào de wēndài cǎoyuán shuǐyuán chōngzú, fēicháng shìhé fāzhǎn xiàndài xùmùyè.
畜牧.en: This vast temperate grassland is rich in water resources and is well-suited for developing modern animal husbandry.

巡逻.zh: 边防战士顶着严寒，日夜在边境线上巡逻，保卫国家安全。
巡逻.py: Biānfáng zhànshì dǐngzhe yánhán, rìyè zài biānjìngxiàn shang xúnluó, bǎowèi guójiā ānquán.
巡逻.en: Braving the biting cold, border guards patrol along the frontier day and night to safeguard national security.

寻觅.zh: 他背着行囊走遍大江南北，只为寻觅那份失传已久的民间手艺。
寻觅.py: Tā bēizhe xíngnáng zǒubiàn dàjiāngnánběi, zhǐ wèi xúnmì nà fèn shīchuán yǐjiǔ de mínjiān shǒuyì.
寻觅.en: Carrying his pack, he traveled all over the country just to seek that folk handicraft that had been lost for ages.

熏陶.zh: 在家庭浓厚艺术氛围的熏陶下，她从小就对绘画产生了浓厚的兴趣。
熏陶.py: Zài jiātíng nónghòu yìshù fēnwéi de xūntáo xià, tā cóngxiǎo jiù duì huìhuà chǎnshēng le nónghòu de xìngqù.
熏陶.en: Nurtured by the strong artistic atmosphere of her family, she developed a deep interest in painting from an early age.

虚荣.zh: 他为了满足一时的虚荣心，不惜借钱购买昂贵的奢侈品。
虚荣.py: Tā wèile mǎnzú yìshí de xūróngxīn, bùxī jièqián gòumǎi ángguì de shēchǐpǐn.
虚荣.en: To satisfy his temporary vanity, he did not hesitate to borrow money to buy expensive luxury goods.

序言.zh: 作者在本书的序言中，详细阐述了自己撰写这部长篇小说的初衷。
序言.py: Zuòzhě zài běn shū de xùyán zhōng, xiángxì chǎnshù le zìjǐ zhuànxiě zhè bù chángpiān xiǎoshuō de chūzhōng.
序言.en: In the preface of this book, the author elaborated in detail on his original motivation for writing this full-length novel.

演变.zh: 汉字经历了数千年的历史演变，从甲骨文逐渐发展为现代楷书。
演变.py: Hànzì jīnglì le shù qiān nián de lìshǐ yǎnbiàn, cóng jiǎgǔwén zhújiàn fāzhǎn wéi xiàndài kǎishū.
演变.en: Chinese characters have undergone thousands of years of historical evolution, gradually developing from oracle bone script to modern regular script.

样品.zh: 厂家在正式签订大宗采购合同前，向客户寄送了几套优质的产品样品。
样品.py: Chǎngjiā zài zhèngshì qiāndìng dàzōng cǎigòu hétong qián, xiàng kèhù jìsòng le jǐ tào yōuzhì de chǎnpǐn yàngpǐn.
样品.en: Prior to officially signing the bulk purchase contract, the manufacturer sent several high-quality product samples to the client.

掩护.zh: 特警队员在浓烟的掩护下迅速突入房间，成功制服了犯罪分子。
掩护.py: Tèjǐng duìyuán zài nóngyān de yǎnhù xià xùnsù tūrù fángjiān, chénggōng zhìfú le fànzuì fènzǐ.
掩护.en: Under cover of heavy smoke, the SWAT team quickly breached the room and successfully subdued the criminal.

严峻.zh: 面对日益严峻的就业形势，大学生需要不断提升自身综合素质。
严峻.py: Miànduì rìyì yánjùn de jiùyè xíngshì, dàxuéshēng xūyào bùduàn tíshēng zìshēn zōnghé sùzhì.
严峻.en: Confronted with an increasingly severe employment situation, college students need to continuously enhance their comprehensive qualities.

严密.zh: 这篇科研论文逻辑严密，论据充分，得出了令人信服的结论。
严密.py: Zhè piān kēyán lùnwén luóji yánmì, lùnjù chōngfèn, déchū le lìngrén xìnfú de jiélùn.
严密.en: This scientific research paper features rigorous logic and ample arguments, arriving at a convincing conclusion.

眼色.zh: 看到母亲使了个眼色，小男孩立刻停止了任性哭闹。
眼色.py: Kàndào mǔqīn shǐ le ge yǎnsè, xiǎo nánhái lìkè tíngzhǐ le rènxìng kūnào.
眼色.en: Seeing his mother give him a meaningful glance, the little boy immediately stopped crying and whining willfully.

验收.zh: 经过相关质检部门严格细致的现场检验，这项市政大桥工程顺利通过了验收。
验收.py: Jīngguò xiāngguān zhìjiǎn bùmén yángé xìzhì de xiànchǎng jiǎnyàn, zhè xiàng shìzhèng dàqiáo gōngchéng shùnlì tōngguò le yànshōu.
验收.en: Following rigorous and meticulous on-site inspection by relevant quality inspection departments, this municipal bridge project successfully passed acceptance.

演习.zh: 学校每学期都会组织全校师生开展一次应急消防疏散演习。
演习.py: Xuéxiào měi xuéqī dōu huì zǔzhī quán xiào shīshēng kāizhǎn yí cì yìngjí xiāofáng shūsàn yǎnxí.
演习.en: Every semester, the school organizes an emergency fire evacuation drill for all teachers and students.

演绎.zh: 这位老戏骨凭借精湛的演技，将那个复杂矛盾的历史人物演绎得淋漓尽致。
演绎.py: Zhè wèi lǎoxìgǔ píngjiè jīngzhàn de yǎnjì, jiāng nàge fùzá máodùn de lìshǐ rénwù yǎnyì de línlíjìnzhì.
演绎.en: Drawing upon consummate acting skills, this veteran actor portrayed that complex and contradictory historical figure to the fullest.

摇摆.zh: 狂风呼啸而过，路边的行道树在风中剧烈地左右摇摆。
摇摆.py: Kuángfēng hūxiào ér guò, lùbiān de xíngdàoshù zài fēng zhōng jùliè de zuǒyòu yáobǎi.
摇摆.en: As wild winds howled past, the roadside trees swayed violently from side to side in the gale.

摇晃.zh: 强烈的海风呼啸而过，停泊在码头的几艘小渔船剧烈地摇晃着。
摇晃.py: Qiángliè de hǎifēng hūxiào ér guò, tíngbó zài mǎtóu de jǐ sōu xiǎo yúchuán jùliè de yáohuàngzhe.
摇晃.en: As the strong sea wind whistled past, several small fishing boats moored at the dock rocked violently.

耀眼.zh: 正午的阳光洒在白雪皑皑的山峰上，反射出十分耀眼的光芒。
耀眼.py: Zhèngwǔ de yángguāng sǎ zài bǎixuě-ái'ái de shānfēng shang, fǎnshè chū shífēn yàoyǎn de guāngmáng.
耀眼.en: The midday sun shone upon the snow-covered peaks, reflecting a dazzling brilliance.

咬牙切齿.zh: 一提到那个卷走全村人血汗钱的骗子，大家就恨得咬牙切齿。
咬牙切齿.py: Yī tídào nàge juǎnzǒu quán cūn rén xuèhànqián de piànzi, dàjiā jiù hèn de yǎoyá-qièchǐ.
咬牙切齿.en: Whenever that fraudster who ran off with the hard-earned money of the whole village was mentioned, everyone gnashed their teeth with hatred.

压迫.zh: 长期保持不良坐姿会压迫颈椎神经，引起严重的头晕和手臂发麻。
压迫.py: Chángqī bǎochí bùliáng zuòzī huì yāpò jǐngzhuī shénjīng, yǐnqǐ yánzhòng de tóuyūn hé shǒubì fāmá.
压迫.en: Maintaining poor sitting posture for prolonged periods compresses cervical spine nerves, causing severe dizziness and numbness in the arms.

压抑.zh: 长期在沉重的高压环境中工作，如果得不到合理调适，容易让人感到内心压抑。
压抑.py: Chángqī zài chénzhòng de gāoyā huánjìng zhōng gōngzuò, rúguǒ dé bù dào hélǐ tiáoshì, róngyì ràng rén gǎndào nèixīn yāyì.
压抑.en: Working in a heavy, high-pressure environment for a prolonged time without proper adjustment can easily make one feel emotionally depressed and stifled.

压榨.zh: 劳动法明确保护劳动者的合法权益，坚决禁止用人单位变相压榨员工。
压榨.py: Láodòngfǎ míngquè bǎohù láodòngzhě de héfǎ quányì, jiānjué jǐnzhǐ yòngrén dānwèi biànxiàng yāzhà yuángōng.
压榨.en: The labor law explicitly protects workers' legitimate rights and interests, strictly prohibiting employers from exploiting employees in disguised forms.

拽.zh: 他反应极其敏捷，在书包快要掉下悬崖的瞬间一把拽住了背带。
拽.py: Tā fǎnyìng jíqí mǐnjié, zài shūbāo kuàiyào diàoxià xuányá de shùnjiān yī bǎ zhuài zhù le bēidài.
拽.en: His reaction was extremely agile, grabbing and pulling back the shoulder strap the very instant the backpack was about to fall off the cliff.

野蛮.zh: 在现代法治社会中，任何野蛮暴力的行径都会受到法律的严肃制裁。
野蛮.py: Zài xiàndài fǎzhì shèhuì zhōng, rènhé yěmán bàolì de xíngjìng dōuhuì shòudào fǎlǜ de yánsù zhìcái.
野蛮.en: In a modern society governed by the rule of law, any barbarous and violent act will be severely punished by law.

野心.zh: 这家初创科技企业毫不掩饰在全球新能源汽车领域扩张的雄伟野心。
野心.py: Zhè jiā chūchuàng kējì qǐyè háobù yǎnshì zài quánqiú xīn néngyuán qìchē lǐngyù kuòzhāng de xióngwěi yěxīn.
野心.en: This technology startup makes no secret of its ambitious plans to expand into the global new energy vehicle sector.

亦.zh: 想要在学术研究上有所建树，既需要刻苦钻研的精神，亦需要勇于突破的创新思维。
亦.py: Xiǎngyào zài xuéshù yánjiū shang yǒusuǒ jiànshù, jì xūyào kèkǔ zhuānyán de jīngshén, yì xūyào yǒngyú tūpò de chuàngxīn sīwéi.
亦.en: To achieve accomplishment in academic research, one needs not only the spirit of assiduous study, but also innovative thinking with the courage to make breakthroughs.

翼.zh: 雄鹰展开宽大强健的双翼，在崇山峻岭之间的碧蓝天空中盘旋。
翼.py: Xióngyīng zhǎnkāi kuāndà qiángjiàn de shuāngyì, zài chóngshān-jùnlǐng zhījiān de bìlán tiānkōng zhōng pánxuán.
翼.en: The eagle spread its broad, strong wings, soaring in circles in the blue sky between towering mountain ranges.

一度.zh: 由于受到罕见特大暴雨的影响，该地区的空中航线和铁路客运一度被迫中断。
一度.py: Yóuyú shòudào hǎnjiàn tèdà bàoyǔ de yǐngxiǎng, gāi dìqū de kōngzhōng hángxiàn hé tiělù kèyùn yīdù bèipò zhōngduàn.
一度.en: Due to the impact of rare torrential rain, air routes and railway passenger transport in the region were once forced to suspend for a time.

遗留.zh: 经过多轮友好而务实的磋商，两国边界上长久遗留的历史争端终于得到化解。
遗留.py: Jīngguò duō lún yǒuhǎo ér wùshí de cuōshāng, liǎng guó biānjiè shang chángjiǔ yíliú de lìshǐ zhēngduān zhōngyú dédào huàjiě.
遗留.en: After multiple rounds of friendly and pragmatic consultations, the longstanding historical disputes left over along the border of the two countries were finally resolved.

隐蔽.zh: 侦察队员在密林深处找到了一个极其隐蔽的山洞，作为临时联络据点。
隐蔽.py: Zhēnchá duìyuán zài mìlín shēnchù zhǎodào le yī gè jíqí yǐnbì de shāndòng, zuòwéi línshí liánluò jùdiǎn.
隐蔽.en: Deep in the dense forest, the scouts found an extremely concealed cave to serve as a temporary contact point.

应酬.zh: 他最近由于频繁参加各种商务应酬，几乎抽不出空闲时间陪伴家人。
应酬.py: Tā zuìjìn yóuyú pínfán cānjiā gèzhǒng shāngwù yìngchou, jǐhū chōubùchū kòngxián shíjiān péibàn jiārén.
应酬.en: Having to frequently attend various business social engagements recently, he has had almost no free time to accompany his family.

盈利.zh: 该新能源汽车制造企业在成立五年后，终于迎来了首次季度规模化盈利。
盈利.py: Gāi xīn néngyuán qìchē zhìzào qǐyè zài chénglì wǔ nián hòu, zhōngyú yínglái le shǒucì jìdù guīmóhuà yínglì.
盈利.en: Five years after its establishment, the new energy vehicle manufacturer finally welcomed its first quarterly large-scale profit.

荧屏.zh: 这位德艺双馨的老演员在电视荧屏上活跃了数十年，塑造了众多深受观众喜爱的经典角色。
荧屏.py: Zhè wèi déyì-shuāngxīn de lǎo yǎnyuán zài diànshì yíngpíng shang huóyuè le shù shí nián, sùzào le zhòngduō shēnshòu guānzhòng xǐ'ài de jīngdiǎn juésè.
荧屏.en: This respected veteran actor has been active on the television screen for decades, portraying numerous classic roles deeply loved by the audience.

应邀.zh: 诺贝尔物理学奖得主应邀出席了本届国际科学论坛，并发表了主旨演讲。
应邀.py: Nuòbèi'ěr wùlǐxué jiǎng dézhǔ yìngyāo chūxí le běnjiè guójì kēxué lùntán, bìng fābiǎo le zhǔzhǐ yǎnjiǎng.
应邀.en: The Nobel laureate in physics attended this international science forum upon invitation and delivered a keynote speech.

隐患.zh: 消防监督人员在节前安全大检查中，及时发现并排除了多处重大火灾隐患。
隐患.py: Xiāofáng jiāndū rényuán zài jiéqián ānquán dà jiǎnchá zhōng, jíshí fāxiàn bìng páichú le duō chù zhòngdà huǒzāi yǐnhuàn.
隐患.en: During the pre-holiday safety inspection, fire safety inspectors promptly discovered and eliminated several major hidden fire hazards.

隐约.zh: 站在晨雾弥漫的山顶，隐约能够看见远方蜿蜒流淌的江水与错落的村落。
隐约.py: Zhàn zài chénwù mímàn de shāndǐng, yǐnyuē nénggòu kànjiàn yuǎnfāng wānyán liútǎng de jiāngshuǐ yǔ cuòluò de cūnluò.
隐约.en: Standing atop the mountain shrouded in morning mist, one could faintly see the winding river and scattered villages in the distance.

毅然.zh: 面对海外机构开出的优厚待遇，他毅然决定回到祖国参与国家重点实验室的建设。
毅然.py: Miànduì hǎiwài jīgòu kāichū de yōuhòu dàiyù, tā yìrán juédìng huídào zǔguó cānyù guójiā zhòngdiǎn shíyànshì de jiànshè.
毅然.en: In the face of the generous remuneration offered by overseas institutions, he resolutely decided to return to his motherland to participate in building national key laboratories.

一如既往.zh: 尽管国际市场竞争日趋激烈，这家百年老字号一如既往地坚持精益求精的匠人品质。
一如既往.py: Jǐnguǎn guójì shìchǎng jìngzhēng rìqū jīliè, zhè jiā bǎinián lǎozìhào yīrújìwǎng de jiānchí jīngyì-qiújīng de jiàngrén pǐnzhì.
一如既往.en: Even though international market competition is intensifying by the day, this century-old time-honored brand continues as always to uphold the craftsman quality of striving for perfection.

一丝不苟.zh: 航天工程师在组装火箭精密仪器时一丝不苟，不放过任何一个细微的技术参数。
一丝不苟.py: Hángtiān gōngchéngshī zài zǔzhuāng huǒjiàn jīngmì yíqì shí yīsībùgǒu, bù fàngguò rènhé yī gè xìwēi de jìshù cānshù.
一丝不苟.en: The aerospace engineer was meticulous when assembling the rocket's precision instruments, never overlooking any minute technical parameter.

依托.zh: 该国家级高新技术产业园区依托周边重点高校的科研资源，迅速实现了科研成果的转化。
依托.py: Gāi guójiājí gāoxīn jìshù chǎnyè yuánqū yītuō zhōubiān zhòngdiǎn gāoxiào de kēyán zīyuán, xùnsù shíxiàn le kēyán chéngguǒ de zhuǎnhuà.
依托.en: Relying on the scientific research resources of surrounding key universities, the national high-tech industrial park rapidly achieved the commercialization of research achievements.

意向.zh: 经过深入务实的商务谈判，双方代表正式达成了深化战略投资的合作意向。
意向.py: Jīngguò shēnrù wùshí de shāngwù tánpàn, shuāngfāng dàibiǎo zhèngshì dáchéng le shēnhuà zhànlüè tóuzī de hézuò yìxiàng.
意向.en: Following in-depth and pragmatic business negotiations, representatives of both parties formally reached a cooperative intention to deepen strategic investments.

以至.zh: 青年科研团队连续攻关几个星期，常常通宵达旦地试验，以至几乎忘记了今天是星期几。
以至.py: Qīngnián kēyán tuánduì liánxù gōngguān jǐ gè xīngqī, chángcháng tōngxiāo-dádàn de shìyàn, yǐzhì jǐhū wàngjì le jīntiān shì xīngqī jǐ.
以至.en: The young research team tackled key problems continuously for several weeks, often running tests throughout the night, to the point that they almost forgot what day of the week it was.

以致.zh: 由于前期项目方案缺少严格细致的实地考察，以致后续施工阶段频频遭遇意外阻碍。
以致.py: Yóuyú qiánqī xiàngmù fāng'àn quēshǎo yángé xìzhì de shídì kǎochá, yǐzhì hòuxù shīgōng jiēduàn pínpín zāoyù yìwài zǔ'ài.
以致.en: Because the initial project proposal lacked rigorous on-site investigation, it resulted in frequent unforeseen obstacles during the subsequent construction phase.

拥护.zh: 这项减轻中小学生课业负担的教育改革方案一经公布，就受到了广大家长的普遍拥护。
拥护.py: Zhè xiàng jiǎnqīng zhōng-xiǎoxuéshēng kèyè fùdān de jiàoyù gǎigé fāng'àn yījīng gōngbù, jiù shòudào le guǎngdà jiāzhǎng de pǔbiàn yōnghù.
拥护.en: Once the education reform plan aimed at easing academic burdens on primary and secondary school students was announced, it received widespread endorsement from parents.

庸俗.zh: 优秀的文学作品应当富有深厚的人文关怀，而不应依靠庸俗低劣的噱头来吸引读者。
庸俗.py: Yōuxiù de wénxué zuòpǐn yīngdāng fùyǒu shēnhòu de rénwén guānhuái, ér bù yīng yīkào yōngsú dīliè de xuétóu lái xīyǐn dúzhě.
庸俗.en: Outstanding literary works should be rich in profound humanistic care, rather than relying on vulgar and lowbrow gimmicks to attract readers.

踊跃.zh: 社区无偿献血的倡议书发出后，居民们纷纷踊跃响应，早早地来到服务站排队登记。
踊跃.py: Shèqū wúcháng xiànxuè de chàngyìshū fāchū hòu, jūmín men fēnfēn yǒngyuè xiǎngyìng, zǎozǎo de láidào fúwùzhàn páiduì dēngjì.
踊跃.en: After the initiative for voluntary blood donation in the community was issued, residents responded enthusiastically and arrived early at the service station to queue up and register.

诱惑.zh: 无论面对多么丰厚的短期利益诱惑，企业经营者都必须坚守诚信底线与商业伦理。
诱惑.py: Wúlùn miànduì duōme fēnghòu de duǎnqī lìyì yòuhuò, qǐyè jīngyíngzhě dōu bìxū jiānshǒu chéngxìn dǐxiàn yǔ shāngyè lúnlǐ.
诱惑.en: No matter how lucrative the temptation of short-term gains, business managers must hold firm to the bottom line of integrity and business ethics.

油腻.zh: 夏季天气闷热，营养师建议多食用新鲜蔬菜和水果，尽量减少油腻食物的摄入。
油腻.py: Xiàjì tiānqì mēnrè, yíngyǎngshī jiànyì duō shíyòng xīnxiān shūcài hé shuǐguǒ, jǐnliàng jiǎnshǎo yóunì shíwù de shèrù.
油腻.en: In hot and humid summer weather, nutritionists advise eating more fresh vegetables and fruits while minimizing the intake of greasy foods.

优胜劣汰.zh: 市场经济遵循优胜劣汰的竞争规则，唯有不断技术创新的企业才能在浪潮中立于不败之地。
优胜劣汰.py: Shìchǎng jīngjì zūnxún yōushèng-liètài de jìngzhēng guīzé, wéiyǒu bùduàn jìshù chuàngxīn de qǐyè cái néng zài làngcháo zhōng lìyú-bùbàizhīdì.
优胜劣汰.en: The market economy follows the competitive rule of survival of the fittest; only enterprises that constantly innovate technologically can remain invincible amid the tide.

有条不紊.zh: 面对突发的网络安全危机，应急指挥中心有条不紊地排查漏洞并恢复核心系统。
有条不紊.py: Miànduì tūfā de wǎngluò ānquán wēijī, yìngjí zhǐhuī zhōngxīn yǒutiáo-bùwěn de páichá lòudòng bìng huīfù héxīn xìtǒng.
有条不紊.en: In the face of a sudden cybersecurity crisis, the emergency command center methodically investigated vulnerabilities and restored core systems.

优越.zh: 该港口依托优越的地理区位与完善的现代集装箱设施，成为了重要的国际航运枢纽。
优越.py: Gāi gǎngkǒu yītuō yōuyuè de dìlǐ qūwèi yǔ wánshàn de xiàndài jízhuāngxiāng shèshī, chéngwéi le zhòngyào de guójì hángyùn shūniǔ.
优越.en: Relying on its superior geographical location and sound modern container facilities, the port has become an important international shipping hub.

愈.zh: 随着山势愈来愈险峻，登山队员们每前进一步都需要付出极大的体力与耐力。
愈.py: Suízhe shānshì yù lái yù xiǎnjùn, dēngshān duìyuán men měi qiánjìn yī bù dōu xūyào fùchū jídà de tǐlì yǔ nàilì.
愈.en: As the mountain terrain grew steeper and steeper, the climbers had to exert immense physical strength and endurance with every step forward.

熨.zh: 出席重要的外事宴会之前，外交官特意将西服套装熨烫得平整利落。
熨.py: Chūxí zhòngyào de wàishì yànhuì zhīqián, wàijiāoguān tèyì jiāng xīfú tàozhuāng yùntàng de píngzhěng lìluo.
熨.en: Before attending the important foreign-affairs banquet, the diplomat specially ironed his suit neat and smooth.

元首.zh: 在此次高峰会谈中，多国国家元首就应对全球气候变化共同签署了联合声明。
元首.py: Zài cǐcì gāofēng huìtán zhōng, duō guó guójiā yuánshǒu jiù yìngduì quánqiú qìhòu biànhuà gòngtóng qiānshǔ le liánhé shēngmíng.
元首.en: During this summit meeting, heads of state from multiple countries jointly signed a joint declaration on tackling global climate change.

冤枉.zh: 司法机关在案件侦破过程中必须重证据、重调查，绝不能冤枉任何一个无辜的公民。
冤枉.py: Sīfǎ jīguān zài ànjiàn zhēnpò guòchéng zhōng bìxū zhòng zhèngjù, zhòng diàochá, jué bù néng yuānwang rènhé yī gè wúgū de gōngmín.
