冤枉.en: In the course of solving cases, judicial organs must emphasize evidence and investigation, and must never wrongly accuse any innocent citizen.

岳父.zh: 趁着长假，他和妻子带着丰盛的礼品回乡探望年事已高的岳父岳母。
岳父.py: Chènzhe chángjià, tā hé qīzi dàizhe fēngshèng de lǐpǐn huíxiāng tànwàng niánshì-yǐgāo de yuèfù yuèmǔ.
岳父.en: Taking advantage of the long holiday, he and his wife took lavish gifts back home to visit his elderly father-in-law and mother-in-law.

乐谱.zh: 即使没有摆放乐谱，这位天赋异禀的青年指挥家依然能精准无误地掌控整部交响曲的节奏。
乐谱.py: Jíshǐ méiyǒu bǎifàng yuèpǔ, zhè wèi tiānfù-yìbǐng de qīngnián zhǐhuījiā yīrán néng jīngzhǔn-wúwù de zhǎngkòng zhěng bù jiāoxiǎngqǔ de jiézòu.
乐谱.en: Even without sheet music in front of him, this exceptionally talented young conductor could still precisely and flawlessly control the tempo of the entire symphony.

蕴藏.zh: 我国广袤的西部盆地地质构造独特，地下蕴藏着极为丰富的天然气和石油资源。
蕴藏.py: Wǒguó guǎngmào de xībù péndì dìzhì gòuzào dútè, dìxià yùncángzhe jíqí fēngfù de tiānránqì hé shíyóu zīyuán.
蕴藏.en: The vast western basins of our country have unique geological structures, harboring extremely rich natural gas and petroleum resources beneath the ground.

运算.zh: 新一代量子计算机具备令人惊叹的数据处理能力，能够在瞬间完成传统超算耗时数月的复杂运算。
运算.py: Xīn yī dài liàngzǐ jìsuànjī jùbèi lìng rén jīngtàn de shùjù chǔlǐ nénglì, nénggòu zài shùnjiān wánchéng chuántǒng chāosuàn hàoshí shù yuè de fùzá yùnsuàn.
运算.en: The new generation of quantum computers possesses astonishing data processing capabilities, capable of completing in an instant complex mathematical operations that would take conventional supercomputers months.

孕育.zh: 长江与黄河流域肥沃的平原，孕育了源远流长、生生不息的中华文明。
孕育.py: Chángjiāng yǔ Huánghé liúyù féiwò de píngyuán, yùnyù le yuányuǎn-liúcháng, shēngshēng-bùxī de Zhōnghuá wénmíng.
孕育.en: The fertile plains along the Yangtze and Yellow River basins nurtured the enduring and ever-flourishing Chinese civilization.

预赛.zh: 经过连续三天激烈的预赛争夺，共有八名顶尖游泳选手成功跻身最终的冠亚军决赛。
预赛.py: Jīngguò liánxù sān tiān jīliè de yùsài zhēngduó, gòng yǒu bā míng dǐngjiān yóuyǒng xuǎnshǒu chénggōng jīshēn zuìzhōng de guàn-yàjūn juésài.
预赛.en: After three consecutive days of fierce preliminary competition, eight top swimmers successfully advanced to the final championship heats.

寓言.zh: 《伊索寓言》借由生动幽默的小动物故事，深入浅出地向人们传达做人做事的深刻哲理。
寓言.py: "Yīsuǒ Yùyán" jièyóu shēngdòng yōumò de xiǎo dòngwù gùshi, shēnrù-qiǎnchū de xiàng rénmen chuándá zuòrén-zuòshì de shēnkè zhélǐ.
寓言.en: "Aesop's Fables" conveys profound life philosophies to people in a simple and accessible way through vivid and humorous stories of little animals.

予以.zh: 针对在重大科技攻关中取得突破性成果的杰出科研骨干，国家将予以表彰和重奖。
予以.py: Zhēnduì zài zhòngdà kējì gōngguān zhōng qǔdé tūpòxìng chéngguǒ de jiéchū kēyán gǔgàn, guójiā jiāng yǔyǐ biǎozhāng hé zhòngjiǎng.
予以.en: In recognition of outstanding core researchers who achieve breakthrough results in major technological endeavors, the state will bestow commendations and substantial awards.

咋.zh: 听完会议上的突然变动，小李一脸疑惑地看着身边的同事，小声问道：“这到底咋回事？”
咋.py: Tīngwán huìyì shang de tūrán biàndòng, Xiǎo Lǐ yī liǎn yíhuò de kànzhe shēnbiān de tóngshì, xiǎo shēng wèndào: "Zhè dàodǐ zǎ huí shì?"
咋.en: Hearing about the sudden changes at the meeting, Xiao Li looked at the colleague beside him with a puzzled expression and asked in a low voice, "What on earth happened?"

砸.zh: 狂风暴雨中，折断的粗壮树干重重地砸在停在路旁的轿车车顶上。
砸.py: Kuángfēng-bàoyǔ zhōng, zhéduàn de cūzhuàng shùgàn zhòngzhòng de zá zài tíng zài lùpáng de jiàochē chēdǐng shang.
砸.en: Amid the storm, the snapped thick tree trunk smashed heavily onto the roof of the car parked by the roadside.

宰.zh: 文旅局设立了二十四小时投诉热线，坚决整治旅游景区个别餐馆高价宰客的乱象。
宰.py: Wénlǚjú shèlì le èrshísì xiǎoshí tóusù rèxiàn, jiānjué zhěngzhì lǚyóu jǐngqū gèbié cānguǎn gāojià zǎikè de luànxiàng.
宰.en: The Culture and Tourism Bureau set up a 24-hour complaint hotline to resolutely clean up the malpractice of certain restaurants in tourist scenic spots ripping off customers with exorbitant prices.

再接再厉.zh: 虽然我们在初赛中取得了第一名，但仍需再接再厉，争取在决赛中卫冕。
再接再厉.py: Suīrán wǒmen zài chūsài zhōng qǔdéle dì-yī míng, dàn réng xū zàijiēzàilì, zhēngqǔ zài juésài zhōng wèimiǎn.
再接再厉.en: Although we took first place in the preliminary rounds, we still need to make sustained efforts to defend our title in the finals.

杂技.zh: 这群年轻演员在杂技表演中展现了惊人的柔韧性与平衡技巧。
杂技.py: Zhè qún niánqīng yǎnyuán zài zájì biǎoyǎn zhōng zhǎnxiànle jīngrén de róurènxìng yǔ pínghéng jìqiǎo.
杂技.en: These young performers demonstrated astonishing flexibility and balancing skills in the acrobatics show.

杂交.zh: 农业科学家通过培育杂交水稻，大幅提高了粮食的亩产量。
杂交.py: Nóngyè kēxuéjiā tōngguò péiyù zájiāo shuǐdào, dàfú tígāole liángshi de mǔchǎnliàng.
杂交.en: Agricultural scientists significantly increased per-mu grain yields by breeding hybrid rice.

暂且.zh: 具体的实施方案暂且搁置，我们先集中精力把预算确定下来。
暂且.py: Jùtǐ de shíshī fāng'àn zànqiě gēzhì, wǒmen xiān jízhōng jīnglì bǎ yùsuàn quèdìng xiàlai.
暂且.en: Let us put the specific implementation plan aside for now and focus our energy on finalizing the budget first.

赞叹.zh: 站在悬崖边俯瞰壮丽的峡谷风光，所有游客都忍不住由衷赞叹。
赞叹.py: Zhàn zài xuányá biān fǔkàn zhuànglì de xiágǔ fēngguāng, suǒyǒu yóukè dōu rěnbuzhù yóuzhōng zàntàn.
赞叹.en: Standing at the edge of the cliff overlooking the magnificent canyon scenery, all the tourists could not help gasping in heartfelt admiration.

赞扬.zh: 这位医生在疫情期间坚守岗位的敬业精神，受到了社会各界的广泛赞扬。
赞扬.py: Zhè wèi yīshēng zài yìqíng qījiān jiānshǒu gǎngwèi de jìngyè jīngshén, shòudàole shèhuì gèjiè de guǎngfàn zànyáng.
赞扬.en: The doctor's dedication in remaining at his post during the epidemic received widespread praise from all sectors of society.

造反.zh: 在严酷的压迫和饥荒之下，边境的驻军最终起义造反。
造反.py: Zài yánkù de yāpò hé jīhuāng zhīxià, biānjìng de zhùjūn zuìzhōng qǐyì zàofǎn.
造反.en: Under harsh oppression and famine, the border garrison ultimately rose up in revolt.

糟蹋.zh: 既然买回了这么好的新鲜食材，就别糟蹋了，让主厨来精心烹饪吧。
糟蹋.py: Jìrán mǎi huíle zhème hǎo de xīnxiān shícái, jiù bié zāotà le, ràng zhǔchú lái jīngxīn pēngrèn ba.
糟蹋.en: Since we bought such fine, fresh ingredients, let's not waste them and have the head chef prepare them meticulously.

贼.zh: 那个潜入仓库盗窃贵重货物的贼，最终被警方当场抓获。
贼.py: Nàge qiánrù cāngkù dàoqiè guìzhòng huòwù de zéi, zuìzhōng bèi jǐngfāng dāngchǎng zhuāhuò.
贼.en: The thief who broke into the warehouse to steal valuable goods was ultimately caught red-handed by the police.

渣.zh: 泡完茶后，她顺手把茶壶里的茶叶渣倒进了厨余垃圾桶。
渣.py: Pào wán chá hòu, tā shùnshǒu bǎ cháhú lǐ de cháyè zhā dào jìnle chúyú lājītǒng.
渣.en: After brewing the tea, she conveniently dumped the tea dregs from the teapot into the food waste bin.

眨.zh: 强烈的阳光照射过来，刺得他不由自主地连续眨了几下眼睛。
眨.py: Qiángliè de yángguāng zhàoshè guòlai, cì de tā bùyóuzìzhǔ de liánxù zhǎle jǐ xià yǎnjing.
眨.en: The intense sunlight shone directly at him, dazzling him into involuntarily blinking his eyes several times.

债券.zh: 为了降低投资组合的整体风险，基金经理配置了一定比例的国债与企业债券。
债券.py: Wèile jiàngdī tóuzī zǔhé de zhěngtǐ fēngxiǎn, jījīn jīnglǐ pèizhìle yīdìng bǐlì de guózhài yǔ qǐyè zhàiquàn.
债券.en: To reduce the overall risk of the investment portfolio, the fund manager allocated a certain proportion of government and corporate bonds.

摘要.zh: 在提交毕业论文之前，导师要求我们在正文开头附上一份中英文摘要。
摘要.py: Zài tíjiāo bìyè lùnwén zhīqián, dǎoshī yāoqiú wǒmen zài zhèngwén kāitóu fùshàng yī fèn Zhōng-Yīngwén zhāiyào.
摘要.en: Before submitting our graduation thesis, the advisor required us to attach an abstract in both Chinese and English at the beginning of the text.

章程.zh: 股东大会全票通过了修改公司章程的决议，明确了董事会的职责范围。
章程.py: Gǔdōng dàhuì quánpiào tōngguòle xiūgǎi gōngsī zhāngchéng de juéyì, míngquèle dǒngshìhuì de zhízé fànwéi.
章程.en: The shareholders' general meeting unanimously approved the resolution to amend the company's articles of association, clarifying the scope of responsibilities of the board of directors.

沾光.zh: 随着新地铁线的开通，沿线的商铺都跟着沾光，客流量明显增加。
沾光.py: Suízhe xīn dìtiěxiàn de kāitōng, yánxiàn de shāngpù dōu gēnzhe zhānguāng, kèliúliàng míngxiǎn zēngjiā.
沾光.en: With the opening of the new subway line, shops along the route also benefited, seeing a significant increase in foot traffic.

展望.zh: 年会期间，董事长回顾了过去的成就，并对集团未来的战略规划进行了展望。
展望.py: Niánhuì qījiān, dǒngshìzhǎng huígùle guòqù de chéngjiù, bìng duì jítuán wèilái de zhànlüè guīhuà jìnxíngle zhǎnwàng.
展望.en: During the annual meeting, the chairman reviewed past achievements and looked ahead to the group's future strategic planning.

瞻仰.zh: 清明节当天，许多市民自发前往烈士陵园，肃穆地瞻仰人民英雄纪念碑。
瞻仰.py: Qīngmíngjié dāngtiān, xǔduō shìmín zìfā qiánwǎng lièshì língyuán, sùmù de zhānyǎng rénmín yīngxióng jīniànbēi.
瞻仰.en: On Tomb Sweeping Day, many citizens went of their own accord to the martyrs' cemetery to solemnly pay homage at the Monument to the People's Heroes.

战役.zh: 这场决定性战役彻底扭转了战场局势，加速了战争结束的进程。
战役.py: Zhè chǎng juédìngxìng zhànyì chèdǐ niǔzhuǎnle zhànchǎng júshì, jiāsùle zhànzhēng jiéshù de jìnchéng.
战役.en: This decisive campaign completely reversed the situation on the battlefield and accelerated the end of the war.

照料.zh: 母亲生病住院期间，全家人轮流在床前悉心照料。
照料.py: Mǔqīn shēngbìng zhùyuàn qījiān, quán jiārén lúnliú zài chuángqián xīxīn zhàoliào.
照料.en: While mother was hospitalized due to illness, the whole family took turns taking meticulous care of her by her bedside.

朝气蓬勃.zh: 这支朝气蓬勃的青年创业团队凭借敏锐的市场洞察力迅速崭露头角。
朝气蓬勃.py: Zhè zhī zhāoqìpéngbó de qīngnián chuàngyè tuánduì píngjiè mǐnruì de shìchǎng dòngchálì xùnsù zhǎnlùtóujiǎo.
朝气蓬勃.en: This youthful, vigorous startup team quickly made its mark with keen market insight.

招投标.zh: 市政工程的整个招投标过程都在公证人员的监督下进行，以确保公平透明。
招投标.py: Shìzhèng gōngchéng de zhěnggè zhāotóubiāo guòchéng dōu zài gōngzhèng rényuán de jiāndū xià jìnxíng, yǐ quèbǎo gōngpíng tòumíng.
招投标.en: The entire bidding and tendering process for the municipal project was conducted under the supervision of notaries to ensure fairness and transparency.

照应.zh: 独自在异乡求学期间，邻居的王阿姨经常在生活上照应他。
照应.py: Dúzì zài yìxiāng qiúxué qījiān, línjū de Wáng āyí jīngcháng zài shēnghuó shang zhàoying tā.
照应.en: While he was studying alone in another city, Aunt Wang next door often looked after him in daily life.

诈骗.zh: 随着网络通讯技术的发展，针对老年人的电信网络诈骗手段层出不穷。
诈骗.py: Suízhe wǎngluò tōngxùn jìshù de fāzhǎn, zhēnduì lǎoniánrén de diànxìn wǎngluò zhàpiàn shǒuduàn céngchūbùqióng.
诈骗.en: With the advancement of network communication technology, telecommunications fraud schemes targeting the elderly have emerged one after another.

遮挡.zh: 阳台上的绿色盆栽不仅美化了环境，还巧妙地遮挡了午后强烈的西晒阳光。
遮挡.py: Yángtái shang de lǜsè pénzāi bùjǐn měihuàle huánjìng, hái qiǎomiào de zhēdǎngle wǔhòu qiángliè de xīshài yángguāng.
遮挡.en: The green potted plants on the balcony not only beautified the environment, but also cleverly blocked the intense afternoon western sunlight.

阵地.zh: 面对敌军密集的炮火攻击，守军顽强坚守阵地，没有后退半步。
阵地.py: Miànduì díjūn mìjí de pàohuǒ gōngjī, shǒujūn wánqiáng jiānshǒu zhèndì, méiyǒu hòutuì bànbù.
阵地.en: In the face of intense artillery fire from the enemy, the defending troops stubbornly held their position without retreating half a step.

振奋.zh: 听到科研团队成功攻克核心技术难题的消息，全体员工感到无比振奋。
振奋.py: Tīngdào kēyán tuánduì chénggōng gōngkè héxīn jìshù nántí de xiāoxi, quántǐ yuángōng gǎndào wúbǐ zhènfèn.
振奋.en: Hearing the news that the research team had successfully overcome core technological hurdles, all employees felt immensely uplifted.

蒸发.zh: 烈日当空，柏油路面温度极高，洒水车喷洒的水分转瞬间便蒸发殆尽。
蒸发.py: Lièrì dāngkōng, bǎiyóu lùmiàn wēndù jígāo, sǎshuǐchē pēnsǎ de shuǐfèn zhuǎnshùnjiān biàn zhēngfā dàijìn.
蒸发.en: Under the scorching sun, the asphalt road surface reached extreme temperatures, and water sprayed by the sprinkler truck evaporated completely in an instant.

正负.zh: 在精密机械加工中，零件尺寸的允许公差必须严格控制在正负零点零一毫米以内。
正负.py: Zài jīngmì jīxiè jiāgōng zhōng, língjiàn chǐcun de yǔnxǔ gōngchā bìxū yángé kòngzhì zài zhèng-fù líng diǎn líng yī háomǐ yǐnèi.
正负.en: In precision machining, the allowable tolerance of part dimensions must be strictly kept within plus or minus 0.01 millimeters.

正经.zh: 他平时爱开玩笑，但一谈起工作上的业务方案，神情就立刻变得正经起来。
正经.py: Tā píngshí ài kāi wánxiào, dàn yī tán qǐ gōngzuò shang de yèwù fāng'àn, shénqíng jiù lìkè biàn de zhèngjing qǐlai.
正经.en: He usually loves joking around, but as soon as business plans at work are discussed, his expression immediately becomes serious.

争气.zh: 孩子们在学习上都非常争气，从未让辛勤劳作的父母操心过。
争气.py: Háizimen zài xuéxí shang dōu fēicháng zhēngqì, cóngwèi ràng xīnqín láozuò de fùmǔ cāoxīn guo.
争气.en: The children worked very hard and did admirably well in their studies, never causing their hardworking parents to worry.

正气.zh: 作为一名人民法官，他一身正气、执法严明，赢得了百姓的由衷尊敬。
正气.py: Zuòwéi yī míng rénmín fǎguān, tā yī shēn zhèngqì, zhífǎ yánmíng, yíngdéle bǎixìng de yóuzhōng zūnjìng.
正气.en: As a people's judge, he possessed complete moral integrity and enforced the law strictly, earning the heartfelt respect of the public.

征收.zh: 为了调控过热的房地产市场，政府决定对多套住房持有者依法征收房产税。
征收.py: Wèile tiáokòng guòrè de fángdìchǎn shìchǎng, zhèngfǔ juédìng duì duō tào zhùfáng chíyǒuzhě yīfǎ zhēngshōu fángchǎnshuì.
征收.en: In order to regulate the overheated real estate market, the government decided to legally levy a property tax on holders of multiple residential properties.

争先恐后.zh: 招聘会的大门一开启，求职者们便争先恐后地涌向各个知名企业的展位。
争先恐后.py: Zhāopìnhuì de dàmén yī kāiqǐ, qiúzhízhěmen biàn zhēngxiānkǒnghòu de yǒngxiàng gège zhīmíng qǐyè de zhǎnwèi.
争先恐后.en: As soon as the job fair doors opened, job seekers scrambled eagerly toward the booths of various renowned companies.

正月.zh: 按照传统习俗，每逢农历正月，家家户户都会走亲访友、互致新春祝福。
正月.py: Ànzhào chuántǒng xísú, měi féng nónglì zhēngyuè, jiājiā-hùhù dōu huì zǒu qīn fǎng yǒu, hù zhì xīnchūn zhùfú.
正月.en: According to traditional custom, during the first month of the lunar calendar, every household visits relatives and friends to exchange New Year greetings.

郑重.zh: 在就职典礼上，新任市长郑重承诺将把改善市民福祉放在首要位置。
郑重.py: Zài jiùzhí diǎnlǐ shang, xīnrèn shìzhǎng zhèngzhòng chéngnuò jiāng bǎ gǎishàn shìmín fúzhǐ fàng zài shǒuyào wèizhì.
郑重.en: At the inauguration ceremony, the new mayor solemnly pledged to place improving citizens' well-being as the top priority.

镇静.zh: 面对突如其来的火灾报警声，空乘人员迅速镇静下来，引导乘客有序撤离。
镇静.py: Miànduì tūrúqílái de huǒzāi bàojǐng shēng, kōngchéng rényuán xùnsù zhènjìng xiàlai, yǐndǎo chéngkè yǒuxù chèlí.
镇静.en: Faced with the sudden fire alarm, the flight attendants quickly calmed down and guided the passengers to evacuate in an orderly manner.

阵容.zh: 这部历史大片汇聚了多位国际巨星，豪华的演员阵容让影迷们充满期待。
阵容.py: Zhè bù lìshǐ dàpiān huìjùle duō wèi guójì jùxīng, háohuá de yǎnyuán zhènróng ràng yǐngmímen chōngmǎn qīdài.
阵容.en: This historical blockbuster gathered multiple international superstars, and the star-studded cast lineup filled movie fans with anticipation.

振兴.zh: 发展特色乡村旅游和现代农业，是全面推进乡村振兴的重要途径。
振兴.py: Fāzhǎn tèsè xiāngcūn lǚyóu hé xiàndài nóngyè, shì quánmiàn tuījìn xiāngcūn zhènxīng de zhòngyào tújìng.
振兴.en: Developing distinctive rural tourism and modern agriculture is an important way to comprehensively promote rural revitalization.

镇压.zh: 面对反动武装的暴乱叛乱，政府果断出动军队予以坚决镇压。
镇压.py: Miànduì fǎndòng wǔzhuāng de bàoluàn pànluàn, zhèngfǔ guǒduàn chūdòng jūnduì yǔyǐ jiānjué zhènyā.
镇压.en: In the face of riots and armed rebellion by reactionary forces, the government decisively deployed troops to resolutely quell them.

真挚.zh: 尽管分别多年，老同学们重逢时所流露出的真挚情感依然没有丝毫改变。
真挚.py: Jǐnguǎn fēnbié duō nián, lǎotóngxuémen chóngféng shí suǒ liúlù chū de zhēnzhì qínggǎn yīrán méiyǒu sīháo gǎibiàn.
真挚.en: Despite being apart for many years, the genuine emotions displayed when old classmates reunited remained completely unchanged.

斟酌.zh: 这份公文关系到两市的合作细节，用词造句必须反复斟酌、确保无误。
斟酌.py: Zhè fèn gōngwén guānxì dào liǎng shì de hézuò xìjié, yòngcí-zàojù bìxū fǎnfù zhēnzhuó, quèbǎo wúwù.
斟酌.en: This official document concerns the details of cooperation between the two cities, so the wording and phrasing must be carefully weighed and considered repeatedly to ensure accuracy.

折腾.zh: 搬家不仅费时费力，而且来回折腾得全家人疲惫不堪。
折腾.py: Bānjiā bùjǐn fèishí fèilì, érqiě láihuí zhēteng de quán jiārén píbèi bùkān.
折腾.en: Moving house is not only time-consuming and laborious, but tossing back and forth also left the entire family utterly exhausted.

制裁.zh: 国际社会对该国违反条约的行为实施了严厉的经济制裁。
制裁.py: Guójì shèhuì duì gāi guó wéifǎn tiáoyuē de xíngwéi shíshīle yánlì de jīngjì zhìcái.
制裁.en: The international community imposed severe economic sanctions against the country for violating the treaty.

滞留.zh: 由于突发暴风雪导致航班大面积延误，数千名旅客被迫滞留在机场候机大厅。
滞留.py: Yóuyú tūfā bàofēngxuě dǎozhì hángbān dà miànjī yánwù, shù qiān míng lǚkè bèipò zhìliú zài jīchǎng hòujīdàtīng.
滞留.en: Due to a sudden blizzard causing widespread flight delays, thousands of travelers were forced to be stranded in the airport departure hall.

致力于.zh: 这家高新技术企业多年来一直致力于清洁能源的研发与推广。
致力于.py: Zhè jiā gāoxīn jìshù qǐyè duō nián lái yīzhí zhìlìyú qīngjié néngyuán de yánfā yǔ tuīguǎng.
致力于.en: This high-tech enterprise has for many years been devoted to the research, development, and promotion of clean energy.

志气.zh: 青年人应当胸怀大志、有志气，敢于在逆境中拼搏追求梦想。
志气.py: Qīngniánrén yīngdāng xiōnghuái dàzhì, yǒu zhìqì, gǎnyú zài nìjìng zhōng pīnbó zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng.
志气.en: Young people should harbor high ambitions, have backbone and resolve, and dare to struggle in adversity to pursue their dreams.

智商.zh: 心理学家指出，一个人能否取得长远成功，不仅取决于智商，更取决于情商。
智商.py: Xīnlǐxuéjiā zhǐchū, yī gè rén néngfǒu qǔdé chángyuǎn chénggōng, bùjǐn qǔjué yú zhìshāng, gèng qǔjué yú qíngshāng.
智商.en: Psychologists point out that whether a person can achieve long-term success depends not only on IQ, but even more so on emotional intelligence.

致使.zh: 持续数周的特大暴雨致使山区多处发生山体滑坡，交通一度完全中断。
致使.py: Chíxù shù zhōu de tèdà bàoyǔ zhìshǐ shānqū duō chù fāshēng shāntǐ huápō, jiāotōng yīdù wánquán zhōngduàn.
致使.en: Torrential rains lasting several weeks caused landslides in multiple locations across the mountainous area, bringing traffic to a temporary complete standstill.

制约.zh: 关键核心零部件的短缺，已成为当前制约该行业快速发展的瓶颈。
制约.py: Guānjiàn héxīn língbùjiàn de duǎnquē, yǐ chéngwéi dāngqián zhìyuē gāi hángyè kuàisù fāzhǎn de píngjǐng.
制约.en: The shortage of key core components has become a bottleneck that restricts the rapid development of the industry.

支柱.zh: 旅游业和先进制造业已经成为该地区拉动经济增长的两大核心支柱产业。
支柱.py: Lǚyóuyè hé xiānjìn zhìzàoyè yǐjīng chéngwéi gāi dìqū lādòng jīngjì zēngzhǎng de liǎng dà héxīn zhīzhù chǎnyè.
支柱.en: Tourism and advanced manufacturing have become the two core pillar industries driving economic growth in this region.

忠诚.zh: 他对公司忠诚尽责，多年来赢得了大家的一致信任。
忠诚.py: Tā duì gōngsī zhōngchéng jìnzé, duōnián lái yíngdéle dàjiā de yízhì xìnrèn.
忠诚.en: He is loyal and conscientious toward the company, winning everyone's trust over the years.

舟.zh: 岸边停泊着几叶小舟，随着微波轻轻摇晃。
舟.py: Ànbiān tíngbó zhe jǐ yè xiǎozhōu, suízhe wēibō qīngqīng yáohuàng.
舟.en: Several small boats were moored by the shore, rocking gently with the ripples.

周折.zh: 经过一番周折，我们终于拿到了项目的批准文件。
周折.py: Jīngguò yì fān zhōuzhé, wǒmen zhōngyú nádàole xiàngmù de pīzhǔn wénjiàn.
周折.en: After many twists and turns, we finally obtained the approval documents for the project.

周转.zh: 为了保证资金周转顺畅，企业需要控制好库存规模。
周转.py: Wèile bǎozhèng zījīn zhōuzhuǎn shùnchàng, qǐyè xūyào kòngzhì hǎo kùcún guīmó.
周转.en: To ensure smooth cash turnover, enterprises need to keep their inventory under control.

拄.zh: 老大爷拄着拐杖，在公园的小径上散步。
拄.py: Lǎo dàyé zhǔzhe guǎizhàng, zài gōngyuán de xiǎojìng shang sànbù.
拄.en: The elderly man walked along the park path leaning on a cane.

专程.zh: 他专程从外地赶来参加老同学的婚礼。
专程.py: Tā zhuānchéng cóng wàidì gǎnlái cānjiā lǎo tóngxué de hūnlǐ.
专程.en: He made a special trip from out of town to attend his old classmate's wedding.

壮烈.zh: 无数革命先烈为了国家的独立而壮烈牺牲。
壮烈.py: Wúsù gémìng xiānliè wèile guójiā de dúlì ér zhuàngliè xīshēng.
壮烈.en: Countless revolutionary martyrs sacrificed their lives heroically for the nation's independence.

装卸.zh: 码头工人正在熟练地装卸集装箱货物。
装卸.py: Mǎtóu gōngrén zhèngzài shúliàn de zhuāngxiè jízhuāngxiāng huòwù.
装卸.en: Dockworkers are skillfully loading and unloading container cargo.

庄重.zh: 在这样庄重的典礼上，大家都不由得肃然起敬。
庄重.py: Zài zhèyàng zhuāngzhòng de diǎnlǐ shang, dàjiā dōu bùyóude sùrán qǐjìng.
庄重.en: At such a solemn ceremony, everyone couldn't help but feel a deep sense of reverence.

传记.zh: 这本传记详细记录了这位科学家传奇的一生。
传记.py: Zhè běn zhuànjì xiángxì jìlùle zhè wèi kēxuéjiā chuánqí de yìshēng.
传记.en: This biography chronicles in detail the legendary life of the scientist.

砖瓦.zh: 暴风雨过后，村民们用砖瓦重新修缮倒塌的围墙。
砖瓦.py: Bàofēngyǔ guòhòu, cūnmínmen yòng zhuānwǎ chóngxīn xiūshàn dǎotā de wéiqiáng.
砖瓦.en: After the rainstorm, the villagers repaired the collapsed perimeter wall using bricks and tiles.

转折.zh: 这次海外深造的经历成了她职业生涯的重要转折。
转折.py: Zhè cì hǎiwài shēnzào de jīnglì chéngle tā zhíyè shēngyá de zhòngyào zhuǎnzhé.
转折.en: The experience of further studies overseas became a major turning point in her career.

追悼.zh: 上百名亲友来到追悼会现场，向逝者表达沉痛哀思。
追悼.py: Shàng bǎi míng qīnyǒu láidào zhuīdàohuì xiànchǎng, xiàng shìzhě biǎodá chéntòng āisī.
追悼.en: Hundreds of relatives and friends attended the memorial service to express their deep condolences for the deceased.

准则.zh: 诚实守信是商业活动中不可违背的基本准则。
准则.py: Chéngshí shǒuxìn shì shāngyè huódòng zhōng bùkě wéibèi de jīběn zhǔnzé.
准则.en: Honesty and trustworthiness are fundamental principles that must not be violated in commercial activities.

琢磨.zh: 这篇发言稿经过反复琢磨，语言表达更加精炼准确。
琢磨.py: Zhè piān fāyángǎo jīngguò fǎnfù zhuómó, yǔyán biǎodá gèngjiā jīngliàn zhǔnquè.
琢磨.en: After repeated polishing, the wording of the speech became more concise and accurate.

着想.zh: 制定管理政策时，应当多为基层员工的切身利益着想。
着想.py: Zhìdìng guǎnlǐ zhèngcè shí, yīngdāng duō wèi jīcéng yuángōng de qièshēn lìyì zhuóxiǎng.
着想.en: When formulating management policies, one should consider more of the vital interests of grassroots employees.

着重.zh: 本次培训将着重讲解数据分析和实际操作技巧。
着重.py: Běn cì péixùn jiāng zhuózhòng jiǎngjiě shùjù fēnxī hé shíjì cāozuò jìqiǎo.
着重.en: This training session will emphasize data analysis and practical operational techniques.

铸造.zh: 青铜器是通过将熔化的金属倒入模具铸造而成的。
铸造.py: Qīngtóngqì shì tōngguò jiāng rónghuà de jīnshǔ dàorù mújù zhùzào ér chéng de.
铸造.en: Bronze ware was cast by pouring molten metal into molds.

驻扎.zh: 一支维和部队长年驻扎在边境地区以维护当地和平。
驻扎.py: Yì zhī wéihé bùduì chángnián zhùzhā zài biānjìng dìqū yǐ wéihù dāngdì hépíng.
驻扎.en: A peacekeeping force has been stationed in the border region for years to maintain local peace.

自发.zh: 事故发生后，附近居民自发组织起来参与救援工作。
自发.py: Shìgù fāshēng hòu, fùjìn jūmín zìfā zǔzhī qǐlái cānyù jiùyuán gōngzuò.
自发.en: After the accident occurred, nearby residents spontaneously organized themselves to participate in rescue operations.

自满.zh: 取得一点成绩绝不能盲目自满，还要继续虚心学习。
自满.py: Qǔdé yìdiǎn chéngjì jué bù néng mángmù zìmǎn, hái yào jìxù xūxīn xuéxí.
自满.en: Achieving a little success should never make one blindly complacent; we must continue to learn with an open mind.

资深.zh: 他作为一名资深记者，多次深入一线进行深度调查报道。
资深.py: Tā zuòwéi yì míng zīshēn jìzhě, duō cì shēnrù yíxiàn jìnxíng shēndù diàochá bàodào.
资深.en: As a veteran journalist, he went to the front lines many times to conduct in-depth investigative reports.

滋长.zh: 长期缺乏有效监督容易滋长腐败现象。
滋长.py: Chángqī quēfá yǒuxiào jiāndū róngyì zīzhǎng fǔbài xiànxiàng.
滋长.en: A prolonged lack of effective supervision easily breeds corruption.

纵横.zh: 高速公路网络纵横交错，极大地便利了城际之间的交通。
纵横.py: Gāosù gōnglù wǎngluò zònghéng jiāocuò, jídà de biànlìle chéngjì zhījiān de jiāotōng.
纵横.en: The network of expressways crisscrosses the country, greatly facilitating intercity transportation.

宗旨.zh: 该公益机构的宗旨是为贫困山区的儿童提供教育援助。
宗旨.py: Gāi gōngyì jīgòu de zōngzhǐ shì wèi pínkùn shānqū de értóng tígōng jiàoyù yuánzhù.
宗旨.en: The objective of this non-profit organization is to provide educational assistance to children in impoverished mountainous areas.

揍.zh: 他因为在学校欺负同学，回家后被父亲狠狠地揍了一顿。
揍.py: Tā yīnwèi zài xuéxiào qīfu tóngxué, huíjiā hòu bèi fùqīn hěnhěn de zòule yí dùn.
揍.en: Because he bullied a classmate at school, he was beaten severely by his father after returning home.

走漏.zh: 谈判还没正式开始，核心信息就已经提前走漏了。
走漏.py: Tánpàn hái méi zhèngshì kāishǐ, héxīn xìnxī jiù yǐjīng tíqián zǒulòule.
走漏.en: Before the negotiations even officially began, core information had already been leaked in advance.

钻研.zh: 他多年来潜心钻研古籍修复技术，成为这一领域的权威。
钻研.py: Tā duōnián lái qiánxīn zuānyán gǔjí xiūfù jìshù, chéngwéi zhè yí lǐngyù de quánwēi.
钻研.en: Over the years, he devoted himself to meticulously studying ancient book restoration techniques, becoming an authority in this field.

嘴唇.zh: 由于天气寒冷干燥，她的嘴唇有些干裂。
嘴唇.py: Yóuyú tiānqì hánlěng gānzào, tā de zuǐchún yǒuxiē gānliè.
嘴唇.en: Due to the cold and dry weather, her lips were somewhat chapped.

阻拦.zh: 尽管家人竭力阻拦，他还是毅然决定前往边远地区支教。
阻拦.py: Jǐnguǎn jiārén jiélì zǔlán, tā háishì yìrán juédìng qiánwǎng biānyuǎn dìqū zhījiào.
阻拦.en: Despite his family's strenuous efforts to dissuade him, he resolutely decided to go to a remote region to volunteer as a teacher.

租赁.zh: 许多刚毕业的年轻人选择与朋友合伙租赁公寓。
租赁.py: Xǔduō gāng bìyè de niánqīngrén xuǎnzé yǔ péngyou héhuǒ zūlìn gōngyù.
租赁.en: Many recent graduates choose to lease an apartment together with friends.

阻挠.zh: 任何企图阻挠和平进程的行径都将遭到国际社会的强烈谴责。
阻挠.py: Rènhé qǐtú zǔnáo hépíng jìnchéng de xíngjìng dōu jiāng zāodào guójì shèhuì de qiángliè qiǎnzé.
阻挠.en: Any attempt to obstruct the peace process will be strongly condemned by the international community.

做东.zh: 今天难得聚齐，晚上的聚餐由我来做东。
做东.py: Jīntiān nándé jùqí, wǎnshang de jùcān yóu wǒ lái zuòdōng.
做东.en: It's rare for all of us to be together today; let me host dinner tonight.

作息.zh: 保持规律的作息时间对身体健康和心理状态大有裨益。
作息.py: Bǎochí guīlǜ de zuòxī shíjiān duì shēntǐ jiànkāng hé xīnlǐ zhuàngtài dàyǒu bìyì.
作息.en: Maintaining a regular daily routine is of great benefit to physical health and mental well-being.

座右铭.zh: “失败是成功之母”一直是他激励自己不断前行的座右铭。
座右铭.py: “Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ” yìzhí shì tā jīlì zìjǐ búduàn qiánxíng de zuòyòumíng.
座右铭.en: "Failure is the mother of success" has always been his motto inspiring him to forge ahead continuously.

做主.zh: 这种事情必须由你自己做主，别人只能提供建议。
做主.py: Zhè zhǒng shìqing bìxū yóu nǐ zìjǐ zuòzhǔ, biérén zhǐ néng tígōng jiànyì.
做主.en: You must make the decision for yourself in this kind of matter; others can only offer advice.
